https://leadership.ng/religion-tribe-not.body: Akume said the Federal Government was committed to ensuring that Nigerians, irrespective of their religious or ethnic backgrounds, enjoy equal opportunities and a sense of belonging in the country’s governance. The SGF stated this on Thursday in Abuja while receiving a delegation of Northern Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN) chairmen, led by Rev. Joseph Hayab. According to a statement issued by his Special Adviser on Media and Publicity, Yomi Odunuga, Akume maintained that the Tinubu administration was determined to build a united and prosperous Nigeria where every citizen could contribute meaningfully to national development. He cited the religious and ethnic composition of the Federal Executive Council as evidence of the administration’s commitment to inclusive governance, stressing that Nigeria’s diversity remained a source of strength rather than division. The SGF assured the Christian leaders that the government would continue to promote policies that foster national unity, mutual respect and equal representation across religious and ethnic divides. Akume also commended the delegation for seeking constructive engagement with the Federal Government, describing sustained dialogue between government and religious institutions as essential to national cohesion, peace and mutual understanding. He reaffirmed his commitment to maintaining open channels of communication with Church leaders to address concerns affecting Nigerians and strengthen cooperation towards national development. Speaking on the administration’s achievements, the SGF said that ongoing economic reforms and strategic interventions were designed to strengthen the economy, improve infrastructure, and enhance citizens’ welfare. He highlighted improvements in the national road network, including projects in Kaduna and Benue states, as well as the Abuja-Kaduna-Kano and Sokoto-Badagry corridors, which he said would enhance connectivity, facilitate trade, and stimulate economic activity. On the economy, Akume disclosed that Nigeria’s foreign exchange reserves had reportedly risen above $55 billion, while the unification of foreign exchange windows by the Central Bank of Nigeria was helping to stabilise the economy and strengthen investor confidence. He also defended the removal of the fuel subsidy, explaining that the policy had created additional fiscal space for increased financial transfers to state and local governments. According to him, the reform was intended to improve the business environment, stimulate economic growth and enable governments at all levels to channel more resources towards development priorities. In the education and health sectors, Akume highlighted the establishment of additional universities, the provision of student loans through the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND), and the development of specialised health centres to improve diagnostic services and healthcare delivery. He further disclosed that the Federal Government was pursuing plans to unlock four million hectares of land for agricultural production and construct 10 new dams to boost food production and strengthen food security. The SGF said the initiatives formed part of the administration’s broader objective of achieving food sovereignty by 2050. He reiterated that the government would continue implementing reforms aimed at economic recovery, social inclusion and sustainable national development. Earlier, the Chairman of the Northern CAN Chairmen, Rev. Joseph Hayab, said the delegation’s visit was intended to strengthen engagement with the Federal Government and reaffirm the Church’s commitment to promoting national development, peace and unity. Hayab pledged the Church’s prayers, support and solidarity with the Tinubu administration, assuring the SGF of the willingness of Christian leaders to collaborate with government on issues of national importance. He also expressed the Church’s readiness to assist the government in communicating its achievements to Nigerians, particularly in addressing misconceptions, scepticism and misinformation surrounding its policies and programmes. According to him, the Church intends to use the forthcoming religious celebrations in December and January to sensitise members on national progress and encourage constructive engagement with government. Hayab cited improvements in the road network in Kaduna State as an example of infrastructure development that deserved greater public awareness. He, however, called for sustained engagement and greater access to government leadership so that religious leaders could communicate citizens’ concerns, challenges, and aspirations directly. The cleric urged Akume to continue seeking the support and collaboration of Church leaders, assuring him of their commitment to contributing to national development through prayers, advocacy and constructive partnership with government. Meanwhile, the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (SGF), Senator George Akume, has warned promoters of the Renewed Hope Electric Transportation Initiative (RHETI) against raising Nigerians’ expectations with promises of affordable electric mass transit without putting in place practical measures to deliver the project. Akume said good intentions alone would not guarantee the success of the proposed initiative, insisting that issues of electricity supply, maintenance, safety and affordable fares must be adequately addressed before the Federal Government could consider granting final approval. He spoke on Thursday in Abuja during a meeting with the promoters of the initiative, a private-sector-driven proposal to introduce affordable electric mass transit across Nigeria’s six geopolitical zones. In a statement by his spokesman, Yomi Odunuga, the SGF said that although the Federal Government welcomed the proposal, the promoters must demonstrate that their plans could translate into tangible benefits for ordinary Nigerians, particularly commuters struggling with rising transportation costs. “Good intentions do not move buses. Electricity moves them. Maintenance keeps them on the road. Sound management keeps fares within reach and passengers safe,” he said. Akume explained that the proposal, submitted to his office through a letter dated 16 September and signed by the initiative’s convener, Dr Madisca Achile, attracted the government’s attention because the promoters were not requesting financial support from the Federal Government. He said the promoters had offered to provide the capital for the project while seeking government endorsement, coordination and an enabling environment for its implementation. “In this building we receive a great many proposals, and most of them, sooner or later, find their way to the same address: the federal budget. This one is different. “Dr Achile, you have said that you did not come here with a begging bowl, and I take you at your word. You are telling government: we will bring the capital; give us your blessing, your coordination and the right environment, and let the results speak for themselves,” Akume said. He described the proposal as consistent with the Tinubu administration’s Renewed Hope Agenda, which encourages private-sector participation in addressing national development challenges. However, the SGF said the promoters must provide clear answers on electricity supply, charging infrastructure, operational standards, passenger safety, and the mechanisms to ensure that fares remain affordable. He also emphasised the need for collaboration with state governments whose cities would host the proposed pilot routes. “These are not obstacles. They are the foundations on which the whole project will stand or fall,” he stated. Akume identified four major benefits the initiative could deliver if successfully implemented, including reduced transportation costs, support for Nigeria’s energy transition, job creation and equitable access across the six geopolitical zones. On the cost of living, he said cheaper fares would enable families to save more money for food, school fees and rent, particularly those who spend a substantial portion of their income on daily transportation. He added that the initiative would complement the Presidential Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) Initiative and Nigeria’s Energy Transition Plan. On employment, Akume said the project could create opportunities for drivers, technicians and charging-station operators, while opening up possibilities for local assembly and the manufacture of electric vehicle components. He disclosed that the promoters were already working with the National Directorate of Employment to train young Nigerians in electric-vehicle repair and maintenance. The SGF welcomed the promoters’ proposal to begin with one pilot route in a city in each geopolitical zone before expanding the scheme based on performance. He also requested regular reports detailing jobs created, kilometres covered and savings made by commuters. Akume said his office would facilitate engagement between the promoters and relevant government institutions, including the Federal Ministries of Transportation, Power, and Finance; the Presidential CNG Initiative; and the National Automotive Design and Development Council. He disclosed that a team from the Office of the SGF, working under the Permanent Secretary, Political and Economic Affairs, had been constituted to work closely with the promoters. The team, he said, would help develop an implementable framework that includes the proposed pilot cities, deliverables, timelines, funding model, and measurable outcomes. Akume, however, clarified that the government’s endorsement of the proposal was not yet final approval, explaining that the framework would guide further consideration of the initiative. He expressed hope that the project would eventually ease the transportation burden on Nigerians, particularly low-income earners. “If, some months from now, she steps onto a clean, quiet and affordable bus, and arrives at work with money still in her purse, then together we will have done something worthwhile. That is what Renewed Hope looks like on our streets,” he said, referring to a nurse he had earlier used to illustrate the daily transportation challenges facing Nigerians. Earlier, Achile said the initiative was conceived to address the high cost of transportation and contribute to the Federal Government’s efforts to reduce poverty. He said the proposal was designed to add value to the Tinubu administration’s development agenda without requiring financial contributions from the Federal Government. “The SGF said he would support anything that would reduce poverty in the country. That is why I came up with this idea to bring electric vehicles that would ease mass transportation at an equally affordable rate throughout the federation. “We are here to add value to the agenda of Mr President, and we are doing this without asking a kobo from the Federal Government. We are here just to get approval, and this is a way out to contribute to mass transit in the country and the reduction of the cost of transportation,” Achile said. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/religion-tribe-not.title_zh: 宗教和部族不是蒂努布任命官员的依据
https://leadership.ng/religion-tribe-not.body_zh: 阿库梅表示，联邦政府致力于确保尼日利亚人无论宗教或族群背景如何，都能享有平等机会，并在国家治理中感受到归属感。联邦政府秘书长星期四在阿布贾接见由牧师约瑟夫·哈亚布率领的尼日利亚北部基督教协会（CAN）主席代表团时说出了上述情况。根据其媒体与公共宣传特助约米·奥杜努加发表的声明，阿库梅坚称，提努布政府决心建设一个团结繁荣的尼日利亚，让每位公民都能为国家发展作出有意义的贡献。他以联邦执行委员会的宗教和族群构成为例，说明本届政府致力于推行包容性治理，并强调尼日利亚的多样性仍是力量来源，而非引发分裂的因素。联邦政府秘书长向基督教领袖保证，政府将继续推动促进国家团结、相互尊重以及宗教和族群之间平等代表的政策。阿库梅还赞扬代表团寻求与联邦政府开展建设性沟通，并指出政府与宗教机构之间持续对话对于国家凝聚、和平与相互理解至关重要。他重申将与教会领袖保持畅通的沟通渠道，以处理影响尼日利亚人的问题，并加强双方在国家发展方面的合作。在谈及本届政府的成就时，联邦政府秘书长表示，持续推进的经济改革和战略性干预旨在 strengthening 经济、改善基础设施并提升公民福祉。他重点介绍了全国道路网络的改善，包括卡杜纳州和贝努埃州的项目，以及阿布贾—卡杜纳—卡诺和索科托—巴达格里交通走廊；他表示，这些项目将增强连通性、促进贸易并激发经济活动。在经济方面，阿库梅透露，据报尼日利亚外汇储备已升至550亿美元以上，而尼日利亚中央银行统一外汇窗口的措施正帮助稳定经济并增强投资者信心。他还为取消燃料补贴辩护，称这项政策为增加向州政府和地方政府拨付更多资金创造了额外的财政空间。据他介绍，这项改革旨在改善营商环境、刺激经济增长，并使各级政府能够将更多资源投入发展重点领域。在教育和卫生领域，阿库梅重点提到增建大学、通过尼日利亚教育贷款基金（NELFUND）提供学生贷款，以及建设专科医疗中心，以改善诊断服务和医疗服务。他进一步透露，联邦政府正推进计划，开发400万公顷土地用于农业生产，并修建10座新水坝，以增加粮食产量并加强粮食安全。联邦政府秘书长表示，这些举措是本届政府到2050年实现粮食自主这一更广泛目标的组成部分。他重申，政府将继续实施旨在推动经济复苏、社会包容和可持续发展的改革。此前，北部CAN主席团主席约瑟夫·哈亚布牧师表示，代表团此次访问旨在加强与联邦政府的沟通，并重申教会致力于推动国家发展、和平与团结。哈亚布承诺为提努布政府祈祷、提供支持和声援，并向联邦政府秘书长保证，基督教领袖愿就具有全国重要性的议题与政府合作。他还表示，教会愿协助政府向尼日利亚人传达其成就，特别是在澄清围绕其政策和方案存在的误解、疑虑与错误信息方面。据他介绍，教会拟利用12月和次年1月即将举行的宗教庆典，提高成员对国家进展的认识，并鼓励他们与政府开展建设性沟通。哈亚布以卡杜纳州道路网络的改善为例，说明基础设施发展值得公众给予更多关注。不过，他呼吁持续加强沟通，并提高民众接触政府领导层的机会，使宗教领袖能够直接传达公民的担忧、挑战和诉求这位教士敦促阿库梅继续争取教会领袖的支持与合作，并向他保证，教会领袖愿通过祈祷、倡议以及与政府建立建设性伙伴关系，为国家发展作出贡献。与此同时，联邦政府秘书长、参议员乔治·阿库梅警告“更新希望电动交通倡议”（RHETI）的推动者，不要在没有切实措施落实项目的情况下，以价格可负担的电动公共交通承诺抬高尼日利亚人的期望。阿库梅表示，仅凭良好意愿无法确保拟议倡议取得成功，坚称在联邦政府考虑给予最终批准前，必须充分解决供电、维护、安全和票价可负担等问题。他星期四在阿布贾与该倡议的推动者会面时发表了上述讲话。这是一项由私营部门主导的提案，拟在尼日利亚六个地缘政治区推出价格可负担的电动公共交通。根据其发言人约米·奥杜努加发表的声明，联邦政府秘书长表示，尽管联邦政府欢迎这项提案，但推动者必须证明其计划能够为普通尼日利亚人带来切实好处，尤其是那些正为交通成本上涨而苦苦挣扎的通勤者。他说：“良好意愿开不动公共汽车。电力才能让公共汽车行驶。维护能让它们继续在路上。健全的管理能让票价保持在公众可承受的范围内，并保障乘客安全。”阿库梅解释道，这项提案于9月16日通过一封由倡议召集人马迪斯卡·阿奇莱博士签署的信函提交至其办公室，因推动者并未请求联邦政府提供财政支持而引起政府关注。他说，推动者愿意为项目提供资本，同时寻求政府的认可、协调以及有利于项目实施的环境。阿库梅说：“在这里，我们收到过大量提案，其中大多数迟早都会找到同一个去处：联邦预算。但这一项不同。‘阿奇莱博士，你说你不是来伸手要钱的，我信你的话。你是在告诉政府：我们会带来资本；请给予我们支持、协调和适宜的环境，让成果自己说明一切。’”阿库梅表示，这项提案符合提努布政府的“更新希望议程”，该议程鼓励私营部门参与应对国家发展挑战。不过，联邦政府秘书长表示，推动者必须就供电、充电基础设施、运营标准、乘客安全以及确保票价保持可负担的机制给出明确答复。他还强调，需要与拟试点路线所在城市的州政府合作。他说：“这些不是障碍，而是整个项目成败所依托的基础。”阿库梅指出，该倡议若成功实施，可带来四项主要好处，包括降低交通成本、支持尼日利亚能源转型、创造就业机会，以及让六个地缘政治区均能公平享受相关服务。在生活成本方面，他说，更低的票价将让家庭能够把更多钱用于食品、学费和住房，尤其是那些收入中有相当大比例用于日常交通的家庭。他补充称，该倡议将与总统压缩天然气（CNG）倡议和尼日利亚能源转型计划形成互补。在就业方面，阿库梅表示，该项目可为司机、技术人员和充电站运营商创造机会，同时为电动车辆零部件的本地组装和制造开辟空间。他透露，推动者正与国家就业管理局合作，为尼日利亚年轻人开展电动车辆维修与维护培训。联邦政府秘书长欢迎推动者提出先在每个地缘政治区选择一座城市试点一条路线，再根据实施表现扩大规模的建议。他还要求定期提交报告，详细说明创造的就业岗位、覆盖的公里数以及通勤者节省的开支。阿库梅表示，其办公室将推动促进推动者与相关政府机构之间的沟通，包括联邦交通部、联邦电力部、联邦财政部、总统CNG倡议以及国家汽车设计与开发委员会。他透露，在政治与经济事务常任秘书领导下，联邦政府秘书长办公室已组建一个团队，负责与推动者密切合作。他说，该团队将协助制定可执行的框架，涵盖拟议试点城市、交付成果、时间表、资金模式以及可量化结果。不过，阿库梅澄清，政府对该提案的认可尚不等于最终批准，并解释说，这份框架将指导对该倡议的后续审议。他希望该项目最终能减轻尼日利亚人的交通负担，尤其是低收入群体的负担。他说：“如果几个月后，她踏上一辆干净、安静且价格实惠的公共汽车，到达工作地点时钱包里还有钱，那么我们共同就做成了一件有意义的事。这就是更新希望在我们街头的样子。”他说这番话时指的是一名护士，早先曾用她说明尼日利亚人每天面临的交通难题。此前，阿奇莱表示，该倡议旨在应对高昂的交通成本，并为联邦政府减轻贫困的努力作出贡献。他说，这项提案旨在为提努布政府的发展议程增添价值，同时不需要联邦政府提供财政资金。阿奇莱说：“联邦政府秘书长表示，他会支持任何能够减少全国贫困的项目。因此我提出这个想法，引入电动车辆，以同样可负担的价格为全国大众交通提供便利。我们来此是为了为总统先生的议程增添价值，而且没有向联邦政府索要一科博。我们来这里只是为了获得批准，并希望以此为全国公共交通和降低交通成本贡献力量。”阿奇莱说。抢先掌握动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/russ.body: Share Comments Add Euronews on Google Share Facebook Twitter Flipboard Send Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp A Russian deputy prime minister led a 70-strong Russian delegation to Afghanistan, pursuing deals on transport, logistics, agriculture, and health products with the Taliban. Russian deputy prime minister Alexei Overchuk was welcomed by a guard of honour when he arrived in Kabul on Thursday with a delegation of 70 Russian business people to conduct business talks with the Taliban government, Afghan officials said. Overchuk met Taliban prime minister Mohammad Hassan Akhund, the deputy prime minister for economic affairs Abdul Ghani Baradar as well as foreign minister Amir Khan Muttaqi. According to a statement by the Afghan government published on X, Abdul Ghani Baradar described to the Russians Afghanistan's potential for economic development and investment, pointing to "strategic location, abundant resources and a workforce of 24 million people". Abdul Ghani Baradar invited Russian companies to invest in agriculture, mining, constructions of roads, railways and factories, and to create a special economic zone in Afghanistan, while expressing his wish to expand exports of Afghan agricultural products to Russia. The deputy prime minister also asked Russia to "provide the necessary facilities for Afghan products to be supplied to Russian markets and to cooperate in reducing transport and transit costs". Overchuk said that the companies represented in the delegation work in the fields of transport, logistics, agriculture and pharmaceuticals and that the Afghan government is interested in Russian chemical fertilisers, as well as in "building fertiliser production plants on Afghan soil". Overchuk estimated that trade between Russia and Afghanistan in the first eight months of 2026 had more than doubled, reaching over 349 million dollars. Russia officially recognised the Taliban government in July 2025, being the only state to have taken such a step since the Taliban seized power in August 2021, after the withdrawal of the United States. Although no country other than Russia has formally recognised the new Afghan regime, the Taliban authorities have so far held high-level talks with many states and have established specific diplomatic and economic relations with some governments
https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/russ.title_zh: 俄罗斯派遣大型商业代表团赴喀布尔，与塔利班举行商务会谈
https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/russ.body_zh: 分享 评论 在Google上添加Euronews 分享 Facebook Twitter Flipboard 发送 Reddit LinkedIn Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads WhatsApp 俄罗斯副总理率领一个由70人组成的俄罗斯代表团访问阿富汗，与塔利班就运输、物流、农业和卫生产品等合作事宜进行洽谈。阿富汗官员表示，俄罗斯副总理阿列克谢·奥弗丘克周四抵达喀布尔时受到仪仗队欢迎，随行的是由70名俄罗斯商界人士组成的代表团，他们将同塔利班政府展开商业会谈。奥弗丘克会见了塔利班总理穆罕默德·哈桑·阿洪德、经济事务副总理阿卜杜勒·加尼·巴拉达尔以及外交部长阿米尔·汗·穆塔qi。阿富汗政府发布在X上的一份声明称，阿卜杜勒·加尼·巴拉达尔向俄方介绍了阿富汗经济发展和投资的潜力，指出阿富汗拥有“战略位置、丰富资源和一支2400万人的劳动力队伍”。阿卜杜勒·加尼·巴拉达尔邀请俄罗斯企业投资农业、采矿业、公路、铁路和工厂建设，并在阿富汗设立经济特区，同时希望扩大阿富汗农产品对俄罗斯的出口。这位副总理还要求俄罗斯“提供必要设施，将阿富汗产品供应至俄罗斯市场，并合作降低运输和过境成本”。奥弗丘克表示，代表团所属企业从事运输、物流、农业和制药等领域，阿富汗政府有兴趣进口俄罗斯化学肥料，并希望在阿富汗境内“建设肥料生产厂”。奥弗丘克估计，2026年前8个月俄阿贸易额增长了一倍以上，超过3.49亿美元。俄罗斯于2025年7月正式承认塔利班政府，是美国撤军、塔利班于2021年8月夺取政权后唯一采取这一步骤的国家。尽管除俄罗斯外尚无其他国家正式承认阿富汗新政权，但塔利班当局迄今已与许多国家举行高级别会谈，并与一些政府建立了具体的外交和经济关系

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The awards presented to Genesis Energy Holding on the opening day of the Summit, at the Landmark Event Centre, Lagos, on Tuesday, 10 November2026, under the theme, “Lagos Energy Evolution: Transforming the Future.” includes the “Most Impactful Project (Power) Award” and the “Excellence in Energy – Summit Partner Appreciation Award.” The first was conferred on the company by Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa, Chairman of the Lagos State House of Assembly Committee on Energy and Mineral Resources, while the second award was conferred on the company by Hon. Biodun Ogunleye, Commissioner for Energy and Mineral Resources, Lagos State. The recognition underscores Genesis Energy Holdings’commitment to advancing reliable electricity supply, developing critical power infrastructure and supporting the transformation of Lagos State’s energy sector through strategic investments and partnerships. Through its subsidiary, GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd, the company operates the Banana Island Local Grid Project in Ikoyi, Lagos, an integrated power generation and distribution network providing reliable electricity to residential and commercial customers. Designed to reduce dependence on expensive and polluting diesel and heavy fuel oil (HFO) generators, the project currently records approximately 99% uptime. Its infrastructure capacity was recently doubled from 15MVA to 30MVA following the commissioning of an expanded substation, strengthening its ability to meet the growing electricity demand within the community. Further demonstrating its commitment to expanding electricity infrastructure across Lagos State , GENESIS is developing Project Echo, the 260MW Ikorodu Power Project, in partnership with the Lagos State Government under the CLEM initiative. With the Lagos State Market Operator as off-taker, the gas-fired power project is designed to deliver reliable, grid-integrated electricity, strengthening power supply across Ikorodu and supporting the development of a more resilient electricity market. Once operational, the project is expected to improve electricity availability for households, businesses and industries, while stimulating economic activity and supporting the area’s continued development. Commenting on the awards, Chairman and CEO of Genesis Energy, Mr Akinwole II Omoboriowo, said: “We want to extend our gratitude to Lagos State for giving us the opportunity to serve. We are most grateful for this recognition, which, for us, is both an honour and a call to action – a call to invest more. The business of energy is a very serious affair. Without energy, there can be no life. For us at GENESIS, it is not just a business; it is a lifelong commitment to uplifting our country and our continent, with Lagos State being at the forefront of that commitment.” These investments reflect the Group’s alignment with Lagos State’s electricity sector reform agenda, particularly the objectives of the Lagos State Electricity Law 2024, which provides a framework for developing a competitive, transparent and commercially viable electricity market. Since its establishment in 2005, Genesis Energy Holdings has developed and financed clean energy projects across Africa, with operations and project footprints spanning 11 African countries. The company deploys a diverse range of technologies, including solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), natural gas, wind, hydro and hybrid solutions, to develop reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure for businesses, governments and communities. Its Nigerian portfolio includes the 84MW gas-fired power project at the Port Harcourt Refinery Complex, one of Nigeria’s largest licensed private off-grid power plants and NIDI project in Kano. In 2025, the Group further expanded its engagement in Nigeria through a US$500 million Memorandum of Understanding with the Katsina State Government for the development, financing, construction, operation and maintenance of major energy infrastructure projects across the State. With a vision to “Light Up Africa One Community at a Time,” GENESIS remains committed to developing and deploying reliable, affordable and sustainable energy infrastructure that addresses the continent’s growing energy needs. Through strategic investments, innovative technologies and partnerships with governments and private-sector stakeholders, the company continues to advance energy access, strengthen energy security and support economic development across Africa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: Genesis Energy 在拉各斯能源峰会上赢得两项奖项，进一步彰显其推动电力基础设施发展的承诺
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 2026年11月10日星期二，在拉各斯Landmark Event Centre举行的峰会开幕当天，Genesis Energy Holding以“拉各斯能源演进：塑造未来”为主题获得“最具影响力项目（电力）奖”和“能源卓越奖——峰会合作伙伴致谢奖”。第一项奖由拉各斯州议会议会能源与矿产资源委员会主席Hon Sabur Akanbi Oluwa授予公司，第二项奖由拉各斯州能源与矿产资源专员Hon. Biodun Ogunleye授予公司。这一认可凸显了Genesis Energy Holdings致力于推进可靠电力供应、建设关键电力基础设施，并通过战略投资与合作推动拉各斯州能源部门转型的承诺。公司通过子公司GELMAK Power Solutions Ltd运营位于拉各斯Ikoyi的Banana Island Local Grid项目。该项目是一体化发电与配电网络，为住宅和商业客户提供可靠电力，旨在减少对昂贵且污染严重的柴油和重燃油（HFO）发电机的依赖，目前运行时间占比约为99%。扩建变电站投运后，其基础设施容量近期从15MVA增至30MVA，增强了满足社区不断增长的用电需求的能力。GENESIS还与拉各斯州政府合作，在CLEM倡议框架下开发Echo项目，即260MW的Ikorodu电力项目，以进一步扩大拉各斯州电力基础设施。项目由拉各斯州市场运营商作为购电方，这座燃气发电项目旨在输送可靠、并网运行的电力，加强Ikorodu的电力供应，并支持建设更具韧性的电力市场。项目投入运营后，预计将改善家庭、企业和工业用电的可用性，同时激发经济活动并支持当地持续发展。Genesis Energy董事长兼首席执行官Akinwole II Omoboriowo先生谈及获奖时表示：“我们要向拉各斯州给予我们服务机会表示由衷感谢。我们非常感谢这份认可，对我们而言，它既是一份荣誉，也是一项行动号召——呼吁我们加大投资。能源事业是一项非常严肃的事业。没有能源，就没有生活。对GENESIS而言，能源不仅是一门生意，更是一项毕生致力于提升我们国家和我们大陆福祉的承诺，而拉各斯州始终走在这一承诺的最前沿。”这些投资体现着集团与拉各斯州电力部门改革议程的一致性，特别是对《2024年拉各斯州电力法》目标的支持。该法为建设竞争、透明且具有商业可行性的电力市场提供了框架。自2005年成立以来，Genesis Energy Holdings已在非洲各地开发并资助清洁能源项目，业务及项目遍及11个非洲国家。公司采用多种技术，包括太阳能光伏（PV）、电池储能系统（BESS）、天然气、风能、水电和混合能源解决方案，为企业、政府和社区建设可靠、可持续的能源基础设施。其在尼日利亚的项目组合包括位于哈科特港炼油厂的84MW燃气发电项目——这是尼日利亚规模最大的持牌私营离网电站之一——以及位于卡诺的NIDI项目。2025年，集团通过与卡塔琳娜州政府签署价值US$500 million的谅解备忘录，进一步扩大在尼日利亚的业务合作，开发、融资、建设和运营维护该州的大型能源基础设施项目。秉持“逐个社区点亮非洲”的愿景，GENESIS继续致力于开发和部署可靠、可负担且可持续的能源基础设施，应对非洲大陆不断增长的能源需求。公司通过战略投资、创新技术以及与政府和私营部门相关方的合作，持续推进能源可及性、强化能源安全并支持非洲各地经济发展。

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.summary_zh: 都柏林——微软产品周五大面积中断，引发了欧洲要求掌控自身数字基础设施的新一轮呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景充满不确定性的情况下。Mensch没有专门评论此次微软服务中断；该中断持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。
https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body: DUBLIN — Friday's widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. "Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure," Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology "could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development," said the boss of Europe's leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn't specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. "When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday's gathering of the leaders of the EU's 27 member countries. "We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU," Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically "must support European technology." Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a "reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants," said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said

https://www.politico.eu/article/microsof.body_zh: 都柏林——微软旗下产品周五发生大范围故障，再次引发要求欧洲掌控自身数字基础设施的呼声，尤其是在人工智能前景存在不确定性的背景下。Mistral首席执行官Arthur Mensch周五发表讲话称：“欧洲只有20%的数字服务运行在欧洲的基础设施上。”他此前在都柏林举行的首次欧盟各国领导人人工智能会议上发表了演讲。这家欧洲领先的前沿人工智能实验室负责人说，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里重新投资，用于我们掌控的基础设施，并资助欧洲的研究与开发”。Mensch没有直接评论微软故障。这次故障持续近24小时，影响了74个国家的数百万用户。不过，包括Outlook电子邮件和Teams即时通信在内的关键工具中断，还是影响了许多齐聚都柏林、筹划欧洲人工智能未来的科技和政府领导人。法国总统Emmanuel Macron在X上发帖为当天收尾：“我们的独立不能外包。必须在这里、在欧洲亲手建设。”他写道：“谈到人工智能，欧洲同样具备参与竞争的一切条件。我们没有时间可以浪费。”包括掌控云、芯片和人工智能模型在内的技术主权，一直是欧洲委员会主席Ursula von der Leyen第二任期的号召，也是周五欧盟27个成员国领导人会议的主要议程之一。芬兰籍欧洲议会议员Aura Salla在故障发生后于周五发布的新闻稿中说：“我们已将太多数字基础设施外包给欧盟之外的参与者。”她建议，政府合同必须明确“支持欧洲技术”。其他人则将焦点放在依赖少数几家公司掌控的数字基础设施所带来的风险上。Digital SME Alliance秘书长Sebastian Toffaletti在与POLITICO分享的一份声明中说，微软故障“提醒人们，将数字基础设施集中在少数全球科技巨头手中，会造成系统性风险”。德国社会民主党的议员Johannes Schätzl表示，此事引出了有关公共采购的问题。他说：“数字主权必须以我们能否在此类故障期间仍保持运行为衡量标准。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: Nigeria’s High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has presented his Letter of Credence to South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, marking the official commencement of his diplomatic assignment in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter to Mr Ramaphosa at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria, the official residence of the South African Presidency, on Friday. The High Commissioner shared the development on X, describing the event as “great and historic.” Letters of credence are formal diplomatic documents issued by a country’s head of state to confirm the appointment of a High Commissioner or permanent representative. They officially introduce the envoy to the receiving authority, in this case, the South African president, and certify that the individual is empowered to speak and act on behalf of their nation. Mr Fani-Kayode presented his letter of credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries. Each was formally introduced and given the floor to speak. He pledged to strengthen diplomatic relations between both countries, describing the restoration of their historic friendship as a key priority of his diplomatic mission. The envoy, also accredited to Lesotho and Eswatini, conveyed President Bola Tinubu’s goodwill to Mr Ramaphosa. This comes amid tense relations between Nigeria and South Africa over xenophobic violence that forced many African states to evacuate their citizens residing in the country. Mr Fani-Kayode had previously condemned violence against Nigerian nationals by South African security officials. He estimated that at least 30 Nigerians have been killed by the state’s police in the last four years. 12 Nigerians have also been killed since the start of the year. In September, the High Commissioner said Nigeria’s patience was running thin. Speaking at the ceremony, however, Mr Fani-Kayode recalled Nigeria’s support for South Africa during the struggle against apartheid, saying both countries shared a longstanding history of solidarity and friendship. He described Nigeria and South Africa as major trading partners on the continent and stressed the importance of preserving their historical ties. “Part of my job here is to reset that relationship, to come and build that bridge, and to ensure that whatever concerns we have, we can work them out and move forward together,” he said. Mr Fani-Kayode added that closer cooperation between the two countries would strengthen Africa’s position and advance the interests of their citizens. “If Nigeria and South Africa work closely together, the destiny of our great continent will be more secure,” he said. The high commissioner also commended South Africa’s contributions to international diplomacy, particularly its role in BRICS, the Global South and the Group of 20 (G20). He described South Africa’s engagement in global affairs as important to strengthening Africa’s representation on the international stage. Meanwhile, Mr Fani-Kayode, on his X handle, complained that the South African presidential media team failed to live-stream his speech despite capturing those of the other ambassadors present. “Of all the 15 introductions and speeches that were made and delivered this morning, only Nigeria’s was cut out,” he said. “To be clear, I repeat, we were the ONLY ones that were left out.” “Clearly, some elements in South Africa do not want to hear what we have to say or see our faces, but we are here to stay as long as we are welcome and have the confidence of President Ramaphosa, which I am sure we do,” he noted further
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 法尼-卡约德向拉马福萨递交国书，正式履任大使
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 尼日利亚驻南非大使费米·法尼-卡约德向南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨递交国书，正式开始其在南非的外交任期。法尼-卡约德先生于星期五在比勒陀利亚的塞法科·马卡托总统迎宾馆——南非总统府官方官邸——向拉马福萨先生递交国书。大使在X平台分享了这一消息，称此次活动“重大而具有历史意义”。国书是由一国国家元首签发的正式外交文件，用于确认任命高级专员或常驻代表。国书向接受国主管机构正式介绍特使，本例中的接受国主管机构是南非总统，并证明该人士获授权代表本国发表言论和采取行动。法尼-卡约德先生与其他14个国家的大使一同递交国书。每位大使均获正式介绍，并获发言机会。他承诺加强两国外交关系，并将恢复两国历史友谊列为其外交使命的一项重点。该特使同时获派驻莱索托和斯威士兰，并向拉马福萨先生转达了博拉·蒂努布总统的友好问候。此前，尼日利亚与南非因针对外国人的暴力袭击而关系紧张，许多非洲国家被迫撤离居住在南非的本国公民。法尼-卡约德先生此前曾谴责南非安全官员针对尼日利亚公民的暴力行为。他估计，过去四年间，该国警察已造成至少30名尼日利亚人死亡。今年年初以来，又有12名尼日利亚人死亡。9月，大使表示尼日利亚的耐心已接近极限。不过，法尼-卡约德先生在仪式上回顾了尼日利亚在南非反抗种族隔离斗争期间对南非的支持，称两国共享源远流长的团结与友谊历史。他将尼日利亚和南非描述为非洲大陆的重要贸易伙伴，并强调维护两国历史联系的重要性。他说：“我在这里承担的工作之一，就是重置双方关系，前来搭建这座桥梁，并确保无论双方有何关切，都能共同解决分歧，携手向前。”法尼-卡约德先生补充说，两国加强合作将增强非洲的立场，并促进两国公民的利益。他说：“如果尼日利亚和南非紧密合作，我们这个伟大大陆的未来将更加稳固。”大使还赞扬南非对国际外交的贡献，尤其是南非在金砖国家、全球南方和二十国集团（G20）中的作用。他表示，南非参与全球事务对于加强非洲在国际舞台上的代表性至关重要。与此同时，法尼-卡约德先生在其X账号上抱怨，尽管南非总统媒体团队拍摄了其他在场大使的演讲，却未对本国演讲进行直播。他说：“今天上午进行的15次介绍和发言中，唯独尼日利亚的发言被剪掉了。”“明确地说，我再重复一遍，我们是唯一被排除在外的。”他进一步指出：“显然，南非某些人士不希望听到我们要说的话，也不希望看到我们的面孔；但只要我们受到欢迎，并得到拉马福萨总统的信任，我们就会留在这里。我确信我们确实得到了他的信任。”

13일(현지시간) CSIS 주최로 열린 팟캐스트 대담에서 "트럼프 대통령이 전작권 전환을 한반도에서 미군을 철수시키는 수단으로 보고 있다는 이야기가 있다"며 "상당히 신빙성 있게 제기된 이야기"라고 밝혔다. 차 석좌는 주한미군의 "병력 규모 하한선(2만8천500명)을 설정한 국방수권법(NDAA)이 존재할 수 있지만, (트럼프 대통령이 NDAA를 우회할) 다른 방법들도 있다. 대통령은 군 통수권자"라며 "대통령이 특정 목표를 강하게 결심하면 그것을 실행할 방법들이 있다"고 말했다. 그러면서 "미국 대통령이 그런 식으로 생각하지 않을 것이라는 환상을 가져선 안 된다. 그는 분명히 이것(전작권 전환)을 한반도에서 미군을 철수시키는 방법으로 보고 있다"고 강조했다. 랜들 슈라이버 전 국방부 인도·태평양 안보 차관보도 "트럼프 대통령이 전작권 전환을 미군 철수 또는 감축 수단으로 볼 가능성이 있다는 데 100% 동의한다"며 "이 문제에 관한 트럼프 대통령의 본능적 판단"이라고 말했다. 대담을 진행한 마크 리퍼트 전 주한미국대사는 전작권 전환을 추진하다 보면 "(트럼프) 대통령은 병력을 철수시키고 싶어 할 수 있다"며 "다른 사람들은 이를 동맹의 지향점을 건설적으로 논의하는 기회로 활용할 수도 있다"고 예상했다. 빈센트 브룩스 전 주한미군사령관 겸 한미연합사령관은 "한국 정부에는 이 대통령의 임기 안에 이 문제를 마무리하려는 조급함이 있다"며 "문재인 정부 때도 똑같은 이야기를 들었다"고 상기했다. 브룩스 전 사령관은 "이 문제가 20년 넘게 논의돼 왔고 달성 목표 기준이 계속 바뀌고 있다는 (한국 측) 우려가 있지만, 그런 주장은 과거에도 사실이 아니었고 지금도 사실이 아니다"라고 주장했다. 브룩스 전 사령관은 "(전작권 전환) 조건들 가운데 유리한 것만 골라서 '우리는 준비가 됐으니 지금 당장 전환할 수 있다'고 말해서는 안 된다"고 말했다. 이어 강신철 국방부 장관이 최근 전작권 전환에 필요한 '3대 조건'이 모두 충족됐으며, "지금 당장이라도 전환이 가능하다"고 말한 데 대해 "매우 실망스럽다"고 지적했다. 그는 강 장관의 발언을 두고 "대학생이 필수 과목을 이수하지 않고 기말시험에 합격하지 않았더라도 오늘 당장 졸업할 수 있다고 말하는 것과 마찬가지"라고 비판했다. 그는 전작권 전환 후 한미연합사를 해체하고 '병렬형' 지휘체제를 구성하자는 주장이 나오지만, 현재의 통합지휘체제보다 견고하지 못한 데다 혼란과 위험을 초래할 가능성이 크다고 지적하면서 "전시에는 주권을 중심으로 조직을 구성하는 것이 아니라 승리를 위해 조직을 구성해야 한다"고 강조했다. 전문가들은 미국 민주당이 연방의회 상·하원을 압도적으로 장악한 중간선거 결과, 그리고 최근 불거진 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 스캔들에 미 상무부가 깊숙이 관여됐던 정황은 한미 안보·통상 관계에도 변수로 작용할 수 있다고 내다봤다. 슈라이버 전 차관보는 민주당이 탄핵소추를 추진하는 피트 헤그세스 국방부 장관이나 엔비디아 스캔들에 연루된 하워드 러트닉 상무부 장관 중 "일부 인사 교체가 있을 것"으로 예상했다. 차 석좌는 "제120대 의회는 관세에 관한 권한 일부를 (행정부로부터) 되찾으려고 시도할 수 있다"고 전망했다. 그는 한국 정부가 적극적으로 추진하는 조선업 진출, 핵추진 잠수함 건조, 우라늄 농축 및 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보에 "애초 큰 진전이 없었다고 주장할 수도 있겠지만, 앞으로 상황이 더욱 어려워질 것"이라고 말했다. 그 이유로는 "민주당이 상·하원을 모두 장악하게 되면, 의회에는 상당히 강력한 핵 비확산 진영이 존재하게 될 것"이라며 "이들은 트럼프 대통령이나 그를 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111400.title_zh: 美国专家称：“特朗普把权限移交视为从驻韩美军撤军的手段”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111400.body_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）驻美记者洪正规＝美国专家观察认为，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普很可能把韩国政府计划在李在明总统任期内推进的作战指挥权移交，作为美军从韩国撤军的契机。美国战略与国际问题研究所（CSIS）韩国项目主任维克托·查于当地时间13日在CSIS主办的网络播客访谈中表示：“有说法称，特朗普总统把移交作战指挥权视为从朝鲜半岛撤出美军的手段。”他说：“这个说法被相当有说服力地提出了。”查主任称：“也许存在一部设定驻韩美军兵力规模下限（2万8500人）的《国防授权法案》（NDAA），但还有其他办法可以绕过NDAA。总统是武装力量总司令。”他还说：“总统若下定决心要实现某个特定目标，就有办法付诸行动。”他强调：“不要抱有美国总统不会这么想的想法。他显然把移交作战指挥权视为从朝鲜半岛撤出美军的手段。”前美国国防部负责印度—太平洋安全事务的副部长兰德尔·施莱弗表示：“我100%认同特朗普总统有可能把移交作战指挥权视为撤军或削减美军的手段。”他说：“这是特朗普总统对这一问题作出的本能判断。”主持访谈的前美国驻韩国大使马克·利珀特预计，推动移交作战指挥权时，“（特朗普）总统可能希望撤出兵力”，而“其他人也可能把它当作建设性讨论盟友意愿的机会。”前驻韩美军司令兼韩美联合司令部司令文森特·布鲁克斯说：“韩国政府急于在这位总统任期内解决这个问题。”他还回想起：“文在寅政府时期，我们也听过同样的话。”布鲁克斯前司令主张：“虽然韩方担心这个问题已经讨论了20多年，实现目标的标准也在不断变化，但这种说法过去并非事实，现在也不是事实。”他说：“不应在移交作战指挥权的各项条件中只挑选有利的条件，然后宣称‘我们已经准备好了，现在可以立即移交’。”针对韩国国防部长姜信哲近期表示移交作战指挥权所需的‘三大条件’均已满足、‘现在随时都可以移交’，他指出这“非常令人失望”。他批评姜部长的发言称：“这就像大学生没修完必修课，却说自己今天就能通过期末考试一样。”他还指出，有观点主张在移交作战指挥权后解散韩美联合司令部并建立‘并行型’指挥体制，但这种体制不如现行联合指挥体制稳固，而且很可能引发混乱与风险。他强调：“战时组织的重点不应是以维护主权为中心，而应为取得胜利而组织。”专家预计，美国民主党在中期选举中压倒性掌控联邦参众两院，以及美国商务部深度介入近期 Nvidia首席执行官（CEO）黄仁勋的调查丑闻，都可能成为影响韩美安全与贸易关系的变数。施莱弗前副部长预计，在推动弹劾的国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯，以及卷入 Nvidia调查的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克等人中，“可能会进行部分人事调整”。查主任展望称：“第120届国会可能试图从（行政当局手中）收回部分关税授权。”他说：“有人或许会主张，韩国政府积极推进进入造船业、建造核动力潜艇，以及取得铀浓缩和乏燃料后处理权限等事项‘原本就没有取得太大进展’，但今后情况会变得更加困难。”他解释道：“如果民主党掌控参众两院，国会内部将存在一股相当强大的核不扩散阵营。”他说：“在这些问题上，他们将比特朗普总统或支持他的共和党议员积极程度低得多。”本报道可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo阅读。版权所有©韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月14日02:21发稿

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: Still on the Minna mining misfortune, By Zainab Suleiman Okino
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: By the third day, we headed for the NSCDC headquarters in Sauka, Airport Road, where all the staff involved in Minna had been brought and detained. I’m proud of the teamwork, collaboration, and collective resolve to ensure succour in the form of justice for the benefit of the poor victims of the Minna mining tragedy, who had the misfortune of being in the wrong place at the wrong time-the misfortune of being poor and unemployed, and the misfortune of being IDPs.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 第三天，我们前往机场路绍卡的NSCDC总部，那里关押着所有涉及米纳事件的全体人员。我为团队合作、协同配合以及集体决心感到自豪；我们努力以伸张正义的形式提供援助，让米纳矿难的贫困受害者受益。他们不幸在错误的时间身处错误之地，既贫困又失业，还成了境内流离失所者。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Unfortunately, Nigeria has not done creditably well in this regard over time. The works of many committees are gathering dust on shelves across the country. When the Federal Government, through the Minister of Interior, Dr Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, set up the NSCDC committee to investigate the deaths of artisanal miners at the Niger State Command, skepticism greeted the idea. Yours sincerely was one of the members. However, a lot of people also called to express their confidence and to say they would give us the benefit of the doubt, knowing I would not agree to suppress the truth. It turned out that all the committee members were enthusiastic, as was the eager public, and each came with his integrity intact and ready to fight any form of suppression of the truth or cover-up. Five weeks later, the committee submitted its report with deep insights into the root causes of the tragedy that cost the lives of innocent people, and recommendations that, if properly implemented, could change the narrative for the NSCDC and other paramilitary agencies. The committee’s report is now public knowledge and awaiting the government’s next line of action, but before then, a bit of background suffices. I waited a bit to see reactions to our findings, revelations, and recommendations. And I’m happy to note that, contrary to controversies that normally trail such efforts, a lot of people seem content with the outcome of ours and have expressed that much in their reactions and individual calls. I’m not surprised, though, considering the calibre and pedigree of the members, their inputs and commitment, and the man-hours poured into this sensitive public service concern. Soon after the September 22nd inauguration, we hit the ground running literally, working till the evening of that day to herald the pressure-cooker work of the next few weeks. We outlined our work and administrative plans and timelines of the onerous task; the sequence of events, form of engagement, etcetera. By the third day, we headed for the NSCDC headquarters in Sauka, Airport Road, where all the staff involved in Minna had been brought and detained. As a matter of courtesy, we met with the NSCDC Commandant-General and his management team. Our engagement and interrogation with the suspected staff in detention was one-on-one, starting from the lowest-ranking officer, and one by one, what transpired on the 15th and night of the 16th through to the morning of the 17th of September, when the bodies of 33 able-bodied young men were discovered , began to unfold. We interrupted this process and moved to Minna for a one-week field fact-finding mission. Our one-week stay in Minna was eventful. The emir’s palace, where we met with most of the families of victims and survivors, felt like home. The emir played host to us and played his fatherly role to all the people who thronged his palace. His advice and words of encouragement were a morale booster to all. A visit to the NSCDC command was a priority. We toured the scene of the crime and the entire NSCDC office, visited the mining sites around MI Wushishi Estate, and visited the state commands of the Police and DSS. Our first port of call on arrival was to Governor Mohammed Bago, who reiterated his commitment to finding the truth and encouraged us to do the same. Minna opened our eyes to new vistas. There we met an NSCDC top shot who was fingered through verbal confessions of those in detention in Abuja, but was seemingly shielded. His personal account collapsed in the face of overwhelming evidence and interrogation from our team. He was indicted along with some five others recommended for dismissal and prosecution. *Back to the third leg of our investigation in Abuja, suspect interrogation continued. All suspects, including the former Niger State Commandant, Suberu Aniviye, appeared before us. The session climaxed with the appearance of the Commandant-General himself. Meanwhile, putting the reports together was Herculean, emotionally and physically draining, and tasking. It took a lot of high-level discussions, back and forth, even voice votes to arrive at some conclusions. So charged, yet democratic were those sessions that betrayal of trust and outsider interference were NOT tenable.* To our relief, after an exhausting five weeks, the Minister of Interior and Nigerians received our report with excitement and a promise of implementation in its independent pristine copy. While we keep our fingers crossed and hope for restitution for victims’ families, I must express how delighted I was to have worked with some of the most patriotic and committed, I’ve ever met. The committee members obviously had pedigree and names to protect, and therefore came with much vigour, credibility, and hunger to succeed. To think otherwise could not have been, considering the lives involved. Compromise was not an alternative as we maintained our independence. We all worked our hearts out, and the report was not even ready until late night on the eve of presentation on October 27. I’m proud of the teamwork, collaboration, and collective resolve to ensure succour in the form of justice for the benefit of the poor victims of the Minna mining tragedy, who had the misfortune of being in the wrong place at the wrong time-the misfortune of being poor and unemployed, and the misfortune of being IDPs. Most of the victims were from some IDP camps scattered in parts of Niger State. I’m also happy to have worked with highly placed professionals with capacity, who approached this important national assignment with zeal and tenacity. The background of our chairman is already in the public space as a retired Deputy Director-General of the Directorate of State Services, but there is more to him. Mr. Jonathan Kure, a thoroughbred, highly sought-after professional with an outstanding career in service, has a calm and disarming demeanour that can thaw ice-cold conflict. Under his leadership, all of us felt safe. He brought his competence, years of experience, and capacity to bear on the work and was able to manage the egos of nine highly competent and accomplished professionals. Starting from an accomplished technocrat with a lot of wisdom, who retired some 14 years ago as a permanent secretary, Alhaji Idris Adamu Kuta knows all the rules and guidelines governing the public service sector and offered them appropriately. And guess what? None of us knew he retired from the mines sector and unarguably knows it like the back of his palms. But because he represented the Minna Emirate Council on the committee, he kept faith with the traditional institution whose view he must project, and he did admirably. Imagine such a self-imposed discipline! Incidentally, the Emirate Council availed us of everything we needed to do our job, including space and other conveniences. Talking of a man of power, knowledge, and capacity, but still humble and calm, the Secretary to the State Government (SSG) of Niger State, Alhaji Abubakar Usman, represented the state on the committee and used the opportunity to showcase the kind of people Governor Bago has in his cabinet-capable, proficient and hardworking. Despite his busy schedules, he made sure to be present through crucial sessions and difficult decisions when his opinions were needed. The Minna triumvirate would not be complete without the mention of Liman Suleiman, the Secretary of the Miners Association representing the association on the committee. His quiet and gentle disposition belied his knowledge of the volatile but emerging powerful sector, as a former banker and businessman. Dr George Agbakahi is an intellectual powerhouse – hardworking and determined, with the zeal to “crucify” offenders. He was fierce and made sure that no stone was left unturned to ensure justice for the Minna 33. Without moderation, and with his volume of intellectual input, we would have “written a whole book” on the incident. He was that passionate, even as he paid attention to details. AIG Hosea Hassan Karma (retd) is a big man not seeming conscious of his social status; he is a personification of humility. He went to the basics of policing responsibility by serving as our “IPO-in-Chief.” Through his untiring efforts, we were able to extract vital information needed to conclude our final verdict of culpability on some of the suspects. Professior Mikhail Olayinka Buhari is the popular histopathologist who eased our job with his practical knowledge of science and medicine. He got to Minna ahead of us, and his precursory work is central to our conclusion that 33 and not 37 miners died. His hard work, steadfastness and professionalism so stood out that he earned the chairman’s constant commendation. Deji Adeyanju, a human rights activist and lawyer, though the youngest, was the most visible; he almost took the shine off our team. As an activist, he was easily recognised and given celebrity status. Deji applied his skills as a lawyer and interrogator, which proved very useful in getting the suspects to squeal and reveal information about the true situation of things, as if he were in a law court. I’m still amazed at our camaraderie, but the unprecedented level of cooperation between the committee chairman and secretary, Professor Isa Hayatu Chiroma, still amazes me. A law professor, Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN), and former director-general (DG) of the Nigerian Law School, he came with hands-on skills and administrative experience. Yet his loyalty to hierarchy and group decisions was impressive. Obviously well experienced and established in the workings of committees, Mr Chiroma is every secretariat’s delight. Versatile, organised, competent, and proficient, Chiroma’s expertise exuded in the secretariat’s decent outcome. He had sleepless nights putting various annexures, appendices, and documents together. On the cooperation between him and the chairman, they still owe me an explanation on whether they knew or had worked together in the past. The bond was seamless. Zainab Suleiman Okino (FNGE) is chairperson of the Editorial Board of Blueprint. She is a syndicated columnist and was a member of the Independent Investigation Committee on the deaths of persons in NSCDC custody, Niger State Command, Minna. She can can be reached via [email protected]
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 明纳州矿难后续，作者：Zainab Suleiman Okino
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 遗憾的是，尼日利亚长期以来在这方面做得并不算出色。全国许多委员会的工作报告积满灰尘，静静躺在架子上。当联邦政府通过内政部长奥卢布米· Tunji-Ojo博士成立国家边境与民防安全委员会（NSCDC），调查尼日尔州指挥部手工业矿工死亡事件时，这一想法一开始就遭到了质疑。您本人正是委员会成员之一。然而，许多人也致电表达信任，表示愿意相信我，认为我不会同意掩盖真相。事实证明，委员会全体成员都充满热情，公众也同样热切；每个人都秉持操守，准备抵制一切压制真相或掩盖真相的行为。五周后，委员会提交了报告，深入剖析了这场夺走无辜生命的惨剧的根本原因，并提出多项建议；如果得到妥善落实，这些建议可能改变国家边境与民防安全委员会及其他准军事机构的发展轨迹。委员会报告现已公开，正等待政府采取下一步行动，但在此之前，简要介绍一些背景情况就足够了。我稍等了一段时间，以观察外界对我们调查结论、披露内容和建议的反应。令我高兴的是，与此类工作通常伴随的争议相反，许多人似乎对我们的调查结果感到满意，并在各自的反应和来电中充分表达了这一点。考虑到成员们的资历和履历、他们的投入与奉献，以及他们为这项敏感公共服务投入的大量工时，我并不感到意外。9月22日就职仪式结束后不久，我们便立刻投入工作，一直忙到当天傍晚，为接下来几周的高压工作拉开序幕。我们梳理了工作安排、行政计划和各项繁重任务的时间表，包括事件推进顺序、参与方式等。到了第三天，我们前往位于机场路绍卡的NSCDC总部；所有牵涉明纳案件的工作人员都已在那里接受拘留。出于礼节，我们会见了NSCDC总司长及其管理团队。我们与被拘留嫌疑人逐一进行问询和审讯，从职位最低的警员开始，一个接一个地还原了9月15日当晚至16日夜间、直到17日早晨发现33具身强体健年轻男子遗体期间发生的事情。我们暂停这一程序，转赴明纳开展为期一周的实地调查。我们在明纳的一周经历丰富。埃米尔宫里，我们与大多数遇难者家属和幸存者会面，那里让我们感到如同home一般。埃米尔热情接待我们，并对所有聚集在他宫内的人尽到父亲般的责任。他的建议和鼓励话语提振了所有人的士气。视察NSCDC指挥部是首要任务。我们查看了犯罪现场和整座NSCDC办公楼，参观了MI Wushishi Estate周边矿区，并走访了州警察指挥部和国家安全局（DSS）州指挥部。我们抵达后首先拜会了州长穆罕默德·巴戈，他重申了查明真相的决心，并鼓励我们同样坚持真相。明纳让我们开阔了眼界。在那里，我们见到一名NSCDC高层人士；阿布ja被拘留人员通过口头供述指认了他，但他似乎得到了庇护。在我们团队掌握的确凿证据和审讯面前，他的个人说法不攻自破。他与另外约5名嫌疑人一同被起诉；我们建议将后者开除并提起公诉。*回到调查在阿布贾的第三阶段，对嫌疑人的审讯仍在继续。所有嫌疑人均到案，包括前尼日尔州指挥官苏贝鲁·阿尼维耶。最后，总司长本人出庭接受问询。与此同时，汇总报告是一项极其艰巨的任务，无论在情感还是体力上都令人精疲力竭。我们进行了大量高层讨论，来回磋商，甚至采用口头表决，才形成了一些结论。那些会议牵涉广泛却又遵循民主程序，因此背叛信任或外部干预根本无法成立。*令我们欣慰的是，经过艰苦的五周工作，内政部长和尼日利亚民众兴奋地收到了我们的报告，并承诺落实报告中的建议；我们收到的是内容完整、未经删改的独立文本。我们翘首以盼，希望遇难者家属能得到赔偿；但我必须表达，与我共事过的那些最具爱国精神、投入最深的人一起工作，是我莫大的荣幸。委员会成员显然履历过硬、声名在外，因此都以十足干劲、可信度和成功决心投入工作。考虑到其中涉及的生命，我们不可能有其他想法。妥协并非选项，因为我们始终保持独立。我们人人都竭尽全力，直到10月27日提交报告的前一夜深夜，报告才最终定稿。为明纳矿难中陷入困境的可怜遇难者伸张正义，为他们带来慰藉，我们团队协作、团结一致，这让我深感自豪。这些人不幸在错误的时间身处错误地点，不幸贫穷失业，也不幸成为境内流离失所者。大多数遇难者来自尼日尔州不同地区的一些境内流离失所者营地。我也很高兴与一些身居高位、卓有能力的专业人士共事；他们以热忱和坚韧对待这项重要的国家任务。我们主席的背景已为公众所知，他曾任国家安全局（DSS）副主任；不过，他还有更多值得称道之处。乔纳森·库雷先生是一名训练有素、备受渴求的精英专业人士，公共服务生涯卓越；他的沉稳和让人卸下戒心的举止能够融化冰冷冲突。在他的领导下，我们所有人都感到安心。他把自身的专业能力、多年经验和才能用于工作，并成功驾驭了9名能力强、成就卓著的专家的自我意识。我们的专家团队中，首先是经验丰富的技术官僚阿尔哈吉·伊德里斯·阿达穆·库塔。他约在14年前便以常务秘书身份退休，通晓公共服务领域的全部规则和准则，并恰当地向我们作了说明。您猜怎么着？我们谁也不知道他是从矿业部门退休的，而他无疑对矿业了如指掌。不过，由于他代表明纳埃米尔委员会参加委员会工作，他忠实维护了必须体现其 views 的传统机构，并表现得非常出色。想想这种自我约束多么难能可贵！顺带一提，埃米尔委员会为我们履行职责提供了一切必要条件，包括场地及其他便利条件。说到这位拥有权力、知识和能力，却仍然谦逊沉稳的人，尼日尔州政府秘书（SSG）阿尔哈吉·阿布巴卡尔·乌斯曼代表州政府参加委员会工作，并借机展示了巴戈州长内阁中的人才——能干、专业而且勤奋。尽管日程繁忙，他仍确保在需要听取其意见的关键会议和艰难决策中到场。说到明纳三杰，不能不提Liman Suleiman；他担任矿工协会秘书，代表协会参加委员会工作。作为前银行家和商人，他性情安静温和，却掌握着这个动荡但正在崛起且日益强大的行业的知识。George Agbakahi博士是一位知识力量强大的人——勤奋、坚定，并有将违法者“钉上十字架”的热忱。他态度强硬，确保不放过任何线索，以保障明纳33名遇难者的正义。若非他毫不克制地提供大量知识性意见，我们本会就这起事件“写出整整一本书”。他充满激情，同时也极为注重细节。AIG Hosea Hassan Karma（已退休）是一位大人物，却似乎并未意识到自己的社会地位；谦逊的化身。他回归警务职责 basics，担任我们的“首席调查官”。通过不懈努力，我们得以提取关键信息，最终认定部分嫌疑人有罪。组织病理学教授Mikhail Olayinka Buhari广受欢迎；他凭借科学与医学实践知识减轻了我们的工作负担。他比我们先抵达明纳，其初步工作是我们认定遇难矿工为33人而非37人的关键依据。他的勤奋、坚定和专业精神十分突出，因而经常受到主席表扬。Deji Adeyanju是一名人权活动家和律师，虽然年纪最小，却最为引人注目；他几乎抢走了团队的风头。作为活动家，他很容易被辨认出来，并获得名人般的关注。Deji运用自己作为律师和审讯者的技能，发挥了极大作用，使嫌疑人开口交代，揭露事情的真实情况，仿佛他身在法庭上一样。我们之间的情谊仍令我惊叹，而委员会主席与秘书Isa Hayatu Chiroma教授之间前所未有的合作程度，更是让我惊讶。他是一名法学教授、尼日利亚资深大律师（SAN），曾任尼日利亚法学院总院长（DG），带来实务技能和行政经验。然而，他对层级和集体决策的忠诚令人印象深刻。Chiroma先生显然经验丰富，深谙委员会运作之道，是每个秘书处都梦寐以求的人才。Chiroma多才多艺、组织有序、能力出众、精于业务，他的专业素养在秘书处的良好成果中充分展现。为了把各项附件、附录和文件汇总在一起，他熬过多个不眠之夜。至于他与主席之间的合作，他们仍欠我一个解释：两人过去是否相识或共事过。两人的关系毫无隔阂。Zainab https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 美国在打击“生育旅游”行动中撤销了6,000多份签证
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 美国政府正在加强移民管控。美国国务院吊销了6,000多张签证，持证人均为参与或协助“生育旅游”的外国人。该部门周四通过其X账号宣布，其“生育旅游防范特遣队”已吊销被认定参与这一行为者的签证。帖文称：“美国国务院生育旅游防范特遣队现已吊销6,000多张签证，涉及参与或协助生育旅游的外国人。”帖文还表示，特遣队仍在查明并“追究所有参与这一非法行为者的责任”。这意味着，未来可能还会因这一行为吊销更多签证。生育旅游是指前往另一个国家，通常在怀孕期间前往当地生产，使孩子通过出生取得该国国籍或身份。最新行动表明，美国正在更广泛地打击参与者和协助者，包括帮助安排此类旅行的人。上个月，该部门宣布已吊销4,000多张签证，其中700张被吊销的签证属于中国公民。不过，最新声明没有提供按国籍划分的明细。因此，目前尚不清楚尼日利亚公民是否在受影响的签证持有人之列。严厉打击移民一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策和政治竞选的核心内容之一。美国领导人在竞选期间承诺增加对居住在美国的外国人的驱逐力度，限制庇护和难民接收，并收紧非法移民以及部分合法移民通道。特朗普复任以来，已实施多项符合这一议程的政策。例如，在就职典礼上，他签署行政命令，将非法移民宣布为全国紧急状态，并下令迅速遣返无证移民。过去一年，美国移民与海关执法局针对移民的执法行动因侵犯人权而受到批评。特朗普政府还对包括尼日利亚在内的多个国家实施签证禁令。该政府还计划推出新政策，要求在美国希望从临时签证持有人身份转为永久居民的外籍人士返回其原籍国申请绿卡

Unlock these with Subscription The fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a “mutually convenient date”, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said on Friday (November 13). Speaking to the media during the bi-weekly media briefing, Randhir Jaiswal, Official Spokesperson of the MEA, reiterated that India seeks to build “positive, constructive and forward-looking” relations with Bangladesh. “The next round of the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue, which will also take up matters relating to the Revised Travel Arrangement, will be held on a mutually convenient date. India remains ready to discuss all bilateral issues with Bangladesh through these existing mechanisms, including at the technical level,” Mr. Jaiswal said. The Hindu had reported on Thursday (November 12) about the postponement of the consular talks that were to be held on November 17 and 18. “India desires a positive, constructive, and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. Accordingly, initiatives have been taken and meetings held under our structured mechanisms in such areas as trade, railways, water resources, and border management, among others,” said Mr. Jaiswal. Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh. Ms. Hasina has been in India since August 5, 2024 and she has said that she would return to Dhaka in December. The two sides started consular dialogue in 2017 to strengthen people-to-people contact by having a regular channel of communication on consular, visa, and mutual legal assistance cooperation matters. Four rounds of consular dialogue were held during the rule of the Awami League in Dhaka. https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.body: In a statement, Macalintal stressed that passing the task of rescheduling the BSKE should the Supreme Court rule in his favor would be a “mockery of justice” and effectively reward Congress alleged abuse of discretion in postponing the polls. “This grants the legislature unchecked power over election scheduling,” he said. “For instance, if a postponement law is enacted just days before the scheduled polls—leaving virtually no time to question its constitutionality—the public is left without recourse. READ: BSKE delay: Macalintal cites public outrage in bid to flip SC decision The veteran lawyer pointed out that putting a court-ordered election in the hands of the lawmakers would result in further postponement of the election. Macalintal, in his 19-page motion for partial reconsideration filed Tuesday night, urged the high tribunal to reconsider its ruling postponing the BSKE and direct the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to hold the polls at the earliest feasible date. He said the majority of the high tribunal, voting 9-5, “gravely erred” in allowing the deferment of the BSKE as a “mere incident,” setting the term of office at five years. Macalintal initially challenged Republic Act No. 12326, the law that moved the polls to Nov. 13, 2028, from the original date of Nov. 2 this year. After filing Macalintal’s motion, Comelec Chair George Garcia said the poll body no longer has the mandate to reschedule the polls once 30 days have passed since the original election date. Macalintal said precedent shows that immediate Comelec action, not intervention from Congress, is required, as in the Supreme Court’s ruling in Hagedorn v. House of Representatives. “The court emphasized that conducting a special election within 60 days of a vacancy is a primary power and duty of the Comelec, and waiting for formal legislative declarations causes unnecessary delay,” he said, citing the 2025 decision on the case. “I appreciate Chairman Garcia bringing up this position, as it reinforces my resolve to ask the Supreme Court to reconsider its stance and set my motion for partial reconsideration for oral arguments,” he added. /mr
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.title_zh: 最高法院申请人：重排BSKE考试日程是选举委员会的决定，而非国会的决定
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.body_zh: 在一份声明中，Macalintal强调，如果最高法院裁定支持他的诉求，将重新安排菲律宾基层公务员和服务员考试（BSKE）的任务交由他人负责将是“对司法公正的嘲弄”，并会实际纵容国会被指滥用裁量权、推迟考试。他说：“这赋予立法机构不受制约的选举安排权。例如，如果在原定考试日期前仅有数日便通过一项推迟法律——几乎没有时间质疑其合宪性——公众将无处寻求救济。阅读：BSKE延期：Macalintal援引公众愤怒，企图推翻最高法院裁决。这位资深律师指出，把法院下令举行的考试交由立法者掌控，将导致考试进一步延期。Macalintal于周二晚提交一份长达19页、请求部分重新审议的动议，敦促最高法院重新审议推迟BSKE的裁决，并指示选举委员会（Comelec）在最早可行日期举行考试。他说，最高法院以9比5表决形成的多数意见允许将BSKE延期，将其视为一个“次要附带事项”，并将任期设定为5年，属于“严重错误”。Macalintal最初对《共和国法》第12326号提出挑战，该法将考试日期由今年的11月2日推迟至2028年11月13日。Macalintal提交动议后，选举委员会主席George Garcia表示，自原定选举日期过去30天后，选举委员会便不再拥有重新安排考试的授权。Macalintal说，先例表明，应立即采取行动的是选举委员会，而非等待国会介入，正如最高法院在Hagedorn诉众议院案中的裁决一样。他援引该案2025年的判决称：“法院强调，在空缺出现后60天内举行特别选举是选举委员会的一项主要权力和职责，而等待正式的立法声明会造成不必要的延迟。”他说：“我很感谢Garcia主席提出这一立场，因为这增强了我请求最高法院重新审议其立场的决心，并请求就我的部分重新审议动议进行口头辩论。”/mr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary_zh: （北京、首尔=韩联社）韩中首席特派记者金智宪报道：外交部长赵显13日就朝鲜半岛问题呼吁中国发挥建设性作用。中国外交部长王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有改变，并将继续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两位外交部长当天下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，双方就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等共同关心的事项交换了意见，会谈持续3小时。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 한반도의 평화·안정이 한중 양국의 공동 이익임을 강조했고 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위한 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 북한의 대화 복귀 등 한반도 문제에서 중국의 역할을 당부했다. 왕 부장은 이에 대해 답하면서 '비핵화' 표현을 명시적으로 쓰지 않는 최근의 태도를 이어갔지만, 비핵화가 포함되는 기존의 중국 대한반도 정책에 변함이 없다는 입장을 반복했다. 왕 부장은 지난 8월 서울에서 조 장관과 외교장관회담을 벌였을 때도 '한반도 문제에 대한 중국의 입장은 연속적이고 안정적'이라는 취지로 언급한 바 있다. 회담에서 조 장관은 정부가 작년 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 의장국으로서 내주 개최되는 선전 APEC 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 기원한다고 했다. 이어 선전에서 양국 정상 간 교류가 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시키는 중요한 계기가 될 수 있도록 잘 준비해 나가자고 했다. 왕 부장은 한중 관계의 긍정적 흐름이 작년 경주에서 선전으로 이어지고 있음을 평가하면서 이재명 대통령의 선전 APEC 계기 방중을 환영하며 충분한 예우를 갖춰 이번 방문이 성공적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하겠다고 화답했다. 양 장관은 작년과 올해 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문을 통한 한중관계 전면 복원의 흐름이 구체 성과로 나타나고 있음을 평가하고, 내년 수교 35주년을 맞아 양국 국민이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 성과를 지속 창출해 나가기 위한 여러 방안에 대해 논의했다. 특히 한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상 진전을 통해 양국의 수평적·호혜적 경제협력의 기반을 강화해 나가는 한편 양 국민 간 인적교류를 확대하고 우호정서를 증진하기 위한 노력도 강화해 나가자는 데도 의견을 같이 했다. 조 장관은 서해 문제 등 사안에서 한국의 원칙적 입장을 전달했으며 중국 내 한국 국민의 안전과 권익 보호를 위한 중국 정부의 노력도 당부했다. 이와 관련해 양 장관은 이런 사안들이 양국 관계 발전에 걸림돌이 되지 않도록 세심하게 관리해 나가자는 데 공감했다고 외교부가 전했다. 회담의 본격적 시작에 앞서 조 장관은 모두발언을 통해 "한반도 문제는 대한민국의 사활적 이익이며 한반도 평화와 안정은 양국의 공동이익"이라며 "한반도 정세 진전을 위해 양국 간 전략적 소통을 계속 강화해 나가기를 기대한다"고 말했다. 이어 "다음 주 선전에서 양국 정상이 10개월 만에 다시 만나 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시켜 나가는 중요한 계기를 만들 것으로 기대한다"며 "경주에서 시작된 두 정상 간 우정과 신뢰의 이야기가 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 이어지면서 한중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지기를 희망한다"고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난해 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문 이후 한중 관계가 전면 복원의 흐름을 공고히 해왔다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "올해 한중 인적 교류는 1천만명을 돌파할 것으로 예상된다"며 "한중 간 교역도 40% 넘게 증가했다"고 말했다. 이어 "이는 양국 정상 간 전면적 관계 복원에 대한 공동 인식을 이행하기 위해 양국 정부가 긴밀히 소통하며 함께 노력해온 결과"라고 강조했다. 조 장관은 이번 회담을 통해 다음 주 양국 정상의 만남이 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 협의하기를 기대한다고 덧붙였다. 왕 부장은 모두발언에서 "지난해 말과 올해 초 시진핑 국가주석과 이재명 대통령의 성공적인 상호 방문으로 중한 관계가 개선과 발전의 정상 궤도로 돌아왔다"고 평가했다. 이어 "다음 단계의 고위급 접촉을 준비하는 것이 매우 필요하다"며 "내년 중한 수교 35주년을 계기로 양국이 함께 노력해 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 올바른 궤도로 발전시켜 나가야 한다"고 강조했다. 왕 부장은 올해 양국 교역액이 사상 최고치를 기록할 것으로 전망하면서 인적 왕래도 연간 1천만명 수준을 회복할 것으로 기대했다. 그는 다음 주 선전 APEC 정상회의에 이 대통령을 비롯한 여러 회원국 정상이 참석하기로 확정됐다며 한국이 지난해 경주 APEC 정상회의를 성공적으로 개최했다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "중한 양국이 잇따라 APEC 회의를 개최하는 만큼 손을 맞잡고 아시아태평양 공동체 건설을 함께 추진해 역내 공동 발전과 번영을 촉진해야 한다"고 말했다. 왕 부장은 한국이 중국의 APEC 개최 준비에 적극적으로 참여하고 기여한 점도 높이 평가하며 선전 정상회의가 양국 관계에 새로운 동력을 제공할 것이라는 기대를 나타냈다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/13 23:47 송고 2026년11월13일 23시47분 송고 (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 13일 오후 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title_zh: 赵兑烈呼吁中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用；王毅表示政策没有改变（综合）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body_zh: （北京、首尔＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者金智宪报道＝外交部长赵显13日敦促中国在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有变化，并重申将持续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两国外长当日下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，历时3小时，就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等双方共同关心的问题交换了意见。赵部长强调，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合韩中两国的共同利益，并介绍了韩国政府为半岛无核化与和平实现所作的努力，同时敦促中国在朝鲜重返对话等半岛问题上发挥作用。王毅在回应时延续了近来未明确使用“无核化”表述的做法，但再次强调，中国既有的半岛无核化政策没有变化。王毅还表示，去年8月在首尔与赵部长举行外长会谈时曾提及，中国对半岛问题的立场具有连续性和稳定性。会谈中，赵部长表示，作为去年亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议主席国，韩国政府希望下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议取得圆满成功。他接着说，双方应做好充分准备，使两国领导人之间的交流成为推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟发展的重要契机。王毅评价，韩中关系的积极势头正从去年庆州延续至宣城，并表示欢迎李在明总统借APEC会议之机访问中国，将给予充分礼遇，确保此次访问取得成功。两位外长评价，通过去年和今年两国领导人相互进行国事访问所推动的韩中关系全面恢复趋势正在转化为具体成果，并就迎接明年建交35周年、持续为两国国民带来切实成果的多种方案进行了讨论。双方尤其同意，将通过推进韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判，进一步夯实两国平等、互利的经济合作基础，同时加强扩大两国国民之间的人员交流以及促进友好感情的努力。赵部长转达了韩国在黄海问题等议题上的原则立场，并敦促中国政府为保护在中国韩国国民的安全和权益而努力。外交部介绍，围绕这些议题，双方同意将审慎管控，避免其成为两国关系发展的障碍。会谈正式开始前，赵部长在全体发言中表示：“朝鲜半岛问题关系到韩国的切身利益，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”“我们期待韩中两国继续加强战略沟通，为半岛局势取得进展作出贡献。”他接着说：“我们期待下周在宣城，两国领导人时隔10个月再次会晤，并以此为重要契机，推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟。”他还说：“希望从庆州开启的两位领导人之间的友谊与信任故事经由北京延续到宣城，同时期待韩中关系更加亲近。”赵部长评价，去年11月和今年1月两国领导人相互进行国事访问后，韩中关系全面恢复的趋势进一步巩固。他强调：“预计今年韩中人员交流将突破1000万人次，两国之间的贸易额也增长了40%以上。”“这是两国政府为落实两国领导人全面恢复关系的共同共识而紧密沟通、共同努力的结果。”赵部长补充说，希望通过此次会谈协商，推动下周两国领导人会晤取得成功。王毅在全体发言中评价：“去年底和今年初，习近平主席与李在明总统成功进行相互访问，推动中韩关系重回改善与发展的正确轨道。”他接着强调：“为筹备下一阶段的高层接触，必须做好充分准备。”“明年正值中韩建交35周年，两国应以此为契机共同努力，推动全面战略合作伙伴关系沿着正确轨道发展。”王毅预计，今年两国贸易额将创历史新高，人员往来也将恢复到每年1000万人左右的水平。他表示，包括李在明总统在内的多个成员国领导人已确定出席下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议，并评价韩国去年成功举办庆州APEC领导人会议。他表示：“既然韩中两国接连举办APEC会议，两国就应携手并进，共同推进建设亚太命运共同体，促进地区共同发展与繁荣。”王毅还高度评价韩国积极参与并助力中国筹备APEC会议，并期待宣城领导人会议为两国关系提供新动力。图片来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/13 23:47发稿 2026年11月13日23时47分发稿（北京＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者＝13日下午，在中国北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行韩中外长会谈，外交部长赵显、中国外交部长王毅等人出席。2026.11.13. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Friday that peace on the Korean Peninsula serves the shared interests of South Korea and China during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, calling for stronger bilateral communication to advance the situation on the peninsula. The ministerial talks took place in Beijing ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen next week, where President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet. "The Korean Peninsula issue is a vital interest for South Korea, and peace and stability on the peninsula serve the shared interests of both countries," Cho said in his opening remarks. "I hope the two countries will continue to strengthen strategic communication to make progress on the situation on the Korean Peninsula," he added, expressing hope that a meeting between the two leaders in Shenzhen would provide an opportunity to further develop their strategic cooperative partnership. Wang said bilateral relations had returned to a normal track following the leaders' reciprocal visits last year and early this year, stressing the need to maintain high-level exchanges and further develop their strategic partnership. Noting that bilateral trade is expected to reach a record high this year, he expressed hope that people-to-people exchanges would recover to around 10 million annually. With the two countries hosting the APEC summit consecutively, Wang called for joint efforts to promote regional development and prosperity, expressing hope that the upcoming summit would give fresh momentum to bilateral ties. South Korea hosted last year's APEC summit in the southeastern city of Gyeongju. At that time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Before departing for Beijing for a two-day visit earlier in the day, Cho said he and Xi planned to discuss issues that need to be coordinated ahead of the APEC summit, as well as North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks. Other issues on the agenda include pending bilateral matters, such as ways to enhance economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation, as well as Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The talks come amid deepening ties between China and North Korea, following Xi's visit to Pyongyang in June and a series of high-level exchanges between the two countries. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the United States in August. He was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. Inter-Korean relations, however, remain frozen. Pyongyang defines ties with Seoul as those between two hostile states and has rejected the Lee Jae Myung administration's calls for dialogue. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia for the APEC summit, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈在会见王毅期间表示，朝半岛和平符合韩国与中国的共同利益
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国 counterparts 王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛的和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。这场部长级会谈在北京举行，先于下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会；韩国总统李在明和中国国家主席习近平预计将在峰会上会晤。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题是韩国的核心利益，半岛的和平稳定符合两国共同利益。我希望两国继续加强战略沟通，推动朝鲜半岛局势取得进展。”他还表示，希望两国领导人在深圳会晤能为进一步发展战略合作伙伴关系提供机会。王毅表示，在两国领导人去年及今年年初相互访问后，双边关系已回到正常轨道，并强调需要保持高层交往，进一步发展战略伙伴关系。他指出，预计今年双边贸易额将创历史新高，并希望民间交往恢复到每年约1000人次的水平。鉴于两国将连续主办APEC峰会，王毅呼吁共同努力，促进区域发展与繁荣，并希望即将举行的峰会为双边关系注入新的动力。韩国去年在东南部城市庆州主办了APEC峰会。当时，两国外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在促使朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。当天早些时候，在启程前往北京进行为期两天的访问之前，赵显表示，他与习近平计划讨论APEC峰会前需要协调的议题以及与朝鲜有关的事务，包括举行美朝会谈的可能性。议程中的其他议题还包括尚未解决的双边事务，例如加强经济文化交流与合作的办法，以及黄海上的中国设施。会谈是在中国与朝鲜关系日益密切的背景下举行的。此前，习近平于6月访问平壤，两国之间进行了一系列高层交往。8月习近平访问美国时，王毅陪同出访。上个月，朝鲜最高领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东时，王毅也在场。然而，朝韩关系仍陷于僵局。平壤将首尔关系定义为两个敌对国家之间的关系，并拒绝李在明政府提出的对话倡议。随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赴亚洲出席APEC峰会，外界一直在猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会晤，因为这位美国总统已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推进相关努力表示不确定。这位部长说：“我认为中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加APEC峰会会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”一名韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在APEC峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后进行接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国产业部表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张局势的背景下，韩国政府周五连续第五个周期维持燃油产品最高限价不变。自6月26日下调后，政府已将最高限价维持在当前水平20周。政府于3月中旬推出燃油最高限价，旨在稳定因美伊战争在中东引发的供应链中断而出现波动的国内燃油价格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home
