Make VnExpress a preferred source to prioritise our updates in your Google search results U.S. Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott sent letters on Thursday to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Nvidia's former CEO Jensen Huang asking them to testify over recent developments at the company. Huang stepped down from Nvidia, one of the major engines behind the AI boom, after reports of a romantic relationship with a businesswoman named Alice Huang whom U.S. authorities suspect of spying for the Chinese government. In addition, a growing number of lawmakers have criticized Lutnick for the administration's refusal to add dozens of Chinese companies to a key U.S. trade blacklist, and over whether the government was properly overseeing Nvidia's exports to China. "Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive U.S. technology," Scott wrote on X. "I am requesting that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify before the Senate Banking Committee." Jensen Huang (L) and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at the White House in July 2026. Photo by Reuters Spokespeople for Huang and Lutnick could not immediately be reached. Scott said he would consider subpoenaing Huang if he does not voluntarily appear. "The American people deserve answers," Scott said. Senior White House officials were separately discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation said, as the desire to take action rose across Washington. Separately, the chairs of three House committees, including the head of the Foreign Affairs panel, Brian Mast, wrote to Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter, requiring them to appear for closed-door transcribed interviews on Dec. 1 and 2, respectively, or face subpoenas to compel their appearances. "There are clear national security concerns that need to be addressed immediately," Mast, as well as House China Select Committee Chair John Moolenaar and House Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford, wrote in the letter. They also asked Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler to testify at a Dec. 3 hearing. China has denied Alice Huang is a spy and U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Thursday that the Justice Department has not yet reached a conclusion on whether she is or not. Alice Huang could not be reached for comment

美国参议院银行委员会主席Tim Scott于周四致函商务部长Howard Lutnick和Nvidia前首席执行官黄仁勋，要求他们就公司近期 developments 出庭作证。黄仁勋已从Nvidia卸任；该公司是人工智能热潮背后的主要推动力量之一。此前有报道称，他与一名名叫Alice Huang的女商人存在浪漫关系，美国当局怀疑她为中国政府从事间谍活动。

此外，越来越多议员批评Lutnick，指责本届政府拒绝将数十家中国企业列入美国一份关键贸易黑名单，并质疑政府是否妥善监管Nvidia对华出口。

Scott在X上写道：“最近的报道引发了有关我国国家安全以及保护美国敏感技术的严重关切。我要求Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋和商务部长Howard Lutnick到参议院银行委员会作证。”

2026年7月，黄仁勋（左）和商务部长Howard Lutnick在白宫。Reuters摄影

记者暂时无法联系到黄仁勋和Lutnick的发言人。Scott表示，如果黄仁勋不主动出席，他将继续考虑传唤他。

Scott说：“美国人民有权得到答案。”

两名知情人士表示，随着华盛顿要求采取行动的呼声日益高涨，白宫高级官员正另行讨论是否应迫使Lutnick离职。

此外，众议院三个委员会的主席——其中包括外交事务委员会主席Brian Mast——分别致函黄仁勋和Nvidia总法律顾问Tim Teter，要求他们于12月1日和2日分别出席闭门且有文字记录的访谈，否则将收到强制其出席的传票。

Mast、众议院中国特别委员会主席John Moolenaar以及众议院情报委员会主席Rick Crawford在信中写道：“目前存在一些需要立即处理的明确国家安全问题。”

他们还要求商务部副部长Jeffrey Kessler在12月3日的听证会上作证。

中国方面否认Alice Huang是间谍。美国总检察长Todd Blanche周四表示，司法部尚未就是否为她间谍作出结论。记者未能联系到Alice Huang置评

https://punchng.com/seplat-fixes-q3-divi.body: Seplat Energy Plc has announced the applicable foreign exchange rate for calculating the naira equivalent of its third-quarter 2026 interim and special dividends. In a corporate disclosure issued on Thursday from its offices in Lagos and London, the dual-listed energy company confirmed that shareholders who elected to receive their payouts in naira, or whose default currency is naira, will have their dividends converted at a rate of N1,358.34 to one United States dollar. According to the statement signed by Chief Financial Officer Eleanor Adaralegbe, the conversion figure aligns with Seplat Energy’s established dividend payment procedures and reflects the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market rate published by the Central Bank of Nigeria on 11 November 2026. The company advised shareholders seeking clarity on default currency rules to consult its earlier regulatory announcement published on 29 October 2026, via its corporate website. The exchange rate disclosure follows Seplat Energy’s strong operational and financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, which prompted the board to declare a combined Q3 payout comprising an interim dividend and a special dividend. That distribution was underpinned by growth in revenue and free cash flow amid higher onshore and offshore production, with the qualification and record date closing on 12 November 2026, ahead of electronic dividend disbursement scheduled for on or around 27 November 2026. Seplat Energy, which trades on the Premium Board of the Nigerian Exchange Limited and the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, “is Nigeria’s leading indigenous energy company” and operates a broad portfolio of onshore and shallow-water assets across the Niger Delta, alongside three gas processing plants and interests in three export terminals. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: Makinde’s campaign group demands probe of Tinubu’s N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: The presidential campaign organisation of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has called for an open investigation into the federal government’s reported commitment of about 340 million barrels of Nigeria’s future crude oil production to secure loans estimated at N11.2 trillion.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 奥约州州长塞伊·马金德的总统竞选组织呼吁，对联邦政府据报承诺以尼日利亚未来约3.4亿桶原油产量换取估计11.2万亿奈拉贷款一事进行公开调查。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The presidential campaign organisation of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has called for an open investigation into the federal government’s reported commitment of about 340 million barrels of Nigeria’s future crude oil production to secure loans estimated at N11.2 trillion. The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of committing future oil revenues to debt obligations without sufficient public disclosure, warning that the arrangements could constrain Nigeria’s finances for years. In a statement on Thursday, the organisation’s Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Ihediwa, said the reported loans were obtained through four financing arrangements: Project Gazelle, Project Gazelle II, Project Leopard and Project Leopard II. It demanded that the federal government disclose the identities of the lenders, the amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees and repayment schedules, as well as the precise volume of crude oil committed under each arrangement. “President Tinubu should give a public explanation on the loan arrangements,” the organisation said. It also called for the disclosure of the pricing formula for the crude oil deliveries, the outstanding liabilities being refinanced and the full financial implications of the transactions. The campaign organisation described the reported arrangements as fiscally reckless, arguing that the government was committing future oil revenues to finance present expenditure without demonstrating corresponding investments in industrial development, infrastructure and improved living standards. It warned that fixed repayment obligations could limit Nigeria’s ability to benefit fully from increases in international crude oil prices, potentially reducing future government revenues and restricting the country’s fiscal flexibility. The organisation also recalled its earlier warning that Mr Tinubu was leading Nigeria towards what it likened to the financial predicament of 19th-century Egypt under Khedive Ismail. It said excessive foreign borrowing and spending under the Egyptian ruler eventually contributed to British occupation of the country in 1882. “A nation that repeatedly pledges its future revenues to finance present excesses risks surrendering its economic independence,” the campaign organisation said. The organisation said the reported borrowing arrangements were particularly concerning amid the economic difficulties facing Nigerians, including hunger, poorly funded public hospitals and deteriorating highways. It argued that commodity-backed financing arrangements should be subjected to public scrutiny and demonstrate clear economic returns and measurable benefits to citizens. “We therefore task the National Assembly to subject these financing arrangements to rigorous legislative scrutiny including an open public hearing,” the campaign organisation stated. It said such a hearing should establish the full extent of Nigeria’s crude oil commitments and assess the implications for Federation Account revenues and the country’s long-term fiscal sustainability. “Economic success is not measured by borrowing or debt restructuring, but by tangible gains in production, jobs, infrastructure, industry and living standards,” it said. PREMIUM TIMES reported Thursday how Governor Makinde, who is contesting next year’s presidential election on the platform of the Allied People’s Movement (APM), criticised the handling of the economy by President Bola Tinubu who is seeking reelection as the presidential candidate of the All Progressives Congress. Mr Makinde, who will complete his second and final term as governor in May 2027, recalled supporting Mr Tinubu to win the 2023 presidential election. He said he withdrew his support for Mr Tinubu and decided to vie for the presidency himself after being disappointed by the president’s performance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队要求调查蒂努布以原油为抵押的112亿奈拉贷款
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 奥约州州长塞yi·马金德总统竞选组织呼吁对联邦政府据报承诺动用尼日利亚未来约3.4亿桶原油产量以获取估计达11.2万亿奈拉贷款一事展开公开调查。马金德—达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）指责博拉·蒂努布总统政府未经充分公开披露便将未来石油收入用于偿债，警告称这些安排可能在未来多年限制尼日利亚的财政。该组织战略传播主任理查德·伊赫迪瓦周四在一份声明中表示，据报这些贷款通过四项融资安排取得：瞪羚项目、瞪羚二号项目、猎豹项目和猎豹二号项目。该组织要求联邦政府披露贷款机构名称、借款金额、利率、管理费、还款时间表，以及每项安排所承诺的原油具体数量。该组织表示：“蒂努布总统应就这些贷款安排作出公开解释。”它还要求披露原油交付的定价公式、正在再融资的未偿债务，以及这些交易造成的全部财务影响。该竞选组织称，据报这些安排在财政上极其轻率，并认为政府正将未来石油收入用于为当前支出融资，却未能在产业发展、基础设施建设和改善生活水平方面作出相应投入。它警告称，固定的偿债义务可能限制尼日利亚充分受益于国际原油价格上涨的能力，潜在后果包括未来政府收入减少以及国家财政灵活性受限。该组织还重申此前警告，称蒂努布先生正把尼日利亚带向其所说的、类似19世纪埃及在伊斯梅尔帕夏治下所处的财政困境。该组织表示，在这位埃及统治者执政时期，过度对外借款和支出最终促成了英国于1882年占领该国。该竞选组织称：“一个反复抵押未来收入来为当前过度支出融资的国家，有可能丧失经济独立。”该组织表示，在尼日利亚民众面临饥饿、公共医院资金不足和公路状况恶化等经济困难之际，据报这些借款安排尤其令人担忧。它认为，以商品为担保的融资安排应接受公众监督，并证明具有明确的经济回报和可衡量的公民受益。该竞选组织声明：“因此，我们责成国民议会对这些融资安排进行严格立法审查，包括举行公开听证会。”它表示，此类听证会应查明尼日利亚原油承诺的全部范围，并评估其对联邦账户收入和国家长期财政可持续性的影响。该组织说：“经济成功不是以借款或债务重组来衡量的，而是以生产、就业、基础设施、工业和生活水平的切实改善来衡量。”《Premium Times》周四报道，马金德州长将以人民联盟运动（APM）的政纲参加明年的总统选举。他批评了寻求以全进步大会候选人身份连任的博拉·蒂努布总统的经济治理方式。马金德先生将于2027年5月完成其第二个也是最后一个州长任期。他回顾称，自己曾支持蒂努布先生赢得2023年总统选举。他说，在对总统的表现感到失望后，他撤回了对蒂努布先生的支持，并决定亲自竞选总统

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.summary_zh: 拟议中的《自然资源收入管理法》将取代现行《石油收入管理法》。现行法律主要关注该国石油和天然气行业的收入。财政部长在解释制定新法律的必要性时表示，现行法律适用范围有限，仅涵盖石油收入，导致其他重要自然资源未被纳入统一、全面的收入管理框架。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.body: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has announced plans to introduce a new law to regulate revenues from Ghana’s natural resources, including oil, gold, lithium and bauxite. The proposed Natural Resource Revenue Management Act will replace the existing Petroleum Revenue Management Act, which focuses primarily on revenues from the country’s oil and gas sector. The new legislation forms part of a series of financial management reforms the government plans to implement in 2027 to strengthen accountability, improve the management of public resources and ensure that natural resource wealth benefits both current and future generations. Presenting the 2027 Budget and the New Economy Agenda in Parliament, Dr Forson said the government would also establish a Ghana Sovereign Wealth Fund and introduce a Loans Act to address longstanding weaknesses in public financial management. "As a complement to the revenue and expenditure measures, Government will implement the following reforms to address long-standing weaknesses in how we manage our public resources," he told Parliament. He said the three measures were intended to establish stronger financial management systems and ensure that the country's public resources were managed responsibly. "Together, these reforms will make sound financial management a lasting feature of our economy," Dr Forson stated. Explaining the need for the new legislation, the Finance Minister said the existing law was limited in scope as it covered only petroleum revenues, leaving other important natural resources outside a single comprehensive revenue management framework. "Government will introduce a Natural Resource Revenue Management Act to replace the Petroleum Revenue Management Act," he announced. "The current law covers only oil revenues. The new law will bring revenues from oil, gold, lithium, bauxite and all other extractive resources under one clear and accountable framework, for the benefit of present and future generations," he said. The proposed legislation is expected to provide a unified framework for managing revenues from the country's extractive resources, strengthen oversight and establish clearer guidelines for allocating and using the funds. Dr Forson also disclosed that the government intended to channel natural resource revenues towards major national infrastructure projects. He cited the use of oil and mineral royalties to support the construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway as an example of how proceeds from the country's natural resources could be invested in critical infrastructure. "We have already used oil and mineral royalties to fund Ghana's first expressway, the Accra-Kumasi Expressway," he told Parliament. "Building on that experience, our natural resource revenues will only be directed to major national infrastructure projects," he added
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.title_zh: 政府将以更广泛的自然资源法律取代《石油收入管理法》
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士宣布，计划出台一项新法律，规范加纳来自石油、黄金、锂和铝土矿等自然资源的收入。拟议中的《自然资源收入管理法》将取代现行《石油收入管理法》，后者主要关注该国石油和天然气行业的收入。新立法是政府计划于2027年实施的一系列财务管理改革的一部分，旨在加强问责、改善公共资源管理，并确保自然资源财富惠及当代和子孙后代。福尔松博士在议会提交2027年预算和《新经济议程》时表示，政府还将设立加纳主权财富基金，并出台《贷款法》，以解决公共财务管理中长期存在的薄弱环节。他告诉议会：“作为收入和支出措施的补充，政府将实施以下改革，以解决我们管理公共资源时长期存在的薄弱环节。”他说，这三项措施旨在建立更完善的财务管理制度，并确保国家公共资源得到负责任的管理。福尔松博士表示：“这些改革结合起来，将使稳健的财务管理成为我国经济的一项持久特征。”财政部长在解释新立法的必要性时表示，现行法律范围有限，仅涵盖石油收入，导致其他重要自然资源未被纳入统一、完善的收入管理体系。他宣布：“政府将出台《自然资源收入管理法》，取代《石油收入管理法》。”他说：“现行法律仅涵盖石油收入。新法律将把石油、黄金、锂、铝土矿及其他所有采矿资源的收入纳入一个明确且问责有力的统一框架，惠及当代和子孙后代。”拟议立法预计将为管理该国采矿资源收入提供统一框架，加强监督，并为资金分配和使用确立更明确的指引。福尔松博士还透露，政府打算将自然资源收入投入重大国家基础设施项目。他以利用石油和矿产权利金支持修建阿克拉—库马西高速公路为例，说明如何将国家自然资源所得投资于关键基础设施。他告诉议会：“我们已经利用石油和矿产权利金，为加纳首条高速公路阿克拉—库马西高速公路提供资金。”他补充道：“在此基础上，我们的自然资源收入将专门用于重大国家基础设施项目。”

Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson announced the allocation during his presentation of the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy to Parliament on Thursday. "We have allocated GH¢782 million to the Ministry of Sports and Recreation to support the development of sports and the people who participate in it," Dr Forson told Parliament. The allocation comes alongside a series of proposed interventions aimed at strengthening Ghana's sports infrastructure, improving grassroots participation and creating sustainable pathways for athlete development. Among the major projects outlined in the budget is the construction of 10 new multipurpose sports stadia in underserved regions, with seating capacities ranging from 5,000 to 12,000. Government also intends to complete the National Sports Policy and its implementation framework, finalise regulations under the Ghana Sports Fund Act, 2025 (Act 1159), and review the Sports Act, 2016 (Act 934). The budget further outlines plans to strengthen structured school and grassroots sports programmes to improve talent identification and athlete progression. Ghana is also expected to begin preparations towards hosting the 2027 CAF Under-20 Africa Cup of Nations, a 12-nation competition expected to create opportunities in sports tourism, hospitality and transportation. The GH¢782 million allocation will therefore support a wide range of sports development priorities, although the budget statement's headline figure does not, on its own, establish how much will go towards each programme. Further details on the distribution of the allocation, including funding for infrastructure, national teams, athlete welfare and the organisation of sporting competitions, will be important in assessing its impact on the sector

https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.body: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says the government has secured about US$3 billion for the construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway, with the funds held in a dedicated project account at the Bank of Ghana. Presenting the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy to Parliament on Thursday, November 12, 2026, he said the account contained US$2.2 billion and GH¢9 billion as of November 11. “As of yesterday, 11th November 2026, the project account at the Bank of Ghana held US$2.2 billion and GH¢9 billion, together equivalent to about US$3 billion. The money is in the safe custody of the Bank of Ghana,” he said. Dr Forson said the funds had been secured ahead of the commencement of construction, describing the development as the fulfilment of a government commitment. “Before actual construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway begins, the money is ready. We promised to secure the financing. We have done so. Promise made, promise fulfilled,” he said. The Finance Minister said detailed feasibility studies, engineering designs, costing, and environmental and social assessments had been completed. He said the engineer’s construction estimate for the 198.7-kilometre, six-lane expressway now stood at US$2.98 billion. According to him, the estimate includes contingencies, supervision, land acquisition and compensation. Dr Forson said the revised estimate was more than US$1 billion below an initial projection of about US$4 billion. The government has issued tenders through an international competitive tendering process, with the exercise expected to be completed by the end of 2026. Dr Forson said the final contract prices would be determined through the competitive process. He added that all contract awards would be subject to commitment control approval and value-for-money assessments, in accordance with procurement and public financial management laws. The government has dedicated the Annual Budget Funding Amount (ABFA) from petroleum revenues, together with mineral royalties, to the Accra-Kumasi Expressway project. The project is expected to connect more than 10 million people. With the tendering process expected to conclude by the end of 2026, the next major step will be the award of contracts and commencement of construction
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.title_zh: 政府为阿克拉—库马西高速公路筹得约30亿美元
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士表示，政府已为阿克拉—库马西高速公路建设筹集约30亿美元，相关资金存放于加纳银行的项目专用账户中。2026年11月12日星期四，他向议会提交《2027年预算声明和经济政策》时说，截至11月11日，该账户内有22亿美元和90亿塞地亚。“截至昨日，即2026年11月11日，加纳银行的项目专用账户内有22亿美元和90亿塞地亚，合计约合30亿美元。这笔资金由加纳银行妥善保管。”他说。福尔松博士表示，政府已在高速公路动工前落实资金，并将这一进展视为兑现政府承诺。“在阿克拉—库马西高速公路正式动工之前，资金已经就绪。我们承诺落实融资，现在已经做到。作出承诺，兑现承诺。”他说。财政部长表示，详细的可行性研究、工程设计、成本核算以及环境和社会评估均已完成。他说，工程师编制的这条全长198.7公里、双向六车道高速公路的施工估算目前为29.8亿美元。据他介绍，该估算包括应急费用、监理、土地征收和补偿。福尔松博士表示，修订后的估算比最初预计的约40亿美元低逾10亿美元。政府已通过国际竞争性招标程序发出招标文件，预计将于2026年底前完成。福尔松博士说，最终合同价格将通过竞争程序确定。他补充称，所有合同授予都将按照采购法和公共财政管理法接受承诺控制审批及物有所值评估。政府已从石油收入中划拨年度预算资金额（ABFA），并连同矿产权利金一并用于阿克拉—库马西高速公路项目。该项目预计将连接逾1000万人。随着招标程序预计于2026年底结束，下一主要步骤将是授予合同并启动建设

https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.summary_zh: 信息与国家导向部长Mohammed Idris呼吁尼日利亚人在2027年再次选举总统Bola Tinubu，称政府需要更多时间解决国家面临的经济困境和生活成本上涨问题。部长承认，尼日利亚人对当前经济困境、贫困加剧和饥饿问题有理由感到担忧，但表示政府改革带来的益处需要时间才能体现在民众生活中。
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.body: The Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, has appealed to Nigerians to re-elect President Bola Tinubu in 2027, saying the administration needs more time to address the country’s economic hardship and rising cost of living. Idris made the appeal on Thursday during the APC’s 2027 presidential and governorship campaign flag-off at the Minna Trade Fair Complex, Niger State. The minister acknowledged that Nigerians had reasons to be concerned about the prevailing economic hardship, rising poverty and hunger but said the benefits of the government’s reforms would take time to reflect in people’s lives. “I appeal for the understanding of Nigerians. President Bola Tinubu means well for Nigerians. Let’s give him more time to complete the good things he has already started,” Idris said. He also urged Niger State residents to re-elect Governor Mohammed Bago, saying his administration’s achievements had made a significant impact on the state in its first term. Wear Nigerian fabrics, eat local food, Soludo urges citizens Tinubu pledges more projects as Okpebholo marks two years 2027: Kebbi farmers’ group endorses Tinubu, Idris Idris called on eligible voters to support APC candidates at all levels in next year’s elections, saying doing so would enable them to enjoy the dividends of democracy. In his remarks, Bago assured Tinubu of 100 per cent votes for the APC in Niger State. The governor, who promised that his second term would be more rewarding, urged residents to turn out en masse to vote for APC candidates in the presidential, governorship, senatorial and House of Representatives elections. Dignitaries at the campaign flag-off included the North-Central Zonal Vice-Chairman of the APC, Mu’azu Rijau, who represented the party’s National Chairman, Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda; former Nigerian Ambassador to South Africa, Abdullahi Idris; and former Niger State Deputy Governor, Ahmed Musa Ibeto, among others. Chika Otuchikere
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.title_zh: 2027年：再次选举Tinubu，以完成经济改革
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.body_zh: 信息与国家Orientation部长穆罕默德·伊德里斯呼吁尼日利亚人在2027年再次选举总统博拉·蒂努布，称本届政府需要更多时间来应对该国严峻的经济困境和不断上涨的生活成本。星期四，伊德里斯在尼日尔州明纳贸易博览会综合大楼举行的APC 2027年总统和州长竞选启动活动上发出这一呼吁。部长承认，尼日利亚人有理由对当前普遍存在的经济困难、贫困加剧和饥饿问题感到担忧，但表示政府改革带来的益处需要时间才能体现在民众生活中。伊德里斯说：“我呼吁尼日利亚人给予理解。博拉·蒂努布总统是真心为尼日利亚人着想。让我们给他更多时间，让他完成已经启动的美好事业。”他还敦促尼日尔州居民再次选举州长穆罕默德·巴戈，称其政府在首个任期内取得的成就已对该州产生了重大影响。索卢多敦促公民穿着尼日利亚传统 fabrics、食用本地食品；蒂努布承诺推出更多项目；奥克佩布洛就任两周年之际，2027年：凯比农民团体支持蒂努布。伊德里斯呼吁符合条件的选民在明年各级选举中支持APC候选人，表示这样将使他们享受民主的成果。巴戈在讲话中向蒂努布保证，APC将在尼日尔州获得100%的选票。这位州长曾承诺第二个任期将带来更多回报，并敦促居民大批前往投票，在总统、州长、参议员和众议员选举中支持APC候选人。竞选启动活动上的嘉宾包括APC中北部地区副主席穆阿祖·里贾乌，他代表党全国主席普罗夫·嫩塔韦·伊尔瓦特达；尼日利亚前驻南非大使阿卜杜拉希·伊德里斯；尼日尔州前副州长艾哈迈德·穆萨·伊贝托等。奇卡·奥图奇凯雷

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Kim Jong-sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea, made the remarks in a statement carried by the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). "Arms build-up of the U.S. and its vassal allies for seizing a maritime edge in the Asia-Pacific region has emerged as a new dangerous factor seriously disturbing regional peace and security," Kim said. He described nuclear submarine programs in South Korea, Japan and Australia as the "detailed implementation" of a new U.S. security strategy aimed at "securing the maritime hegemony." "This has become a root cause of seriously undermining the strategic balance in the region and sparking off a new arms race," he claimed. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: [EXPLAINER] Why Korea's mandatory tender offer plan is drawing global scrutiny
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: The proposed revival of Korea's mandatory tender offer system, abolished in 1998 following the Asian financial crisis, has reignited debate nearly three decades later. Under the bill pending in the National Assembly, a buyer taking control of a company would have to purchase enough shares through a public tender offer to raise its ownership to at least 50 percent plus one share. The mandatory tender offer system is intended to address this imbalance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国拟恢复强制要约收购制度。该制度在亚洲金融危机后于1998年被废止，如今近30年后，这一提议再次引发讨论。根据国民议会正在审议的法案，控制一家公司的买方必须通过公开要约收购购买足够数量的股份，使其持股比例至少达到50%再加一股。强制要约收购制度旨在解决这种失衡问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The proposed revival of Korea's mandatory tender offer system, abolished in 1998 following the Asian financial crisis, has reignited debate nearly three decades later. The idea behind the system is simple: When someone buys a company, smaller shareholders should have a chance to sell their shares at the same price as the company's largest shareholder. Under the bill pending in the National Assembly, a buyer taking control of a company would have to purchase enough shares through a public tender offer to raise its ownership to at least 50 percent plus one share. The goal is to protect minority shareholders, particularly retail investors, who could otherwise miss out on the higher prices paid in corporate takeovers. Here's why the rule matters: Imagine Company A wants to take over Company B. Company B's largest shareholder, Kim, owns 40 percent of its shares, while smaller shareholders own the remaining 60 percent. Company A offers to buy Kim's entire stake at a price above the current market price. By acquiring Kim's 40 percent stake, Company A gains control of Company B. Kim walks away with a premium, but the other shareholders, who collectively own a larger stake in the company, get no such deal. They are left holding shares that they can only sell at market price. The mandatory tender offer system is intended to address this imbalance. But ironically, critics say the proposed rule could still leave minority shareholders at a disadvantage. Two prominent international corporate governance groups — the International Corporate Governance Network (ICGN) and the Asian Corporate Governance Association (ACGA) — recently sent letters to the National Assembly calling for changes to the proposal. Their main concern is how many shares minority shareholders would actually be able to sell. Consider the same example, but suppose Company B has just 100 shares in total. Company A buys Kim's 40 shares. Under the proposed rule, it would then need to buy only 11 more shares from other shareholders to bring its ownership to 51 shares — just over half the company. That means the remaining shareholders, who originally owned 60 shares between them, would get to sell only 11 shares in total through the mandatory offer. The other 49 shares would remain in their hands. In other words, Kim still gets to sell all his shares at a premium, while minority shareholders get to sell only a fraction of theirs. If a controlling shareholder can sell their entire stake at a higher price, they say, minority shareholders should have the same opportunity. They are calling for rules that would allow minority shareholders to sell all their shares, rather than just enough to bring the buyer's stake above 50 percent
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: [解读] 韩国强制要约收购方案为何引发全球关注
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国拟恢复强制要约收购制度。该制度在亚洲金融危机后于1998年被废除，如今近三十年过去，重启该制度的提议再次引发讨论。这项制度的基本理念很简单：有人收购一家公司时，小股东应有机会以与该公司最大股东相同的价格出售所持股份。根据韩国国会审议中的法案，控制一家公司的收购方必须通过公开要约收购购买足够多的股份，使其持股比例至少达到50%外加一股。其目的是保护少数股东，尤其是散户，否则他们在企业并购中可能无法获得支付给其他股东的高价。这项规则为何重要？假设A公司想收购B公司。B公司的最大股东Kim持有40%的股份，其他小股东合计持有其余60%。A公司提出以高于当前市价的价格购买Kim的全部持股。通过收购Kim持有的40%股份，A公司取得对B公司的控制权。Kim获得溢价离场，但合计持股比例更高的其他股东却无法获得同样的交易条件。他们手中剩余的股份只能按市场价格出售。强制要约收购制度正是为了解决这种失衡。然而颇具讽刺意味的是，批评者称，拟议规则仍可能使少数股东处于不利地位。国际公司治理网络（ICGN）和亚洲公司治理协会（ACGA）这两个知名国际公司治理组织最近致函韩国国会，要求修改该提案。它们主要关注的是少数股东实际能够出售多少股份。仍以刚才的例子为例，假设B公司总共只有100股。A公司买下Kim持有的40股。按照拟议规则，A公司随后只需再从其他股东手中购买11股，就能将持股比例提高至51股，即略高于公司一半。这意味着，原本合计持有60股的其余股东，只能通过强制要约合计出售11股，其余49股仍将留在他们手中。换言之，Kim仍可按溢价出售全部股份，而少数股东却只能出售自己所持股份的一小部分。两组织表示，如果控股股东能够按更高价格出售全部持股，少数股东也应享有同样的机会。它们呼吁制定相关规则，使少数股东能够出售全部股份，而不是仅仅出售足以使收购方持股比例超过50%的股份数量

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Korean Peninsula issues may be sidelined as other crises take priority: analysts A summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un appears unlikely at next week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) gathering in Shenzhen, China, a Cheong Wa Dae official and security analysts said Thursday, despite Trump’s earlier talk of a potential meeting. 3 U.S. midterm elections have weakened Trump’s momentum for unconventional diplomatic initiatives such as a meeting with Kim.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 分析人士称，随着其他危机成为优先事项，朝鲜半岛问题可能遭搁置。青瓦台一名官员和安全分析人士周四表示，尽管特朗普此前曾谈及可能举行会晤，但在下周于中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）会议上，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩会晤似乎不太可能。美国中期选举削弱了特朗普推动会晤金正恩等非常规外交倡议的动力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Korean Peninsula issues may be sidelined as other crises take priority: analysts A summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un appears unlikely at next week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) gathering in Shenzhen, China, a Cheong Wa Dae official and security analysts said Thursday, despite Trump’s earlier talk of a potential meeting. The assessment comes as the Republican Party’s sweeping losses in the Nov. 3 U.S. midterm elections have weakened Trump’s momentum for unconventional diplomatic initiatives such as a meeting with Kim. Pressing international issues are also expected to dominate any talks involving the U.S. on the sidelines of APEC, including a possible one-on-one meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and three-way talks that would also involve Russian President Vladimir Putin. “We see little possibility of North Korea participating in multilateral events on occasions such as APEC, and little possibility of U.S.-North Korea contact taking place on that occasion,” the Cheong Wa Dae official said during a press briefing. Yang Moo-jin, former president of the University of North Korean Studies, voiced a similar view, ruling out a formal summit while leaving open a slim chance of a brief encounter. “The possibility of a summit around APEC period is zero,” Yang said. “As for an encounter, chances are not high either, but even a 1 percent possibility is still a possibility, so preparations are necessary.” Kwak Jin-o, a research professor at Pai Chai University, said a trip to China by the North Korean leader for a possible meeting with Trump would require preparations well in advance, suggesting it is already too late to arrange the summit. “For Kim Jong-un to make a move, preparations should already have been made,” he said. Moon Chung-in, a professor emeritus at Yonsei University, also pointed to the absence of groundwork, along with Pyongyang’s lingering distrust following the collapse of the 2019 Hanoi summit. “For a summit to take place, Washington would need to appoint a special envoy, establish preliminary contacts, set an agenda and form a task force to support the negotiations,” Moon said. “None of these preparations appear to be underway.” Moon dismissed speculation that Kim might agree to a spontaneous meeting, arguing that the North Korean leader would demand concrete incentives in exchange for curbing nuclear activities. “Kim will not come out just for a showcase. He still has the trauma of Hanoi,” he said. Bureaucratic considerations within North Korea's foreign ministry are another reason Moon sees little possibility of such a meeting. “Former Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho was reportedly purged following the Hanoi summit’s collapse. Even though Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui wields considerable power, she would be reluctant to take such a risk without assurances of a successful outcome,” Moon said. The prospect of a Trump-Kim meeting drew attention after The Wall Street Journal reported on Aug. 18 that Trump was seeking talks with Kim, potentially during his November trip to China. Trump said the next day that he expected to meet Kim before the year’s end. Expectations faded on Oct. 19, however, when Trump said “I don’t know” about a possible meeting in China, with the Republic Party’s Nov. 3 midterms defeat further dimming hopes. Questions remain over how much attention issues on the Korean Peninsula will receive during the APEC gathering. The Cheong Wa Dae official said Seoul is closely following reports of a possible U.S.-China-Russia summit and communicating with relevant countries. “We cannot rule out the possibility of issues concerning the Korean Peninsula being discussed, so we are closely following the situation and maintaining the necessary communication with relevant countries,” he said. Analysts, however, were skeptical that the peninsula would feature prominently, given competing priorities such as nuclear arms control and the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine. “I do not see much possibility of issues concerning the Korean Peninsula being discussed in depth, although I would not rule out a passing reference to peace and stability on the peninsula,” Yang said. Moon also said Trump’s likely focus on resolving the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran could overshadow North Korea, further reducing Pyongyang’s willingness to engage. Kwak similarly expected any discussions to remain broad, potentially limited to denuclearization, and doubted Seoul would play a central role given Pyongyang’s opposition to its involvement. “South Korea’s role is important, but bringing South Korea into the discussion would draw objections from North Korea,” he said. Korea Times reporter Kim Bo-kyoung contributed to this article
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 特朗普与金正恩在APEC会晤的可能性变得很小
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
随着其他危机成为优先事项，朝鲜半岛问题可能被边缘化：分析人士
青瓦台一名官员和安全分析人士周四表示，尽管特朗普此前曾提及可能举行会晤，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩似乎不太可能在中国深圳举行的下周亚太经济合作组织（APEC）会议上举行峰会。
这一评估正值共和党在11月3日美国中期选举中惨败，削弱了特朗普推动非常规外交倡议的势头，其中包括与金正恩会晤。
预计，涉及美国的任何APEC会议期间双边或多边会谈，都将被紧迫的国际议题主导，包括可能与中国国家主席习近平举行的单独会晤，以及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京参与的三方会谈。
青瓦台官员在新闻发布会上说：“我们认为，朝鲜参加APEC等场合的多边活动的可能性极小，美朝接触在那个场合发生的可能性也极小。”
朝鲜大学前校长杨慕真表达了类似看法，认为正式峰会不可能举行，但为短暂接触留下了一丝可能。
杨说：“在APEC前后举行峰会的可能性为零。至于接触，可能性也不高，但哪怕只有1%的可能，也仍然是一种可能，因此有必要做好准备。”
培材大学研究教授郭振浩说，朝鲜领导人赴中国与特朗普可能举行会晤，需要提前做好充分准备，这表明现在安排峰会已经太迟。
他说：“要金正恩采取行动，就应该已经完成相关准备。”
延世大学名誉教授文重仁也指出，由于2019年河内峰会破裂后平壤方面仍存疑虑，相关前期工作尚未完成。
文说：“要举行峰会，华盛顿需要任命特使、建立初步联系、制定议程，并成立支持谈判的任务小组。这些准备工作似乎都没有进行。”
文否定了金正恩可能同意临时会晤的猜测，认为这位朝鲜领导人会以限制核活动为条件，要求具体回报。
他说：“金正恩不会只是为了作秀而露面。他仍未摆脱河内峰会的创伤。”
文认为，朝鲜外务省的内部行政考量也是他看不出此次会晤可能性极小的另一个原因。
他说：“据报道，前外相李容浩在河内峰会破裂后被清洗。尽管外长崔善姬掌握相当大的权力，但若没有确保取得成功的保证，她也不愿冒这样的风险。”
《华尔街日报》8月18日报道称，特朗普正寻求与金正恩会谈，并可能于11月访问中国期间举行会谈，此后，特朗普与金正恩会晤的前景受到关注。
特朗普次日表示，预计年底前会与金正恩会面。
然而，10月19日，特朗普谈及可能在中国举行的会晤时表示“我不知道”，共和党的11月3日中选惨败又进一步削弱了有关希望。
朝鲜半岛问题在APEC会议期间会受到多大关注，仍存疑问。
青瓦台官员表示，首尔正在密切关注有关可能举行的美中俄峰会的报道，并与相关国家进行沟通。
他说：“我们不能排除讨论朝鲜半岛相关问题的可能，因此正密切跟踪局势，并与相关国家保持必要沟通。”
不过，鉴于核军控以及中东和乌克兰战争等议题相互竞争，分析人士怀疑朝鲜半岛不会成为会议重点。
杨说：“我看不出有关朝鲜半岛的问题得到深入讨论的可能性有多大，但也不能排除有人顺带提及半岛的和平与稳定。”
文还表示，特朗普可能把重点放在解决乌克兰和伊朗的冲突上，从而使朝鲜受到进一步关注，平壤参与对话的意愿也会进一步降低。
郭同样预计，有关讨论只会停留在广泛层面，议题可能仅限于无核化；鉴于平壤反对韩国参与，他怀疑首尔不会发挥核心作用。
他说：“韩国的作用很重要，但让韩国参与讨论会引发朝鲜反对。”
《韩国时报》记者金宝剑对本文亦有贡献。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: Korea welcomes record 20 mil. foreign visitors as K-culture fuels tourism boom

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Korea has crossed a milestone that once seemed distant, welcoming more than 20 million foreign tourists in a single year for the first time as the global popularity of Korean culture fuels demand for travel to the country. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism announced that international arrivals surpassed the 20 million mark on Thursday, just 14 years after Korea first recorded 10 million annual visitors in 2012. The achievement marks a new high for the country's tourism industry, with arrivals expected to continue setting records through the end of the year. The surge has also translated into higher spending and more visitors entering through regional gateways, extending tourism's economic benefits beyond the capital. Foreign tourists spent 15.9 trillion won on tourism-related activities through September, up 47.7 percent from the same period last year, according to the ministry. Arrivals through airports outside the Seoul metropolitan area reached 3.24 million, up 37.4 percent, while arrivals through regional seaports totaled 1.58 million, an increase of 14.5 percent. The ministry attributed the growth to the international expansion of Korean pop culture, coordination among government agencies and the hospitality shown by ordinary citizens. A 2026 survey of 27,000 people in 30 countries found that Korean food and beauty products were popular among respondents, with 55 percent expressing interest in Korean food and 53 percent in Korean beauty content. The government has also introduced measures to make travel easier, including improvements to immigration procedures, expanded international flight services at regional airports and stronger penalties for businesses charging excessive prices. Chae Hwi-young, minister of culture, sports and tourism, said the milestone should serve as a starting point for greater ambitions. "Surpassing 20 million foreign tourists is the starting point for Korea's leap toward becoming an irreplaceable tourism powerhouse," Chae said. The ministry plans commemorative events, airport welcome ceremonies, promotional campaigns and industry meetings to mark the achievement and prepare for further growth. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 韩国文化推动旅游热潮，接待外国游客创2000万人次纪录
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 韩国跨越了一个曾经看似遥远的里程碑，首次在一年内接待超过2000万名外国游客。随着韩国文化在全球日益流行，前往韩国旅游的需求不断增长。韩国文化、体育观光部宣布，国际游客到访人数于周四突破2000万大关，而距离韩国2012年首次录得年度游客1000万人次仅过去14年。这一成绩创下该国旅游业新高，预计全年到访人数将继续刷新纪录。游客激增还带来了消费增长，以及更多游客经由各地区门户入境，使旅游业的经济效益延伸至首都之外。据该部数据，截至9月，外国游客在旅游相关活动上的消费达到15.9万亿韩元，同比增长47.7%。经首尔 metropolitan area以外机场入境的游客达到324万人次，同比增长37.4%；经各地区港口入境的游客共计158万人次，增长14.5%。该部将增长归因于韩国流行文化的国际传播、政府机构间的协调以及普通市民所展现的待客热情。2026年对30个国家2.7万人开展的一项调查发现，韩国美食和美容产品颇受受访者欢迎，55%的受访者对韩国美食感兴趣，53%对韩国美容内容感兴趣。政府还推出便利化出行措施，包括改进出入境手续、扩大地区机场的国际航班服务，以及加强对收取过高价格企业的处罚。文化、体育观光部长蔡汇永表示，这一里程碑应成为实现更大抱负的起点。蔡说：“突破2000万名外国游客，是韩国跃升为不可替代的旅游强国的起点。”该部计划举办纪念活动、机场迎宾仪式、宣传活动和业界会议，以纪念这一成就并为进一步增长做好准备。本文在生成式人工智能协助下发布，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun will visit China this week for talks with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on North Korea-related issues and bilateral relations, Seoul's foreign ministry said Thursday. Cho is scheduled to make a two-day visit to Beijing starting Friday, during which he will hold talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang and attend a dinner on the same day, according to the ministry. "The two ministers plan to hold wide-ranging discussions on issues of mutual interest, including bilateral relations, developments on the Korean Peninsula and other regional issues," ministry spokesperson Park Doo-soon said at a press briefing. Cho's visit follows an invitation from Wang during their talks in Seoul in August. At the time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. The visit will precede President Lee Jae Myung's planned trip to China to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen on Nov. 18-19. Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump and other world leaders are also expected to attend the summit. The gathering is expected to provide an opportunity for Xi and Trump to meet. The possibility of a trilateral meeting involving Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the summit has also drawn attention. There has also been speculation about a possible meeting between Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. "While there have been various reports about the possibility of renewed U.S.-North Korea dialogue, we currently see little likelihood of any concrete moves. We are closely monitoring relevant developments," spokesperson Park said. "We hope the resumption of U.S.-North Korea dialogue will help create a virtuous cycle of progress toward stability and peace on the Korean Peninsula," he added

https://www.myjoyonline.com/health-minis.body: The Ministry of Health has warned the public against a fraudulent fundraising campaign being aired on some Ghanaian television stations, which falsely solicits money from people seeking surgical treatment through Mercy Ships. In a press release dated November 10, 2026, the Ministry said the campaign, featuring an organisation identified as the “HELP Save LIFE Foundation”, was requesting financial contributions through an MTN Mobile Money account. It stressed that the fundraising campaign was not affiliated with, authorised by or endorsed by Mercy Ships. The Ministry explained that Mercy Ships International, an organisation that provides free surgical care and medical education across Africa, currently has its hospital vessel, The Global Mercy, docked at the Tema Port. The vessel is expected to provide free surgeries to more than 2,500 Ghanaians over a 10-month period ending in June 2027. According to the Ministry, patients scheduled for treatment were identified and pre-screened before the vessel’s arrival through a coordinated process involving Mercy Ships and the Ministry, based on established medical and eligibility criteria. It added that the hospital vessel was currently operating at full capacity and was not accepting additional patients for the ongoing field service. The Ministry cautioned that payments or registrations through third parties would not guarantee access to treatment, emphasising that all medical services provided by Mercy Ships were entirely free. It urged the public not to make payments, share personal or financial information or engage with individuals claiming they could facilitate access to the services. The Ministry has encouraged anyone who suspects fraudulent activity to report it to the Cyber Security Authority through call or SMS to 292, or by email at report@csa.gov.gh. Suspected incidents may also be reported to the nearest police station, MTN Ghana through its 100 customer service line, or Mercy Ships through its official communication channels. The Ministry described the exploitation of vulnerable patients and their families through fraudulent schemes as unacceptable and urged the public to rely only on official communication channels for information on Mercy Ships services and patient access

https://www.myjoyonline.com/health-minis.body_zh: 卫生部门已警告公众提防一些加纳电视台播出的欺诈性募款活动。该活动谎称通过 Mercy Ships 为寻求手术治疗的人募款。在一份日期为2026年11月10日的新闻稿中，该部门表示，这项活动以一个名为“帮助拯救生命基金会”的机构为特色，正通过 MTN Mobile Money 账户请求公众提供资金。新闻稿强调，这项募款活动与 Mercy Ships 无关，未获其授权或认可。该部门 explained，Mercy Ships International 是一家在整个非洲提供免费外科护理和医疗教育的机构，目前其医院船“全球 Mercy”停靠在特马港。该船预计将在截至2027年6月的10个月期间，为超过2,500名加纳人提供免费手术。该部门表示，根据既定的医疗和资格标准，预定接受治疗的患者已在该船抵达前通过 Mercy Ships 与该部门协调开展的相关流程完成身份确认和初步筛查。该部门补充称，这艘医院船目前正满负荷运行，不接受额外患者参加正在进行的现场医疗服务。该部门警告称，通过第三方付款或登记无法保证获得治疗，并强调 Mercy Ships 提供的所有医疗服务均完全免费。该部门敦促公众不要付款，不要分享个人或财务信息，也不要与声称能够帮助获得相关服务的人员接触。该部门鼓励任何怀疑存在欺诈活动的人拨打或发送短信至292，或发送电子邮件至 report@csa.gov.gh，向网络安全局举报。疑似事件也可向最近的警察局报告，或通过 MTN Ghana 的100客户服务热线向其举报，或通过 Mercy Ships 的官方沟通渠道举报。该部门表示，通过欺诈计划剥削弱势患者及其家属的行为不可接受，并敦促公众仅通过官方沟通渠道获取 Mercy Ships 服务和患者就诊的相关信息。

Unlock these with Subscription The Nifty Auto index fell over 1% on Thursday despite easing crude oil prices and a broadly positive trend in the domestic equity market, as investors booked profits following the previous session’s rally. The sectoral index shed 292 points, or 1.02%, to close at 28,231. In contrast, the benchmark Nifty 50 and Sensex gained 44 points and 32 points, respectively, to settle at 25,299.35 and 81,911.01. Among auto constituents, Hyundai Motor India was the biggest loser, declining nearly 2.5%, followed by Mahindra & Mahindra, which fell 1.9%, and Tata Motors, down 1.3%. The index had rallied on Wednesday, supported by a decline in crude oil prices. Analysts attributed Thursday’s reversal largely to profit booking. The Nifty IT index also remained under pressure, extending its decline to a third consecutive session despite a recovery in global AI and technology stocks. “Global AI stock recovery is likely to continue in the near term. The sharp corrections seen globally last week have subdued following the sweeping victory of the Democrats. It could be unrealistic to expect further sharp decline, but the Nvidia issue could weigh,” said VK Vijayakumar, chief investment strategist at Geojit Financial Services. Meanwhile, the rupee surrendered its early gains from foreign fund inflows as state-run banks purchased dollars on behalf of oil marketing companies, while concerns over rising inflation added to pressure. The currency closed at 94.04 against the US dollar, down 0.4% from its previous close. “Closing near 94.0425, the pair reflects a clear tug-of-war where broad US dollar strength and elevated Fed rate expectations have temporarily overshadowed India’s supportive local equity inflows and easing oil costs,” said Anil Kumar Bhansali, head of treasury, Finrex Treasury Advisors LLP. Adding to currency concerns, India’s consumer price inflation rose to a two-year high of 6.09% in October, breaching the Reserve Bank of India’s upper tolerance limit of 6%. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: South Korea is closely watching developments surrounding the possibility of a trilateral summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia on the sidelines of next week's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, a senior Seoul official said Thursday. First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo made the remarks during a session of the parliamentary foreign affairs and unification committee in response to Rep. Park Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party's question about the prospect of such a meeting. "We are closely monitoring developments involving the U.S., China and Russia, as the possibility of discussions on issues concerning the Korean Peninsula (during the meeting) cannot be ruled out," Park said. There have been discussions about a possible first-ever trilateral meeting among U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit scheduled for Nov. 18-19 in the Chinese city of Shenzhen, according to foreign media reports. The lawmaker said North Korea's strategic value and leverage have grown since the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine war amid closer military and security ties between Pyongyang and Moscow, adding that a trilateral summit could help create momentum toward a resolution of the war in Ukraine. In response, Park said North Korea is in a "considerably advantageous strategic position" and the government will continue to closely monitor relevant developments. Asked about possible additional sanctions against North Korea over its illicit cyber activities, the vice minister said the government "is holding interagency consultations" on the matter

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Korea will accept its final round of applications this year for foreign worker visas starting Nov. 23, offering 6,699 new permits to help businesses ease persistent labor shortages while introducing incentives for employers who complete human rights and labor law training, the Ministry of Employment and Labor said Thursday.

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea will accept its final round of applications this year for foreign worker visas starting Nov. 23, offering 6,699 new permits to help businesses ease persistent labor shortages while introducing incentives for employers who complete human rights and labor law training, the Ministry of Employment and Labor said Thursday. The five-day application window, running through Nov. 27, covers nonprofessional employment visas, known as E-9, across five major sectors. Manufacturing accounts for the lion’s share of the quota with 4,510 slots, followed by agriculture and livestock with 954, fisheries with 897, construction with 198 and services with 140. Should employer demand exceed sector caps, officials said they will tap into a flexible reserve pool of 10,000 additional permits. The announcement underscores Korea’s growing reliance on overseas labor to sustain its export-driven factories, farms and fishing fleets amid one of the world’s fastest-aging populations and lowest birthrates. Over the past several years, the government has steadily expanded its Employment Permit System, which brings in workers primarily from Southeast and South Asia to fill blue-collar jobs that domestic workers increasingly avoid. At the same time, Seoul has faced mounting pressure from labor advocates and international observers to improve working conditions and housing standards for migrant workers, following high-profile incidents of workplace accidents and wage theft. Beginning with this fifth and final allocation round of 2026, the ministry will award bonus points under its permit scoring system to workplaces that complete in-person training on human rights protection and basic labor laws. The courses are administered by the Human Resources Development Service of Korea, a state-run agency overseeing workforce management. To qualify for the program, prospective employers must first demonstrate that they spent at least seven days attempting to hire domestic workers. Businesses can then submit applications in person at regional labor offices or online through the government’s Work24 portal . Successful applicants will be notified on Dec. 11. Permit issuance will follow in two phases: from Dec. 14-16 for manufacturing and mining employers, and from Dec. 17-21 for those in agriculture, livestock, fisheries, forestry, construction and services. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国开放2026年最后一轮外国劳动者签证申请
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国就业劳动部周四表示，韩国将于今年11月23日起接受最后一批外国劳动者签证申请，将发放6,699份新许可证，以帮助企业缓解持续存在的劳动力短缺，并为完成人权及劳动法培训的雇主提供激励。申请窗口为期五天，持续至11月27日，涵盖五个主要行业的非专业就业签证，即E-9签证。制造业占配额大头，共有4,510个名额，其次是农业和畜牧业954个、渔业897个、建筑业198个以及服务业140个。官员表示，如雇主需求超过各行业上限，将从1万个额外许可证组成的灵活储备名额中调配。此次公告凸显出，在全球人口老龄化速度最快、出生率最低的国家群体之一中，韩国正日益依赖海外劳动力，以维持出口导向型工厂、农场和捕鱼船队。过去几年，政府稳步扩大就业许可制度，主要从东南亚和南亚引进劳工，以填补韩国本国劳动者日益不愿从事的蓝领岗位。与此同时，继多起引人注目的工作场所事故和工资侵占事件发生后，首尔面临劳工倡导人士和国际观察人士日益增大的压力，要求改善移民劳动者的工作条件和住房标准。自2026年第五轮也是最终一轮配额分配开始，该部将在其许可证评分制度下，为完成现场人权保护及基本劳动法培训的用工场所授予额外分数。课程由韩国人力资源开发院负责实施，该机构是负责劳动力管理的国有机构。拟参与该计划的雇主必须首先证明，其曾至少花费7天努力招聘韩国本国劳动者。随后，企业可亲自前往各地区劳动办公室提交申请，也可通过政府的Work24门户网站在线申请。获批申请人将于12月11日接到通知。许可证发放将分两个阶段进行：12月14日至16日为制造业和采矿业雇主，12月17日至21日为农业、畜牧业、渔业、林业、建筑业和服务业雇主。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea is unlikely to attend the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit set to be held in China next week, a South Korean presidential official said Thursday. "It would be difficult to say there is zero possibility of talks (between North Korea and the United States), but I think the probability might not be high," the official said when asked about the possibility of North Korea attending multilateral diplomatic events or holding talks with Washington. The North is, in particular, unlikely to attend next week's APEC summit, the official said on condition of anonymity, adding the chances of talks between the two sides during the summit are slim. The remarks come amid persistent speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during the APEC summit, scheduled for next Wednesday and Thursday in Shenzhen, China, after Trump repeatedly offered to meet Kim for talks. The official said that the possibility of a summit between Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the APEC summit "cannot be ruled out" and that Seoul is paying close attention. Earlier this week, Trump mentioned the possibility of a meeting with Xi and Putin during the APEC gathering, saying that the agenda would include denuclearization and ending the war in Iran. Asked about the impact of the U.S midterm election results on South Korea-U.S. discussions on Seoul's bid to retake wartime operational control (OPCON) of South Korean troops from the U.S., the official noted that the relevant discussions were "faring well." Referring to Seoul's steps to expand the operational scope of its anti-piracy unit operating in waters off the Somali coast to areas closer to the Strait of Hormuz, the official said the move aims to protect South Korean nationals and vessels and participate in international cooperation to secure freedom of navigation. The unit will be entitled to exercise the right to self-defense at the minimum necessary level in an emergency, but will not engage in war or combat or come under a different command system, the official said. "There will be no case of it entering into a dangerous situation." Earlier this week, the South Korean Cabinet approved a bill seeking parliamentary consent for the government's plan to expand the operational scope of the Cheonghae unit from waters off the Somali coast to waters south of Oman in the Arabian Sea, closer to the Strait of Hormuz. Following the Cabinet approval, the bill is set to be submitted to the National Assembly for approval
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 官员：朝鲜不太可能参加亚太经合组织会议，也不太可能与美国会谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国总统府官员周四表示，朝鲜不太可能出席下周在中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会。该官员在谈及朝鲜参加多边外交活动或与华盛顿举行会谈的可能性时说：“很难说（朝鲜与美国）会谈的可能性完全为零，但我认为概率可能不会很高。”该官员在要求匿名的情况下表示，尤其是朝鲜不太可能出席下周的APEC峰会，并补充说，两国在峰会期间举行会谈的机会渺茫。此番言论之际，外界持续猜测美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会在APEC峰会期间会面。峰会定于下周周三和周四在中国深圳举行，此前特朗普曾多次表示愿意与金正恩会晤。该官员说，特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在APEC峰会期间举行首脑会晤的可能性“无法排除”，首尔正密切关注此事。本周早些时候，特朗普提到在APEC会议期间与习近平和普京会面的可能性，称议程将包括伊朗核问题以及结束伊朗战争。当被问及美国中期选举结果对韩美就首尔收回美国对韩国军队的战时作战指挥权（OPCON）事宜进行讨论的影响时，该官员表示，相关讨论“进展顺利”。谈及首尔采取 steps，将其部署在索马里沿岸水域的反海盗部队行动范围扩大至更靠近霍尔木兹海峡的地区，该官员表示，此举旨在保护韩国国民和船舶，并参与保障航行自由的国际合作。该官员说，在紧急情况下，这支部队将有权在最低必要限度内行使自卫权，但不会参与战争或战斗，也不会归入其他指挥体系。“不会出现该部队陷入危险境地的情况。”本周早些时候，韩国内阁批准了一项法案，请求国会同意政府将清海部队的行动范围从索马里沿岸水域扩大至阿曼湾和阿拉伯海南部、更加靠近霍尔木兹海峡的水域。内阁批准后，该法案将提交国会审议批准

Early Thursday morning international currency feeds recorded spot quotes hovering near ₦1,345.72 per dollar, while official NFEM benchmarks reflect the closing figures from the prior trading session pending the day’s official fixing. Earlier in the week, trading at the official window saw intraday fluctuations between ₦1,349.25 and ₦1,354 per dollar, with interbank turnover reaching $248.07 million across 144 deals. In the parallel market, commonly referred to as the black market, the naira continues to trade at a significant discount to the official rate. Currency dealers across Lagos and Abuja quoted the dollar between ₦1,411 and ₦1,420 for buying, while selling rates ranged from ₦1,419 to ₦1,430 per dollar depending on transaction volume and location. This leaves an exchange rate gap of roughly ₦68 to ₦80 per dollar between the official NFEM benchmark and street-level rates. Market analysts attribute the recent softening of the local currency to heightened seasonal foreign exchange demand from importers and travelers heading into the end-of-year period, alongside foreign portfolio investment outflows and a firmer US dollar globally. Despite the recent dip—which saw the parallel market touch a 10-month low of ₦1,430 per dollar this week—Nigeria’s gross external reserves remain sturdy at approximately $54.9 billion, well above the CBN’s full-year target of $51.04 billion, offering a substantial buffer to support market liquidity through the remainder of the fourth quarter. Traders and businesses continue to monitor daily NFEM liquidity injections and CBN updates for direction as Thursday’s trading progresses. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/doll.body_zh: 第一层 尼日利亚奈拉周四，即2026年11月12日开盘交易，在尼日利亚官方外汇市场（NFEM）和平行市场均承受持续需求压力的情况下，维持了本周早些时候出现的较大价差。在官方窗口，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）的数据显示，奈拉在周四交易时段开始时处于每美元₦1,350.36至₦1,353.50的区间。周四早间，国际货币数据流记录显示，现货报价在每美元₦1,345.72附近徘徊；官方NFEM基准价则反映上一交易时段的收盘数据，等待当天官方定盘。此前一周，官方窗口的交易日内每美元价格波动在₦1,349.25至₦1,354之间，银行间成交量在144笔交易中达到2.4807亿美元。在通常被称为黑市的平行市场，奈拉兑官方汇率继续大幅折价。拉各斯和阿布贾的外汇交易商报出的美元买入价在每美元₦1,411至₦1,420之间，卖出价则根据交易量和所在地处于每美元₦1,419至₦1,430之间。这意味着官方NFEM基准价与街头汇率之间每美元存在约₦68至₦80的汇率差。市场分析人士认为，本币近期走软源于年底之际进口商和旅客的season性外汇需求上升，同时外国证券投资资金外流，且全球美元走强。尽管近期出现下跌，使平行市场本周触及每美元₦1,430的10个月低点，但尼日利亚的对外总储备仍稳健保持在约549亿美元，远高于尼日利亚中央银行全年510.4亿美元的目标，为第四季度剩余时间的市场流动性提供充足缓冲。随着周四交易推进，交易员和企业继续关注尼日利亚中央银行每日注入NFEM流动性的情况及其发布的最新动态，以判断市场走向。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的观点

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription The government has simplified its visa regime by reducing the categories from 13 to nine and making the application forms leaner by up to 70%, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) said in a statement on Wednesday (November 11, 2026). The “Tourist Visa” has been renamed “Visitor Visa”, reflecting a broader range of permitted purposes beyond conventional tourism, the Ministry said. “The step aims at making it more compact, coherent and responsive to the requirements of foreign nationals visiting India. On August 27, 2026, MHA reduced the number of main visa categories from 13 to nine and the number of sub-categories from 49 to 23,” it said. This follows the earlier rationalisation done in October 2025, when the main visa categories were reduced from 22 to 13 and sub-categories from 63 to 49. While enacting the changes, the government studied the visa systems of developed countries and global standards. The consolidation of similar purposes of travel is aimed at providing greater clarity and ease in identifying the appropriate visa category while facilitating legitimate foreign arrivals, the Ministry said. Currently, e-visa is processed through electronic travel authorisation (ETA) under 13 subcategories. The facility of e-visa is presently available to the nationals of 172 countries. As reported by The Hindu on November 4, the required fields/columns for all 23 categories/sub-categories in the visa application have been reduced by 65%-70%. The initiative aims to reduce the information required from foreign nationals, simplify the visa form while retaining essential details necessary for visa processing. This will reduce the time and effort required to complete the application and will enhance administrative efficiency by facilitating more focused scrutiny and processing of visa applications. To implement all changes made in the Indian Visa Regime, the Ministry is updating the IT systems. By year-end, visas will be granted as per the new rationalisation. The visitor visa category has been organised into two sub-categories, V-1 and V-2, so that applicants may select a visa suited to the nature and duration of their proposed visit. In addition to other eligible visitor activities, the V-1 visa covers short-term activities such as business meetings, medical consultations, wellness retreats, short-duration medical treatment, and short-term courses in Indian languages, music, art and craft. It is granted for 30 days with multiple entries. V-2 Visa is intended for longer-duration visits, with a validity of one year, five years, or 10 years. It covers the activities permissible under V-1 and mountaineering. For mountaineering, a visa valid for six months, with multiple entries, will be granted. By bringing a wider range of short visits under a clearly identified category, the new arrangement makes visa selection simpler for travellers who may combine leisure with business meetings, medical consultations, wellness retreats, cultural learning, or short-duration yoga programmes, the Ministry said. The longer-duration V-2 option provides continuity and convenience for eligible repeat visitors, while the specific mountaineering provision addresses the distinct needs of such travel. The Medical Visa framework retains separate provisions for treatment under conventional and AYUSH systems. M-1 Visa covers medical treatment, while the M-3 Visa covers treatment under AYUSH systems. M-1 and M-3 Visas, including their e-Visa variants, will be granted for one year as a default option with multiple entries. Corresponding medical attendant visa provisions are also available; M-2 and M-4 Visas will be granted for attendant of M-1 and M-3 visa holders respectively. This arrangement gives patients greater predictability when the treatment involves multiple consultations, follow-up appointments, or staged procedures. Multiple-entry validity can reduce the need for repeated visa applications during a course of care, while the distinct AYUSH provision helps applicants identify the appropriate treatment route. The availability of attendant visas also facilitates support by accompanying persons. This will encourage the Medical Value Travel in India. The Student Visa category has been consolidated into two broad sub-categories. S-1 Visa covers school, graduate, and post-graduate education. S-2 Visa covers PhD and research scholars in Indian universities, visiting faculty, foreign research students visiting India for research, scientific and anthropological expeditions, internships and exchange students, among other specified academic activities. For foreign students enrolled in Indian educational institutions through the Study in India portal, the e-S1 Visa may be granted for up to five years or for the duration of the academic course, whichever is less, with multiple entries. These provisions offer students a more readily identifiable visa pathway and greater certainty for academic planning. Longer validity linked to the course duration can also minimise procedural interruptions and make it easier for eligible students to travel during their studies. The Business Visa category has been consolidated into B-1 and B-2. B-1 Visa covers long-term, licence-based business activities, including foreign nationals seeking to establish industrial or business ventures in India. B-2 Visa covers short-term, contract-based business activities, including Production Investment Business, conferences, sports, performative arts and films. This was previously granted under e-B4 visa nomenclature. This differentiation gives businesses greater clarity when planning long-term investments as against short-term contractual assignments. The dedicated provision for technical specialists can facilitate timely deployment of expertise for setting up and operationalising industrial facilities, transferring technology, training personnel and supporting production, thereby improving predictability for companies and foreign professionals alike. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.title_zh: 印度简化签证规定，精简类别并将表格缩减70%
https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受《premium stories》（独家报道）、《社论》、《观点》等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。内政部（MHA）周三（2026年11月11日）发表声明称，政府简化了签证制度，将签证类别从13类减少至9类，并将申请表格所需内容精简最多70%。“旅游签证”已更名为“访客签证”，以涵盖传统旅游以外的更多许可目的。内政部表示：“此举旨在使签证制度更加精简、协调，并能响应外国公民赴印度访问的需求。2026年8月27日，内政部将主要签证类别从13类减少至9类，将次类别从49类减少至23类。”这是继2025年10月首次调整后的又一次优化；当时，主要签证类别从22类减少至13类，次类别从63类减少至49类。政府实施这些调整时，研究了发达国家的签证制度和全球标准。内政部表示，将用途相近的旅行类别整合，旨在让申请人更容易识别适当的签证类别，同时便利外国人的合法入境。目前，电子签证通过13个次类别项下的电子旅行授权（ETA）办理。电子签证目前向172个国家的公民开放。据《The Hindu》11月4日报道，签证申请中全部23个类别及次类别所需的填报栏目均已减少65%至70%。这项措施旨在减少向外国公民收集的信息，在保留签证办理所需重要细节的同时简化签证表格。这将缩短完成申请所需的时间和精力，并通过更有针对性地审查和办理签证申请来提高行政效率。为落实印度签证制度的所有调整，内政部正在更新信息系统。今年年底前，所有签证将按照新的整合规定签发。访客签证被划分为V-1和V-2两个次类别，使申请人可以根据计划访问的性质和期限选择合适的签证。除其他符合条件的访客活动外，V-1签证涵盖商务会议、医疗咨询、健康疗养、短期医疗治疗以及在印度学习语言、音乐、艺术和工艺的短期课程等短期活动。该签证有效期为30天，可多次入境。V-2签证适用于期限较长的访问，有效期为1年、5年或10年，涵盖V-1签证允许的活动以及登山。用于登山的签证有效期为6个月，可多次入境。内政部表示，将更多短期访问活动纳入界定明确的类别后，对于可能将休闲活动与商务会议、医疗咨询、健康疗养、文化学习或短期瑜伽课程相结合旅行者而言，签证选择将更加简便。长期有效的V-2签证为符合条件的访客提供了连续性和便利，而专门的登山规定则满足了此类旅行的独特需求。医疗签证框架继续分别规定传统医疗体系和AYUSH体系下的治疗。医疗签证包括M-1医疗签证和M-3 AYUSH医疗签证。M-1和M-3签证及其电子签证变体默认签发1年有效期，并可多次入境。医疗陪护者签证也设有相应规定；M-2和M-4签证分别签发给M-1和M-3签证持有人，作为其陪护者。当治疗涉及多次会诊、复诊预约或分阶段治疗程序时，这种安排能让患者更准确地预期后续安排。多次入境有效期可减少治疗期间反复申请签证的必要性，而单独的AYUSH规定则有助于申请人确定适当的治疗途径。陪护者签证的提供也有利于随行人员给予支持，从而促进医疗旅游在印度的发展。学生签证类别已整合为两个主要次类别。S-1签证涵盖中学、研究生和博士阶段教育。S-2签证涵盖在印度大学攻读博士学位的研究人员和访问学者、来访教师、赴印度开展研究、科研和人类学考察、实习及交流的学生，以及其他规定的学术活动。对于通过Study in India门户注册就读印度教育机构的外国学生，电子S-1签证可签发最长5年有效期，或至其学术课程结束，以较短期限为准，并可多次入境。这些规定为学生提供了更易识别的签证路径，也为学业规划带来更大确定性。与课程期限相联系的较长有效期还可减少程序中断，使符合条件的学生在学习期间更容易出行。商务签证类别已整合为B-1和B-2。B-1签证涵盖长期、基于许可的商业活动，包括寻求在印度创办工业企业或商业项目的外国公民。B-2签证涵盖短期、基于合同的商业活动，包括生产投资业务、会议、体育、表演艺术和电影；这些活动此前以电子B-4签证名义签发。这种区分让企业在规划长期投资和短期合同任务时更加明确。针对技术专家的专门规定，可以便利企业及时调配专业人才，用于建设和运营工业设施、技术转让、人员培训以及生产支持，从而提高企业和外国专业人员的可预期性。评论须以英文撰写，并使用完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果您已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果您还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录Vuukle账户后，可以查看以前的评论。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.title: How ISWAP’s southern expansion plot was foiled, commander killed in Ondo forest
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.summary: The elimination of Abdussamad Ohida, also known as Anwar, a senior commander of the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP), alongside several of his fighters has brought major relief not only to the people of Ondo State but to the entire southern Nigeria.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.summary_zh: 伊斯兰国西非省高级指挥官阿卜杜萨马德·奥希达（又名安瓦尔）及其数名战斗人员被消灭，不仅让翁多州民众，也让尼日利亚整个南部如释重负。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.body: The elimination of Abdussamad Ohida, also known as Anwar, a senior commander of the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP), alongside several of his fighters has brought major relief not only to the people of Ondo State but to the entire southern Nigeria. Ohida, who took over the coordination of ISWAP’s central and southern regional activities following the 2023 arrest of his superior, Abu Ikrimah (Abu Uwais) inside an Ondo forest, was killed during an intelligence-led operation deep inside the Owo Forest, Ondo State, early this month. The operation was executed by a combined team of Nigerian Army troops, operatives of the Department of State Services (DSS), and officers of the Western Nigeria Security Network, codenamed Amotekun, with strategic intelligence backing from the United Kingdom. A major blow against southern expansion, security analysts have described the operation as another major counter-terrorism breakthrough by Nigerian security agencies, at a time authorities are intensifying efforts to prevent terrorist groups from extending their operational footprint from the North-East into the South. According to security sources, the forces carried out a thorough clearance operation in the forest, aimed at dislodging entrenched terrorist cells and preventing planned attacks on communities in southern Nigeria. Before the breakthrough, credible intelligence had indicated that Ohida was plotting to launch coordinated attacks on civilians during the festive period. The plot was designed to create a widespread atmosphere of insecurity that could undermine public confidence and disrupt preparations for the 2027 general elections. His elimination has therefore foiled the group’s plans to launch major terrorist attacks in parts of southern Nigeria during the coming festivities. The killing of Ohida came barely months after Nigerian and United States forces, in a joint counter-terrorism operation, killed another senior Islamic State commander, Abu-Bilal al-Minuki, in Borno State. For years, Ohida’s group had carried out several coordinated attacks against military formations, security installations and other soft targets as part of a deliberate strategy to establish or expand operational networks outside its traditional strongholds in northeastern Nigeria. The latest operation is being viewed by security authorities as a decisive attempt to disrupt ISWAP’s desperate push to establish a new operational corridor in the South. Ohida was accused of involvement in several high-profile attacks on security formations across the country. One of the alleged attacks was the December 31, 2025 attack on the Ipele Divisional Police Station in Owo, Ondo State, during which eight AK-47 rifles were reportedly carted away before the Police facility was bombed. The killed terrorist was also linked to the April 23, 2022 attack on the Ogaminana Police Station in Adavi Local Government Area of Kogi State, where five policemen were killed in cold blood. Other attacks attributed to him included the February 7, 2022 assault on the Okene Area Command and the December 24, 2020 attack on a naval checkpoint in Okene, where two naval officers were reportedly killed. Security sources said Ohida had been on the wanted list for years and had perfected the use of Ondo’s thick forest reserves as a safe haven and launching pad for operations into Kogi, Edo and other parts of the South-West. Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa had issued a 14-day ultimatum for bandits, kidnappers and other criminal elements to vacate the state’s forest reserves. The governor warned that failure to comply would trigger a coordinated security operation involving state security agencies, tactical teams and local hunters. The raid carried out at the ISWAP camp that resulted in the killing of its leader, Abdussamad Ohida and his fighters came 19 days after the governor’s ultimatum elapsed. In a statement issued by his Senior Special Assistant on Forestry, Bidemi Joshua Obayangban, Governor Aiyedatiwa commended the security agencies involved in the operation. He said the operation demonstrated his administration’s determination to reclaim the state’s forests from terrorists, kidnappers and other criminal elements. “The successful operation demonstrates that Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa’s 14-day ultimatum is yielding results. We commend the joint security forces for their courage and commitment in eliminating the ISWAP commander and members of his group. The government will continue to support security agencies until criminal elements are completely flushed out of Ondo State’s forests”, he said. Despite the recent breakthroughs, insecurity in the state remains a serious challenge as gunmen and suspected kidnappers have continued to target farm settlements and small communities, such as Imafon, Igushin, Ilado, Ilu-Abo, and Aba Oyinbo in Akure North, Owo and Ose council areas resulting in the abductions and deaths of farmers and residents. Consequently, youths across communities in the state have staged protests over the incessant abduction for ransom, killings and rape of women on their way to farms by suspected herders. Insecurity across the state has taken a heavy toll on farmers, who can no longer tend their farms freely for fear of attack. Falae also lamented the economic impact of the insecurity, noting that many residents are now afraid to visit their farms. Cocoa plantations and poultry operations, which are key sources of livelihood in the area, have been abandoned owing to fear of abduction. He said: “People are afraid to go to the farm. Our hard-working residents cannot continue to live in fear; otherwise, we risk becoming beggars and food insecure. “I am certain that the law will not abandon us and security agencies will not fold their arms. With determination, training and strategic action, we will rescue our people and safeguard our heritage,” Falae stated. The development has forced some families, who have been repeatedly targeted by gunmen, to flee their communities and put their homes up for sale. In a related development, Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa has revealed that security operatives recently foiled an alleged plot to bomb the Ondo State Government House in Akure. Governor Aiyedatiwa, who disclosed this during an appearance on a television personality programme, described the operation as one of several silent victories recorded in the state’s fight against insecurity. He explained that the planned attack was uncovered about three to four months ago after intelligence reports alerted security agencies to suspicious activities by a group of youths allegedly plotting to target the seat of government. According to the governor, the suspects initially lodged in a hotel within the state capital before relocating to a rented apartment, where security operatives later discovered materials and equipment believed to be connected to the planned operation. “Following intelligence reports, the Police and Amotekun moved in, raided the location, arrested the suspects, and they remain in custody,” the governor said. Aiyedatiwa noted that investigators are yet to establish the exact motive behind the alleged plot but stressed that the incident underscores the complex security challenges confronting the state and the need for constant vigilance. The governor said many successful security operations often go unnoticed by the public because attacks are prevented before they happen. “So much work is being done. Security is one responsibility that leaders carry that is not so visible to everybody. It is only when there is a lapse that it will look as if the government has not been doing enough. We have been doing so much,” he said. Speaking on security efforts across the South-West, Aiyedatiwa said governors in the region are working together to strengthen safety, intelligence-gathering and joint operations. “We are talking to ourselves; we are working,” he said, adding that recent meetings among the governors focused on enhancing collaboration through regional security outfits such as Amotekun and improving information sharing across state boundaries. The governor also welcomed the conviction of four persons linked to the June 5, 2022 Owo church massacre, describing the judgment as a major victory for justice and the rule of law. “For us in Ondo State, we are happy that this judgment is a victory for the rule of law and for all the victims attacked, not just in Owo, Ondo State, but all who have been attacked at one time or the other by these terrorists,” he said. The attack on St. Francis Xavier Catholic Church in Owo had claimed more than 40 lives and left many others injured after gunmen opened fire on worshippers during a Sunday service. Speaking on the security situation, the Commander of Amotekun in Ondo State, Chief Adetunji Adeleye, renewed his call for the establishment of state policing, describing it as the most viable solution to Nigeria’s growing security challenges. Adeleye, who doubles as Chairman of Amotekun Commanders in the South-West region, said the council had consistently maintained that decentralised policing remains the most effective strategy for tackling insecurity across the country. According to him, local security structures possess better knowledge of their environments and are better positioned to identify and apprehend criminals operating within their communities. “The position of the Council of Amotekun Commanders has always been that state policing remains the only viable solution to the present insecurity in the country. It is easier to identify criminals when security operations are rooted within the local communities,” he said. Adeleye described the proposed state police structure as a major step towards decentralising Nigeria’s security architecture and strengthening grassroots intelligence-gathering. “As far as the South-West is concerned, we are ready to adjust and conform with whatever framework is put in place to ensure the successful take-off of state policing,” he added. The Ondo Amotekun boss noted that the corps had demonstrated the effectiveness of community-based policing through its operations across the state, disclosing that more than 500 suspected criminals had been arrested and prosecuted this year alone”, he said. According to him, many of those prosecuted have been convicted and are currently serving various jail terms, a development, he said, validates the effectiveness of the Amotekun model. However, residents remain apprehensive over desperate plans by Islamic groups still hiding in the thick forests to establish a new operational corridor in southern Nigeria, raising fresh concerns about the need for sustained surveillance and forest combing operations. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.title_zh: 伊斯兰国西非省如何在南线扩张计划中受挫，指挥官在翁多森林遇袭身亡
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/how-.body_zh: 伊斯兰国西非省（ISWAP）高级指挥官阿卜杜萨马德·奥希达，又称安瓦尔，与其数名战斗人员被消灭，不仅让奥恩多州民众，也让尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）整个南部地区如释重负。2023年，其上级阿布·伊克里马（阿布·乌韦斯）在奥恩多州一片森林内被捕后，奥希达接手协调ISWAP中部和南部地区的活动。本月初，奥希达在奥恩多州奥沃森林深处一次情报主导的行动中被击毙。行动由尼日利亚陆军部队、国家安全局（DSS）特工以及代号为Amotekun的西尼日利亚安全网络官员联合执行，并得到英国提供的战略情报支持。安全分析人士称，针对ISWAP向南扩张的这次行动是一次重大打击，也是尼日利亚安全机构在当局加大力度阻止恐怖组织将行动范围从东北部扩展至南部之际取得的又一重大反恐突破。安全消息人士称，部队在森林中开展了全面清剿行动，旨在清除盘踞当地的恐怖分子小组，并阻止其策划袭击尼日利亚南部社区。此前，可信情报显示，奥希达正图谋在节日期间对平民发动协同袭击。这个阴谋意在制造大范围的不安全局势，削弱公众信心，并扰乱2027年大选筹备工作。因此，消灭奥希达挫败了该组织在即将到来的节庆期间于尼日利亚南部部分地区发动大规模恐怖袭击的计划。奥希达被击毙距尼日利亚和美国部队联合开展反恐行动、在博尔诺州击毙另一名伊斯兰国高级指挥官阿布-比拉尔·明努基仅数月。多年来，奥希达所属团伙有计划地在尼日利亚东北部传统据点之外，针对军事编队、安全设施及其他非军事目标发动了数起协同袭击，试图建立或扩大行动网络。安全当局认为，最近这次行动是果断打击ISWAP desperate 企图在南部建立新行动走廊的关键举措。奥希达被指控参与全国多起针对安全编队的高调袭击。其中据称的袭击之一发生在2025年12月31日，目标是奥恩多州奥沃的Ipele分区警察局；警方设施被炸毁前，8支AK-47步枪被抢走。这名被击毙的恐怖分子还被指与2022年4月23日对科吉州阿达维地方政府辖区Ogaminana警察局的袭击有关，该袭击导致5名警察被冷血杀害。其他被归咎于他的袭击还包括2022年2月7日对奥克尼地区指挥部的突袭，以及2020年12月24日对奥克尼一处海军检查站的袭击，据称有2名海军军官遇害。安全消息人士称，奥希达多年来一直被通缉，并已熟练利用奥恩多州茂密森林保护区作为藏身处，以及向科吉州、埃多州和其他西南部地区发动行动的出发地。州长拉基·阿耶达蒂瓦曾向武装匪徒、绑匪和其他犯罪分子发出14天最后通牒，要求其离开该州森林保护区。州长警告称，若拒不遵从，将触发由州级安全机构、战术部队和当地猎人参与的联合安全行动。突袭ISWAP营地并导致其领导人阿卜杜萨马德·奥希达及其战斗人员被消灭的行动，在州长最后通牒期满19天后展开。州长林业事务高级特别助理比德米·乔舒亚·奥巴扬班代表阿耶达蒂瓦州长发表声明，赞扬参与行动的安全机构。他说，此次行动表明，其政府决心从恐怖分子、绑匪和其他犯罪分子手中夺回该州森林。“这次行动成功，表明拉基·阿耶达蒂瓦州长发出的14天最后通牒正在取得成果。我们赞扬联合安全部队消灭ISWAP指挥官及其团伙成员的勇气和奉献精神。在犯罪分子被彻底逐出奥恩多州森林之前，政府将继续支持安全机构，”他说。尽管近期取得突破，该州的不安全局势仍是严峻挑战，因为武装枪手和疑似绑匪持续袭击农场聚居点和小社区，包括阿库雷北部、奥沃和奥塞各议会区的Imafon、Igushin、Ilado、Ilu-Abo和Aba Oyinbo，导致农民和居民遭绑架及死亡。因此，该州各社区的青年抗议疑似牧民为索取赎金而持续绑架、杀害男子，以及强奸前往农场途中的妇女。全州的不安全状况给农民造成沉重打击，他们因担心遭到袭击，已无法自由耕种农场。Falae也对不安全局势造成的经济影响表示痛心，指出许多居民如今害怕前往自己的农场。可可种植园和家禽养殖是当地重要的生计来源，但人们因担心遭到绑架而被迫放弃这些产业。他说：“人们害怕去农场。我们勤劳的居民不能继续生活在恐惧之中，否则就有沦为乞丐和陷入粮食不安全境地的风险。“我确信法律不会抛弃我们，安全机构也不会袖手旁观。凭借决心、培训和战略行动，我们将挽救我们的人民并守护我们的传承，”Falae表示。这一事态迫使一些多次遭枪手针对的家庭逃离社区，并将房屋挂牌出售。与此同时，州长拉基·阿耶达蒂瓦披露，安全人员近期挫败了一起据称企图炸毁阿库雷奥恩多州政府大楼的阴谋。阿耶达蒂瓦州长是在参加一档电视人物节目时透露此事的。他称，这次行动是该州打击不安全局势时取得的多项无声胜利之一。他解释说，约在3至4个月前，情报报告显示一个青年团伙正密谋袭击政府所在地，安全机构收到警报后发现了这起计划中的袭击。据州长称，嫌疑人最初入住州首府内的一家酒店，之后转移到一套出租公寓，安全人员后来在那里发现了据信与计划中的行动有关的材料和设备。“收到情报报告后，警察和Amotekun采取行动，突袭该地点，逮捕了嫌疑人，他们目前仍被羁押，”州长说。阿耶达蒂瓦指出，调查人员尚未查明这起据称阴谋的确切动机，但强调这一事件凸显了该州面临的安全挑战十分复杂，也说明必须保持持续警惕。州长说，许多成功的安全行动往往不为公众所知，因为袭击在发生前就已被阻止。“各方付出了大量工作。安全是领导人承担的一项责任，但并不为每个人所清楚看见。只有出现疏漏时，人们才会觉得政府没有尽到足够责任。我们一直在做了很多工作，”他说。谈及西南地区的安全工作，阿耶达蒂瓦表示，该地区各国州长正携手加强安全保障、情报收集和联合行动。“我们彼此沟通，也在开展工作，”他说，并补充说，近期各州长会议重点是通过Amotekun等地区安全机构加强协作，以及改善各州边界之间的信息共享。州长还欢迎对4名与2022年6月5日奥沃教堂大屠杀有关人员作出的定罪，称这一判决是司法和法治的重大胜利。“对于我们奥恩多州而言，我们很高兴这一判决维护了法治，也伸张了正义，受益者不仅是奥沃和奥恩多州的受害者，也包括所有曾在不同时期遭这些恐怖分子袭击的人，”他说。奥沃圣方济各·沙勿略天主教堂遭袭时，枪手在主日礼拜期间向礼拜者开火，造成40多人死亡，许多人受伤。谈及安全局势，奥恩多州Amotekun指挥官阿德通吉·阿德莱伊再次呼吁建立州级警察制度，并将其描述为应对尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）日益严峻的安全挑战最可行的方案。阿德莱伊同时担任西南地区Amotekun指挥官委员会主席。他说，委员会始终认为，分权式警务仍是解决全国不安全局势最有效的策略。据他称，地方安全机构更了解周边环境，也更有条件识别并抓捕在其社区活动的犯罪分子。“Amotekun指挥官委员会一贯主张，州级警务仍是解决当前全国不安全局势唯一可行的方案。安全行动扎根于当地社区时，更容易识别犯罪分子，”他说。阿德莱伊称，拟议中的州级警务架构是推动尼日利亚安全架构分权、加强基层情报收集的重要一步。“就西南地区而言，无论最终采用何种框架，我们都愿意作出调整并加以配合，以确保州级警务顺利启动，”他补充说。奥恩多州Amotekun负责人表示，该团队通过在全州开展行动证明了社区警务的成效，并透露仅今年就已有500多名疑似犯罪分子被逮捕并提起诉讼”，他说。据他介绍，许多被提起诉讼者已被判有罪，目前正在服 various jail terms；他说，这一进展验证了Amotekun模式的有效性。然而，居民仍对伊斯兰组织在茂密森林中潜伏并企图在尼日利亚南部建立新行动走廊的绝望计划感到不安，这再次引发了对持续监视和森林搜剿行动必要性的担忧。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何雇员的观点
