https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 韩国企划和预算部周四表示，受强劲的企业盈利带动税收收入增加，韩国2026年前九个月的财政收支较上年同期有所改善。据企划和预算部称，按照更严格标准计算、反映财政健康状况的重要指标——管理财政收支，截至9月底为32万亿韩元（239亿美元）的赤字，较2025年同期改善了70.5万亿韩元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korea's fiscal balance improved in the first nine months of 2026 from a year earlier, helped by increased tax revenue on the back of strong corporate earnings, the budget ministry said Thursday. The managed fiscal balance, a key gauge of fiscal health calculated under stricter criteria, posted a deficit of 32 trillion won ($23.9 billion) as of the end of September, according to the Ministry of Planning and Budget, marking an improvement of 70.5 trillion won from the same period in 2025. Tax revenue reached 385 trillion won during the January-September period, up 95.4 trillion won from a year earlier. Corporate tax revenue rose by 51.9 trillion won on the back of strong earnings by domestic companies. Income tax revenue increased by 15.7 trillion won, driven by bonuses paid by domestic companies and an increase in housing transactions. Non-tax revenue and fund revenue increased by 9.3 trillion won and 19.9 trillion won, respectively, from a year earlier. Total government expenditures amounted to 584.9 trillion won during the nine-month period, up 40.7 trillion won from a year earlier. As of the end of September, the central government's outstanding debt stood at 1,369.4 trillion won, down 2.7 trillion won from a month earlier

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国企划预算部周四表示，受国内企业盈利强劲带动税收收入增加，韩国2026年前九个月的财政收支较上年同期有所改善。韩国企划预算部称，截至9月底，按照更严格标准计算、反映财政健康状况的重要指标——管理财政余额为赤字32万亿韩元（239亿美元），较2025年同期改善70.5万亿韩元。1月至9月期间，税收收入达到385万亿韩元，较上年同期增加95.4万亿韩元。受国内企业盈利强劲带动，企业所得税收入增加51.9万亿韩元。国内企业发放奖金和住房交易增加，推动所得税收入增长15.7万亿韩元。非税收收入和基金收入较上年同期分别增加9.3万亿韩元和19.9万亿韩元。前九个月政府支出总额为584.9万亿韩元，较上年同期增加40.7万亿韩元。截至9月底，中央政府未偿债务为1369.4万亿韩元，较上月减少2.7万亿韩元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will attend summits of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) next week, his national security adviser said Thursday. The South Korean president will depart Monday first for Manila where he will attend the ASEAN summit until Tuesday, followed by a two-day trip to China's Shenzhen beginning Wednesday, where he will attend the APEC summit, National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac told a briefing.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国总统李在明将于下周出席东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）和亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会，其国家安全顾问周四表示。韩国总统将于周一先行前往马尼拉，参加截至周二举行的东盟峰会，随后自周三开始赴中国深圳展开为期两天的行程，并在那里出席亚太经合组织峰会。国家安全顾问魏圣洛在记者会上说。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will attend summits of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) next week, his national security adviser said Thursday. The South Korean president will depart Monday first for Manila where he will attend the ASEAN summit until Tuesday, followed by a two-day trip to China's Shenzhen beginning Wednesday, where he will attend the APEC summit, National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac told a briefing. On Monday, Lee plans to hold discussions with ASEAN countries on ways to enhance cooperation during a South Korea-ASEAN summit, followed by a meeting with leaders of five Mekong countries — Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam. During the summit with the Mekong countries, the South Korean president plans to express his commitment to strengthening strategic partnership with the countries and discuss ways to enhance cooperation in critical minerals, responses to transnational crimes and others, Wi said. The following day, Lee will attend the ASEAN Plus Three summit, which will bring together the heads of state of ASEAN member countries, as well as South Korea, Japan and China, and later the East Asia Summit to discuss regional issues. Arriving in Shenzhen on Wednesday, the South Korean president will attend an APEC CEO summit, followed by a welcoming dinner hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan. The following day, he will attend the APEC summit and take part in discussions under this year's theme, "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together," before returning home the same day. In his remarks at the summit, Lee will stress South Korea's pledge to play a constructive role in developing APEC and promoting the prosperity of the Asia-Pacific region, the national security adviser noted. At the upcoming summits, Lee also plans to strengthen mutual trust and cooperation with other heads of state through bilateral and multilateral meetings while highlighting South Korea's contributions to resolving regional challenges, including energy supply chains, transnational crimes and food security, according to Wi. The president also plans to call on ASEAN and APEC member countries to support Seoul's peaceful coexistence policy toward North Korea and convey a "positive message" in favor of peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, the official noted. A presidential official separately said that North Korea is unlikely to attend next week's APEC summit to hold talks with the United States. "It would be difficult to say there is zero possibility of talks (between North Korea and the U.S.), but I think the probability might not be high," the official said on condition of anonymity. The North is, in particular, unlikely to attend next week's APEC summit, the official said, adding that the chances of talks between the two sides during the summit are slim

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 消息人士周四表示，随着平壤与北京加强联系并扩大高层交往，朝鲜驻北京大使馆近期似乎进行了扩建和翻修。该使馆的翻修工程多次引发关注，因为在国家领导人出访海外期间有时会造访本国驻外机构，这可能表明朝方正为金正恩可能访京做准备。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea's Embassy in Beijing appears to have undergone expansion and renovation work recently amid strengthening ties and growing high-level exchanges between Pyongyang and Beijing, sources said Thursday. The interior expansion work involved two buildings, reportedly including dormitory facilities, with some of the work being detected around the time of leader Kim Jong-un's surprise visit to the Chinese city of Dandong last month, according to sources familiar with the matter. Construction safety netting was seen around buildings inside the embassy compound and near its main gate. The sources also said there were indications that Pyongyang had sought contributions from North Koreans staying in China to help cover the costs. Renovation work at the embassy has often drawn attention as it could be a sign of preparations for Kim's possible trip to Beijing, given that heads of state sometimes visit their country's diplomatic missions during their overseas trips. The renovation work came as North Korea and China have stepped up efforts to strengthen bilateral ties through a series of high-level exchanges and concrete steps to expand cross-border cooperation. During a summit in Pyongyang in June, Kim and Chinese President Xi Jinping pledged to elevate bilateral ties to a strategic level and expand cooperation in various fields. The New Amnok River Bridge, linking the North Korean border city of Sinuiju with Dandong, officially opened in mid-October, marking a major step toward revitalizing economic ties. The four-lane bridge was completed in 2014 but remained unused for more than a decade. During his visit to Dandong via the bridge, Kim met with China's top political adviser, Wang Huning, and voiced hope for expanding the two countries' historic friendship and practical cooperation, according to the North's state media. More recently, Kim Song-nam, a senior ruling Workers' Party official in charge of international affairs, traveled to China, while a Chinese Communist Party delegation also visited Pyongyang, underscoring active party-to-party exchanges
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 中朝关系趋近之际，朝鲜驻中国大使馆翻新
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 消息人士周四表示，随着平壤与北京加强联系、两国高层交流日益频繁，朝鲜驻北京大使馆近期似乎进行了扩建和翻修工程。据知情人士介绍，馆内扩建工程涉及两栋建筑，据称包括宿舍设施；其中部分工程是在朝鲜领导人金正恩上个月突然访问中国丹东市前后被发现的。大使馆院区内建筑周围及其正门附近可见施工安全网。消息人士还表示，有迹象显示，平壤方面曾向旅居中国的朝鲜人募集资金，以协助分担工程费用。大使馆翻修工程经常引起外界关注，因为鉴于国家元首在海外访问期间有时会视察本国驻外机构，这可能预示着金正恩可能准备访问北京。此次翻修工程正值朝鲜和中国通过一系列高层交流以及扩大跨境合作的实际行动，努力加强双边关系。6月在平壤举行的峰会上，金正恩与中国国家主席习近平承诺将双边关系提升至战略水平，并扩大两国在各个领域的合作。连接朝鲜边境城市新义州与中国丹东的新安鸭绿江大桥于10月中旬正式通车，标志着两国经济关系复苏迈出了重要一步。这座四车道大桥于2014年建成，但此后十余年一直未投入使用。据朝鲜官方媒体报道，金正恩经由该桥访问丹东期间，会见了中国最高政治顾问王沪宁，并表示希望扩大两国的传统友谊和务实合作。最近，朝鲜 ruling Workers' Party 负责国际事务的高级官员金成男访问了中国，中国共产党代表团也访问了平壤，凸显了两党之间活跃的党际交流……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — South Korea's top envoy to the United States on Wednesday reaffirmed Seoul's willingness to cooperate on a proposed Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project while emphasizing commercial and legal conditions for participation. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——韩国常驻美国最高特使周三再次表示，首尔愿意就拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目开展合作，同时强调参与该项目所需满足的商业和法律条件。首尔与华盛顿在该拟议项目所处阶段的问题上存在分歧。白宫此前曾表示，有540亿美元与阿拉斯加项目挂钩，但首尔一直坚持，其参与该项目的决定仍须以商业可行性评估结果为前提。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea's top envoy to the United States on Wednesday reaffirmed Seoul's willingness to cooperate on a proposed Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project while emphasizing commercial and legal conditions for participation. Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha made the remarks in an opinion piece published in the Washington Post, outlining progress in South Korea's US$350 billion investment commitment to the U.S. "Korea and the U.S. have also agreed to commence working on the Alaska LNG project, subject to meeting commercial reasonableness and applicable domestic legal requirements," Kang wrote. Her remarks came amid differences between Seoul and Washington over the status of the proposed project. The White House previously said $54 billion was tied to the Alaska project, but Seoul has maintained that its participation remains subject to a commercial viability review. Kang did not specify an investment figure for the Alaska project, even as she outlined financial commitments for other major energy initiatives in the United States. She said the two governments had agreed on a framework for up to $120 billion in Korean investment to build eight large-scale nuclear reactors in the United States. "This would involve up to $120 billion in Korean investment in eight large-scale reactors to be built by Korean and American companies," she wrote. Kang also stressed the importance of mutual trust and honoring commitments as the alliance expands into advanced technologies and other strategic sectors. "As our cooperation expands into advanced technologies and other strategic sectors, long-term success will depend not simply on short-term opportunities but on reliable partners and mutual confidence that commitments will be honored," she wrote. Last month, U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to "charge" South Korea "more" if it does not agree to invest in the Alaska project. "If they don't want to do it, that's okay with me. I'll just charge them more," Trump said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 韩国特使重申首尔对拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气项目采取有条件支持的立场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——韩国常驻美国大使姜京华周三表示，韩国愿意就拟议中的阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目开展合作，同时强调参与该项目的商业和法律条件。姜京华在《华盛顿邮报》刊登的评论文章中说明了韩国承诺向美国投资3500亿美元的进展，并概述了双方在相关问题上的立场。姜京华写道：“韩国和美国也已同意启动阿拉斯加LNG项目，但前提是符合商业合理性并满足适用的国内法律要求。”她的表态正值首尔与华盛顿就该拟议项目的现状存在分歧之际。白宫此前表示，有540亿美元与阿拉斯加项目挂钩，但首尔一直坚持，其参与仍须接受商业可行性审查。姜京华没有说明阿拉斯加项目的投资金额，同时概述了韩国对美国其他重大能源项目的资金承诺。她说，两国政府已就韩国在美国投资最多1200亿美元建设8座大型核反应堆达成框架协议。她写道：“这将涉及韩国投资最多1200亿美元，用于建设由韩国和美国企业承建的8座大型反应堆。”姜京华还强调，随着同盟关系拓展至先进技术及其他战略领域， mutual信任和信守承诺十分重要。她写道：“随着我们的合作拓展至先进技术及其他战略领域，长期成功不仅取决于短期机会，也取决于可靠的伙伴，以及彼此相信各方会信守承诺。”上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁称，如果韩国不同意投资阿拉斯加项目，他就会让韩国“付出更多”。特朗普说：“如果他们不想这么做，我也没问题。我只会让他们付出更多。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国海军一名高级指挥官强调，与韩国开展教育和培训合作的重要性，称两国水兵之间的联系是对双边联盟的持久投资。据周一发布的一份美国军方报告，美国海军教育与训练司令部司令Greg Huffman于10月27日在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海军航空站韩国海军训练舰ROKS Hansando上举行的招待会上表示了上述观点。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — A senior U.S. Navy commander has highlighted the importance of education and training cooperation with South Korea, describing ties between sailors of the two countries as a lasting investment in the bilateral alliance. "The friendships formed during this voyage are among the most lasting and mutually beneficial investments our alliance can make," Rear Adm. Greg Huffman, commander of the U.S. Naval Education and Training Command, said during an Oct. 27 reception aboard South Korea's naval training ship ROKS Hansando at Naval Air Station Pensacola in Florida, according to a U.S. military report released Monday. During the visit, Huffman also met with senior South Korean naval officers, including Vice Adm. Park Kyu-paek, superintendent of the Korea Naval Academy, and Rear Adm. Kim Joon-yup, commander of the South Korean Navy's Cruise Training Task Group. "Our mission is fundamentally about people - recruiting, training, educating and developing sailors to serve with competence, character and confidence," Huffman said. "This development is not confined to a classroom; it is a career-long journey that is immeasurably strengthened when we learn alongside trusted allies." The visit followed a series of exchanges between the two countries' naval education and training commands, including a September 2025 visit to Pensacola by South Korean Vice Adm. Kang Jeong-ho and Huffman's visit to Jinhae, South Korea, in September this year. During his visit to Jinhae, Huffman held discussions with South Korean naval officials on professional military education, personnel development and opportunities for continued cooperation, according to the report. South Korean sailors aboard the Hansando also visited Veterans Memorial Park in Pensacola on, where they laid a wreath at the Korean War Memorial to honor those who served in the 1950-53 conflict
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国海军司令在访问韩国期间强调与韩国的训练合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国海军一名高级指挥官强调了与韩国开展教育和培训合作的重要性，称两国水兵之间的联系是双方联盟的一项持久投资。美国海军教育与训练司令部司令、海军少将格雷格·赫夫曼周一发布的一份美国军方报告显示，10月27日，他在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉海军航空站举行的招待会上表示：“此次航行中建立的友谊，是我们的联盟所能作出的最持久、最有利于双方的投资之一。”招待会在韩国海军训练舰“汉山岛”号上举行。访问期间，赫夫曼还会见了韩国海军多名高级军官，包括韩国海军学院院长朴圭白海军中将和韩国海军巡航训练特遣队司令金俊燮海军少将。赫夫曼说：“我们的使命本质上关乎人才——招募水兵、开展培训和教育，培养他们以胜任、品格和自信履行使命。这种培养并不局限于课堂，而是一段贯穿职业生涯的历程；当我们与值得信赖的盟友一起学习时，这种培养会得到无法估量的加强。”此次访问是在两国海军教育与训练司令部进行一系列交流之后开展的，其中包括韩国海军中将姜正浩于2025年9月访问彭萨科拉，以及赫夫曼今年9月访问韩国金海。根据报告，赫夫曼在金海访问期间与韩国海军官员讨论了职业军事教育、人才培养以及继续合作的机会。韩国水兵还在彭萨科拉参观了退伍军人纪念公园，并在朝鲜战争纪念碑前敬献花圈，以纪念参加1950年至1953年冲突的人员

https://www.politico.eu/article/poland-s.body: Poland's defense minister said Tuesday that the Pentagon had given a “green light” to plans for a permanent U.S. military base in the country, with President Donald Trump expected to make a final decision in early December. Speaking after talks with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in Washington, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said his American counterpart told him that “everything is moving in the right direction.” “We interpret that as a green light from the Pentagon,” he said. The project has not yet received formal U.S. approval. The Pentagon’s own account stopped short of endorsing the base or confirming the December timetable, but acknowledged ongoing talks about strengthening the permanent U.S. military presence in Poland. Hegseth praised Poland’s military buildup, calling its army “one of the most formidable” in Europe. He also pushed for European NATO allies to take greater responsibility for their own defense, potentially allowing Washington to reduce its troop presence on the continent. Poland already hosts thousands of American troops, largely on rotating deployments. But Warsaw is pushing for a permanent base as the Pentagon reviews its military presence across Europe, with other NATO allies fearing Trump could withdraw thousands more troops . The review is expected to conclude by December. The project is also a rare point of agreement between Poland's feuding leaders. Prime Minister Donald Tusk and President Karol Nawrocki — a Trump ally whom the U.S. president backed in last year's election — agreed last week to cooperate on securing the base, despite their bitter confrontation over control of Poland's top court. Nawrocki has embraced the proposed name “Fort Trump,” first floated by his predecessor, Andrzej Duda, in 2018. The U.S. Department of Defense didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment

https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.summary: Accord Party presidential candidate, Dr. Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim, has told the United States Congress and the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) that protecting every Nigerian’s right to worship freely must become a central pillar of the country’s security and conflict prevention strategy.
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.summary_zh: Accord党总统候选人 Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim 博士告诉美国国会和美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF），保护每一位尼日利亚人自由礼拜的权利，必须成为该国安全与冲突预防战略的核心支柱。
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.body: Accord Party presidential candidate, Dr. Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim, has told the United States Congress and the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) that protecting every Nigerian’s right to worship freely must become a central pillar of the country’s security and conflict prevention strategy. In a policy brief submitted ahead of a US House Hearing on Nigeria, yesterday, Olawepo-Hashim acknowledged the persecution of Christians in parts of the country, including attacks on churches, killings of pastors and destruction of communities. He, however, cautioned against presenting Nigeria’s religious crisis solely as a conflict between Christians and Muslims, a statement from his media office disclosed on Wednesday. “Christians in northern and central Nigeria face persecution. Churches have been burned, villages destroyed, and pastors killed. This is real,” he said. He continued, “But Shia Muslims, minority sects, and Hausa Muslim communities also face persecution and discrimination. Framing Nigeria as Christians versus Muslims divides Nigeria. Framing it as all victims versus violent extremism unites Nigeria.” He argued that religious freedom should be treated not only as a human rights issue but also as an instrument of conflict prevention and national security. “When people cannot worship freely, they feel excluded. When killers are not punished, impunity grows. When impunity grows, communities form militias. When militias grow, extremists recruit from them,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim said that, if elected, his administration would develop and implement a National Policy Framework on Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism. Within its first 90 days, he proposed convening a National Summit involving victims, the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), the Nigeria Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs (NSCIA), Shia leaders, Hausa cultural representatives, women, young people and internally displaced persons. He also pledged to pursue a National Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism Act within 180 days of assuming office. The proposed legislation, he said, would criminalise religious persecution, hate incitement and forced displacement. Another proposal is an Independent National Commission, with offices in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, reporting to the National Assembly. Under the proposed arrangement, attacks would be investigated within 30 days, findings made public and victims compensated. Olawepo-Hashim also proposed establishing a National Guard to protect vulnerable villages, farms, schools and places of worship. He added that the broader security programme would support the return of displaced people and the rebuilding of destroyed communities, including those in Shanga, Plateau, Benue, Kaduna and Borno. “This is a Nigerian solution for Nigeria and a model for West Africa and Africa,” he said. The Accord candidate called on the United States to partner with Nigeria in convening an International Conference on Security in Nigeria and the Sahel within the first 100 days of his presidency, if elected. The proposed conference would bring together ECOWAS, the African Union, the United States and other international partners to develop a coordinated strategy covering religious freedom, conflict prevention, intelligence sharing, border security and countering violent extremism. “Nigeria should lead, with the United States as partner. If Nigeria gets this right, West Africa and Africa will follow,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim linked religious freedom and national security to the credibility of the 2027 general elections, warning that political intimidation, incitement and electoral malpractice could deepen existing divisions. “Free, fair, transparent and credible elections mean no religious violence, no intimidation, no incitement and no rigging,” he said. Citing the recent attack on activist and political figure Omoyele Sowore in Ekiti, he warned against allowing political violence to compound the country’s insecurity. “Election rigging is itself a threat to religious freedom, conflict prevention and human rights. A rigged election does not just steal votes; it steals peace.” He urged the United States to support Nigeria’s electoral process through sustained engagement, international observation, technical assistance to the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) and support for civil society. “This is not a request for America to choose Nigeria’s leader. It is a request for America to help Nigerians choose their own leader, free from religious and political violence, intimidation and rigging,” he said. Olawepo-Hashim maintained that Nigeria must lead efforts to demonstrate that religious freedom is not a foreign concept but an African value. “Religious freedom cannot be protected while Boko Haram, ISWAP, Ansaru and bandit terror networks operate with impunity. https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.title_zh: Olawepo-Hashim告诉美国国会：我将保护尼日利亚的所有信仰
https://leadership.ng/i-will-protect-all.body_zh: 协和党总统候选人、博士Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim告诉美国国会和美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF），保护每一名尼日利亚公民自由礼拜的权利，必须成为该国安全与防止冲突战略的核心支柱。Olawepo-Hashim在美国众议院昨日举行的尼日利亚问题听证会前提交的一份政策简报中承认，该国部分地区基督徒遭受迫害，包括针对教堂的袭击、牧师遇害以及社区被毁。然而，他的媒体办公室周三发布的一份声明称，他警告不要将尼日利亚的宗教危机仅仅描述为基督徒与穆斯林之间的冲突。他说：“尼日利亚北部和中部的基督徒遭受迫害。教堂被烧毁，村庄被毁，牧师被杀。这是事实。”他继续说：“但什叶派穆斯林、少数教派和豪萨穆斯林社区也遭受迫害和歧视。将尼日利亚描绘成基督徒对穆斯林会撕裂尼日利亚。将它描绘成所有受害者对暴力极端主义，则能团结尼日利亚。”他认为，宗教自由不仅应被视为人权问题，也应被视为防止冲突和维护国家安全的工具。他说：“当人们无法自由礼拜时，他们会感到自己遭到排斥。当杀人者不受惩罚时，逍遥法外便会加剧。当逍遥法外加剧时，社区就会组织民兵。当民兵壮大时，极端分子就会从中招募人员。”Olawepo-Hashim表示，如果当选，他的政府将制定并实施《防止冲突与打击暴力极端主义宗教自由国家政策框架》。他提议在就职后的前90天内召开一次全国峰会，邀请受害者、尼日利亚基督徒协会（CAN）、尼日利亚伊斯兰事务最高委员会（NSCIA）、什叶派领袖、豪萨文化代表、妇女、青年和境内流离失所者参加。他还承诺在就任180天内推动制定《防止冲突与打击暴力极端主义宗教自由国家法》。他说，拟议立法将把宗教迫害、煽动仇恨和强迫流离失所定为犯罪。另一项提议是成立一个独立的国家委员会，在全部36个州及联邦首都区设立办公室，并向全国议会报告。根据拟议安排，袭击事件将在30天内得到调查，调查结果将予以公布，受害者将获得赔偿。Olawepo-Hashim还提议成立国家卫队，以保护易受攻击的村庄、农场、学校和礼拜场所。他补充说，更广泛的安全计划将支持流离失所者返回家园以及重建被毁社区，包括Shanga、Plateau、Benue、Kaduna和Borno的社区。他说：“这是为尼日利亚制定的尼日利亚方案，也是西非和非洲的典范。”这位协和党候选人呼吁美国在竞选中胜出后的前100天内，与尼日利亚合作召开尼日利亚和萨赫勒安全国际会议。拟议会议将汇集西非国家经济共同体、非洲联盟、美国及其他国际伙伴，制定协调战略，涵盖宗教自由、防止冲突、情报共享、边境安全和打击暴力极端主义。他说：“应由尼日利亚牵头，美国担任伙伴。如果尼日利亚把这件事做好，西非和非洲就会跟上。”Olawepo-Hashim把宗教自由与国家安全同2027年大选的可信度联系起来，警告政治恐吓、煽动和选举舞弊可能加深现有分裂。他说：“自由、公平、透明且可信的选举意味着没有宗教暴力、没有恐吓、没有煽动、没有舞弊。”他提到Ekiti最近针对活动人士和政治人物Omoyele Sowore的袭击，警告不要让政治暴力加剧该国的安全困境。他说：“选举舞弊本身就是对宗教自由、防止冲突和人权的威胁。舞弊选举夺走的不只是选票，还是和平。”他敦促美国通过持续接触、国际观察、向独立国家选举委员会（INEC）提供技术援助以及支持民间社会等方式，支持尼日利亚的选举进程。他说：“这不是要求美国替尼日利亚选择领导人，而是要求美国帮助尼日利亚人自由、不受宗教和政治暴力、恐吓及舞弊威胁，选择自己的领导人。”Olawepo-Hashim坚持认为，尼日利亚必须带头证明宗教自由并非外来概念，而是非洲价值观。他说：“在博科哈拉姆、伊斯兰国西非省、Ansaru和匪徒恐怖网络逍遥法外的情况下，宗教自由无法得到保护。打击暴力极端主义就是保护宗教自由。”他最后总结道。抢先获取最新动态。实时报道、突发独家消息和独到视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，获取全天候更新 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 总统Bola Tinubu于星期三敦促奥多州选民，确保他在2027年1月16日总统选举中以至少120万张选票获胜。总统Tinubu由副总统Kashim Shettima代表出席并发表讲话。他说，在该州登记的210万选民中，预计奥多州将投给他不少于120万票。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: President Bola Tinubu , on Wednesday, urged voters in Ondo State to ensure his return with at least 1.2 million votes in the 16 January 2027 presidential election. The president spoke at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Akure on Wednesday. Represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima, President Tinubu said he expected no less than 1.2 million votes from Ondo out of the 2.1 million registered voters in the state. INEC declared that about 1.8 million voters have collected their Permanent Voter Cards in the state, leaving about 200,000 cards uncollected a few months before the election. “It is our expectation that Ondo should be able to deliver 1.2 million votes out of the 1.8 million PVCs collected so far,” he said. He also mocked his political opponents, such as Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the National Democratic Party (NDC), respectively, as lacking the competence and consensus to lead the country. “Looking at the rally today in Ondo, it is shut down. Our political opponents are conducting rallies on Instagram and Facebook,” he said. He also noted that Atiku, who hails from Adamawa State, has no alignment with most notable leaders in his state and therefore lacks the capacity to lead the country. The president said the same about Mr Obi, whom he described as lacking the support of former and present governors of Anambra State. “That you have the ability to import cheap wine from South Africa, does not mean you can govern Nigeria,” The president said of Mr Obi, adding that the country had fared better under the current administration and deserving the votes of all Nigerians. The Ondo State Governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa, while delivering his welcome address, promised that the state would ensure it delivered nothing less than one million votes for President Tinubu during the election. He said the president’s reforms had trickled down to the masses of Ondo in the form of developments, including key appointments such as three ministers and heads of agencies. But the Director General of the Tinubu Presidential Campaign Council, Abdullaziz Yari, said that, given the benefits accruing to Ondo State from the Tinubu administration, the president deserved more than one million votes from the state. Mr Yari urged party leaders and other members to unite to ensure they deliver the maximum votes in January. Earlier, the Chairman of the Progressives Governors Forum and Governor of Imo State, Hope Uzodima, while addressing the rally, urged Ondo voters to collect their PVCs if they want to deliver the pledged one million votes. He also urged the various groups within the party to close ranks and end the bickering in order to be able to garner the required votes for the president. Senate Leader, Opeyemi Bamidele, also harped on unity among leaders of the party in Ondo State following reports that there are various factions running parallel campaigns for the president. Mr Bamidele, an indigene of the neighbouring Ekiti State, said he had a message from President Tinubu to Ondo APC, urging party leaders to recognise the governor as the coordinator of the campaigns in the state and to team up with him to deliver votes during the election. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 博拉·蒂努布总统周三敦促奥恩多州选民，在2027年1月16日总统选举中确保他至少获得120万张选票。总统于周三在阿库雷举行的全体进步大会党总统竞选集会上发表讲话。副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马代表蒂努布总统出席。蒂努布总统表示，在该州210万名登记选民中，他预计奥恩多州将至少投出120万票。独立国家选举委员会宣布，该州约有180万名选民已经领取永久选民卡，距离选举还有数月，仍有约20万张选民卡尚未领取。他说：“我们期望奥恩多州能够从目前已领取的180万张永久选民卡中投出120万票。”他还嘲讽了非洲民主大会党的阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和人民民主党的彼得·奥比，称他们缺乏领导国家的能力和共识。他说：“看看今天奥恩多州的集会，它已经关闭了。我们的政治对手却是在Instagram和Facebook上举办集会。”他还指出，来自阿达瓦瓦州的阿提库没有得到该州大多数知名领导人的支持，因此缺乏领导国家的能力。总统对奥比先生也表达了同样的看法，称他缺乏阿南布拉州前任和现任州长的支持。总统谈到奥比先生时表示：“你能从南非进口廉价葡萄酒，并不意味着你能够治理尼日利亚。”他补充说，国家在现任政府治理下取得了更好的成效，理应获得所有尼日利亚人的选票。奥恩多州州长拉基·艾耶达蒂瓦在欢迎词中承诺，该州将在选举中确保为蒂努布总统投出不少于100万票。他说，总统推行的改革已经惠及奥恩多州民众，体现在多项发展成就中，包括任命三名部长和各机构负责人。不过，蒂努布总统竞选委员会主任阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里表示，鉴于蒂努布政府为奥恩多州带来的益处，总统理应获得该州超过100万张选票。亚里先生敦促党内领导人和其他成员团结起来，确保在1月为总统争取到尽可能多的选票。此前，进步州长论坛主席、伊莫州州长霍普·乌佐迪马在集会上发言，敦促奥恩多州选民领取永久选民卡，如果他们希望兑现承诺的100万票。他还敦促党内各个团体加强团结、停止争执，以便为总统争取到所需选票。参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱也强调，在有关奥恩多州存在多个派别为总统分别开展竞选活动的报道之后，党内领导人必须团结一致。巴米德莱先生是邻近的埃基蒂州本地人。他说，他带来了蒂努布总统给奥恩多州全体进步大会党成员的信息，敦促党内领导人承认州长是该州竞选活动的协调人，并与州长携手合作，在选举中争取选票。奥恩多州和埃多州前州长奥卢塞贡·米米科与阿德姆斯·奥希奥莫雷，以及拉各斯州州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢出席了集会。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 Nigeria produced an average of 1.687 million barrels of crude oil and condensate per day in October 2026, the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has said. Data released by the commission on Wednesday showed that daily production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day (bpd), while the lowest output during the month was 1.60 million bpd. The data showed that crude oil production, excluding condensate, averaged 1.51 million barrels per day (mbpd) during the review period. This represented 101 per cent of Nigeria’s 1.5 million bpd production quota allocated by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). According to the report, Nigeria had met its assigned OPEC crude oil production quota for six consecutive months. It said the country produced 1.53 million bpd in May, 1.55 million bpd in June, 1.51 million bpd in July, 1.50 million bpd in August, 1.53 million bpd in September and 1.51 million bpd in October. The report, however, indicated a 1.7 per cent month-on-month decline in crude oil production. It attributed the relatively stable performance in recent months to improved operational stability, production uptime and crude evacuation efficiency. The commission said the sustained performance in October reflected the commitment of operators and industry stakeholders to improving operational efficiency, maintaining asset integrity and enhancing production reliability across the upstream sector. A breakdown of daily average crude oil and condensate production by terminals and streams showed that Forcados Terminal recorded the highest output of 318.49 thousand barrels per day (kbpd). Bonny Terminal followed with 311.02 kbpd, while Qua Iboe Terminal recorded 173.97 kbpd. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚原油产量达到168万桶/日
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）表示，尼日利亚第一层油田在2026年10月平均每日生产原油和凝析油168.7万桶。该委员会周三发布的数据显示，日产量最高达到179万桶（bpd），当月最低产量为160万桶。数据显示，在审查期内，不含凝析油的原油日均产量为151万桶（mbpd），相当于石油输出国组织（OPEC）分配给尼日利亚的150万桶日产量配额的101%。报告称，尼日利亚已连续6个月完成其获分配的OPEC原油产量配额。该国5月产量为153万桶/日，6月为155万桶/日，7月为151万桶/日，8月为150万桶/日，9月为153万桶/日，10月为151万桶/日。然而，报告指出，原油产量环比下降1.7%。报告将近几个月相对稳定的表现归因于运营稳定性、生产设备可用率及原油外输效率的改善。该委员会表示，10月持续稳定的表现反映了运营商和行业利益相关方为提高运营效率、维护资产完整性以及增强上游行业生产可靠性所作的承诺。按终端和油流划分的原油及凝析油日均产量明细显示，Forcados Terminal产量最高，达到31.849万桶/日（kbpd）。Bonny Terminal以31.102万桶/日紧随其后，Qua Iboe Terminal产量为17.397万桶/日。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报社或其任何员工的观点

Second Vice Science Minister Ryu Je-myung made the remarks at a congratulatory address during an AI conference hosted by the ministry in Seoul as he mentioned growing concerns in the United States that the incoming Democratic Congress could tighten regulations on AI and data centers.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 一位科技部高级官员周三表示，美国中期选举后围绕人工智能（AI）投资出现的新不确定性，可能为韩国提供“黄金机遇”。科技部第二副部长柳济明在首尔由该部主办的人工智能会议上发表祝贺致辞时提到，美国日益担忧即将上任的民主党国会可能会收紧对人工智能和数据中心的监管。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Fresh uncertainties surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) investments following the US midterms could provide a "golden opportunity" for Korea, a high-level science ministry official said Wednesday. Second Vice Science Minister Ryu Je-myung made the remarks at a congratulatory address during an AI conference hosted by the ministry in Seoul as he mentioned growing concerns in the United States that the incoming Democratic Congress could tighten regulations on AI and data centers. "There are observations that market uncertainty could increase amid potential changes in the investment environment for AI and data centers (following the US midterms)," Ryu said at the event. "It (actually) provides a golden opportunity to narrow our gap with leading countries and secure overwhelming national AI competitiveness through aggressive and speedy investments and technological innovation," he added. To that end, the government is considering doubling the amount of funding for the AI sector to around 9.4 trillion won next year, he said. "South Korea is a major research and development powerhouse, whose funding for the R&D sector accounts for over 5 percent of the country's gross domestic product," Ryu pointed out. Meanwhile, markets have been rattled with worries that the Democrats' sweeping victory in the US midterm elections could lead to a slowdown in the building of AI data centers. Such fears have sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq down by more than 5 percent. Local semiconductor giants suffered as well, with Samsung Electronics and SK hynix both shedding over 3 percent, following the election results
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国第二副科学部长： 美国中期选举后的人工智能不确定性是韩国的“黄金机遇”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 一位高级科学部门官员周三表示，美国中期选举后围绕人工智能投资出现的新不确定性，可能为韩国提供“黄金机遇”。第二科学技术次官柳在明在首尔举行的一场人工智能会议上致贺辞时表示，美国日益担心新一届民主党国会可能收紧对人工智能和数据中心的监管。他说：“有观点认为，在美国中期选举后，人工智能和数据中心投资环境可能发生变化，市场不确定性随之加剧。这实际上为我们提供了缩小与领先国家差距的黄金机遇，通过积极、快速的投资和技术创新，确立压倒性的国家人工智能竞争力。”他补充说，为实现这一目标，政府正考虑明年将人工智能领域的资助金额翻倍，增加至约9.4万亿韩元。柳指出：“韩国是重要的研发强国，研发领域的资助额占国内生产总值的5%以上。”与此同时，市场因担忧民主党在美国中期选举中取得压倒性胜利可能拖慢人工智能数据中心建设而受到冲击。这些担忧已令科技股占比较高的纳斯达克指数下跌逾5%。选举结果公布后，本地半导体巨头也遭受重创，Samsung Electronics和SK hynix的股价均下跌逾3%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il on Wednesday called for South Korea's financial attaches in overseas missions to closely monitor the impact of the U.S. midterm elections on the global economy, including how individual countries are responding. Lee made the remarks during his first meeting with financial attaches at 18 overseas missions since taking office in September, held virtually to review the latest economic trends in major countries, according to the Ministry of Finance and Economy. During the meeting, Lee stressed that South Korea faces external uncertainties, including fiscal instability in Europe and global geopolitical tensions, despite the country's robust exports. "In order to turn recent achievements into sustainable growth, we need to preemptively identify changes in the external environment and take steps to address risks in advance," Lee said during the meeting. "We also need to focus on how changes in the political landscape following the U.S. midterm elections will affect the Trump administration's policy direction," the finance minister added, asking the attaches to closely monitor relevant developments. The finance minister also called for the attaches to closely watch the fiscal crisis in France and its potential impact on the global economy, as well as global supply chains amid the Russia-Ukraine war and the U.S.-Iran war. The finance ministry said it will continue to communicate closely with the financial attaches to review economic and policy trends in major countries and proactively respond to external risks

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: HD Construction Equipment has joined hands with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs to honor Ethiopian soldiers who fought and died during the 1950-53 Korean War, unveiling a memorial wall bearing their names at Holy Trinity Cathedral in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company said it held a ceremony to dedicate the memorial wall at the cathedral on Wednesday, coinciding with the International Memorial Day for U.N. Korean War Veterans. The event was attended by HD Construction Equipment CEO Moon Jae-young, Veterans Minister Kwon Oh-eul, Korean Ambassador to Ethiopia Koo Hong-seok, Ethiopian defense officials and Korean War veterans and their families. HD Construction Equipment and the veterans ministry signed a memorandum of understanding in May to establish memorial facilities in countries that sent troops to support Korea under U.N. Command. Ethiopia was selected as the first site, with HD Construction Equipment covering the full cost of construction. The wall features individual plaques inscribed with the names of the 122 fallen soldiers, as well as messages of gratitude and remembrance in Korean, English and Amharic, Ethiopia's official working language. It also includes a bronze relief depicting members of the Kagnew Battalion marching alongside Ethiopia’s national symbol, the lion. "It is deeply meaningful to permanently inscribe the names of Ethiopian heroes who gave their lives defending Korea's freedom and peace,” Kwon said in his congratulatory remarks for the event. “The government will continue to honor the U.N. veterans who demonstrated extraordinary solidarity and humanity across national borders and do its utmost to ensure that future generations in Korea and the countries that sent troops remember and carry forward the legacy of their service and solidarity." Alongside the memorial project, HD Construction Equipment will expand its cooperation with Ethiopia by supporting efforts to train local workers and develop skills needed for the country's infrastructure and industrial sectors. The company is working with local institutions to establish a training center to develop skilled construction equipment operators and maintenance technicians. The center will provide training in equipment operation and maintenance to local young people, including descendants of Korean War veterans, helping develop skilled workers and expand employment opportunities. “I hope the memorial wall will serve as a place to remember the noble sacrifices of Ethiopian veterans who fought for Korea and pass on their spirit to future generations,” Moon said. Ethiopia was the only African country to deploy ground troops to the Korean War. Its elite Kagnew Battalion, made up of imperial guards, sent about 3,500 soldiers to the conflict and recorded 253 victories in 253 engagements. A total of 122 Ethiopian soldiers were killed

Unlock these with Subscription Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka said the State government was making efforts to open several of the 105 Young India Integrated Residential Schools from the next academic year, with construction works progressing at a brisk pace. The government had sanctioned 105 schools across the State at an estimated cost of ₹200 crore each as part of its efforts to provide quality education to children, irrespective of their socio-economic background, he said. Speaking after laying the foundation stone for a Telangana Public School building at the Government Boys’ School in Kazipet on Wednesday (November 11, 2026), under the Warangal West Assembly constituency, Mr. Vikramarka said the government was determined to develop an education system comparable to those in the world’s top 10 developed countries. Referring to the Telangana Public Schools initiative, the Deputy Chief Minister said one school had been sanctioned for each Assembly constituency. These institutions would offer English-medium education from pre-primary to Class 12, with digital classrooms, modern teaching methods, trained teachers and other facilities. The schools would function under a semi-residential model, under which the government would provide uniforms, shoes, textbooks, notebooks, school bags and transportation facilities. Students would receive breakfast and lunch at school and return home in the evening after sports and other activities. Mr. Vikramarka said the model was designed to provide quality education without depriving children of the opportunity to spend time with their families. He said the government had introduced a breakfast scheme for nearly 27 lakh students studying in government schools across the State this year. Providing breakfast to such a large number of students within an hour was a unique initiative, he claimed. Recalling the contributions of India’s first Education Minister Maulana Abul Kalam Azad on his birth anniversary, Mr. Vikramarka said the government was committed to carrying forward his ideals of promoting education and scientific knowledge. 特伦甘纳邦副首席部长马卢·巴蒂·维克拉马尔卡表示，邦政府正努力从下一学年起开办105所“青年印度综合寄宿学校”中的数所学校，目前施工进展迅速。他说，作为为不同社会经济背景儿童提供优质教育努力的一部分，邦政府已批准在全邦设立105所学校，每所估算成本为₹200 crore。

维克拉马尔卡于2026年11月11日星期三，在瓦朗加尔西选区 Kazipet 的政府男子学校为一栋特伦甘纳公立学校教学楼奠基后表示，邦政府决心打造一套可与世界前10个发达国家相媲美的教育体系。

谈及“特伦甘纳公立学校”计划，副首席部长表示，每个选区都已获批设立一所学校。这些机构将提供从学前教育到12年级的英语授课教育，并配备数字教室、现代教学方法、经过培训的教师及其他设施。

学校将采用半寄宿制模式，由政府提供校服、鞋子、教科书、笔记本、书包和交通设施。学生将在校享用早餐和午餐，参加体育及其他活动后于傍晚回家。维克拉马尔卡表示，这一模式旨在提供优质教育，同时不剥夺儿童与家人相处的时间。

他说，今年邦政府已在全邦政府学校推出了早餐计划，覆盖近27万名学生。他声称，在一小时内为如此大规模的学生提供早餐是一项独特举措。

值印度首任教育部长毛拉纳·阿卜杜勒·卡拉姆·阿扎德诞辰之际，维克拉马尔卡表示，邦政府致力于传承他推动教育和科学知识的理念。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Nigeria’s solid minerals sector generated more than N101 billion in revenue January through September, up from N6 billion in 2023, the Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dele Alake, has said. Mr Alake attributed the improvement to the reforms introduced by President Bola Tinubu’s administration, saying revenue from the sector rose to N38 billion in 2024 and N70 billion in 2025 before topping N101 billion in the first nine months of 2026. He disclosed the figures on Tuesday in Abuja at the unveiling of the All Progressives Congress 2027–2031 manifesto. According to the minister, figures from the Central Bank of Nigeria showed that revenue from the sector continued to rise in 2026. “When I resumed there in 2023, the total revenue that the sector generated was N6 billion. With the introduction of creative policies and reforms, within one year, in 2024, it rose to N38 billion. By 2025, it rose to N70 billion,” he said. Mr Alake said the increase demonstrates the impact of the administration’s economic policies and efforts to restructure the mining sector. The minister defended the removal of petrol subsidy and the unification of multiple exchange rates, arguing that President Tinubu has prioritised national interest over political considerations ahead of the 2027 general election. “Ordinary politicians will think of the next election and avoid contentious policies that probably could mar their political aspirations. But not President Bola Tinubu. He puts the nation ahead of self,” he noted. Mr Alake asserted that no civilian government since Nigeria’s independence in 1960 has undertaken structural reforms on the scale of the current administration. He said the new manifesto will consolidate the reforms and extend their benefits to security, healthcare, agriculture, industrialisation, manufacturing and solid minerals. The minister added that the administration’s objective is to translate macroeconomic improvements into better living conditions for Nigerians. Nigeria has deposits of several commercially valuable minerals, including lithium, gold, iron ore, limestone, barite, coal and lead-zinc, but the sector has historically contributed relatively little to the country’s overall economic output. The government has repeatedly identified mining as an alternative source of revenue and foreign exchange earnings, particularly as it seeks to reduce dependence on crude oil. However, the sector continues to face challenges, including illegal mining, weak regulation, insecurity in mining communities, limited processing capacity and inadequate geological data. The government has also been stepping up efforts to expand local processing and value addition rather than the exportation of raw mineral resources, with the aim of creating jobs and scaling up industrial activity. Also speaking at the event, the Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, urged Nigerians to support the administration’s economic reforms, saying their benefits are becoming evident across different sectors. Mr Idris cited improved security on the Abuja-Kaduna and Abuja-Kano highways, 1.6 million beneficiaries of the student loan scheme, declining inflation and rising gross domestic product as evidence of progress. He also said Nigeria’s removal from the Financial Action Task Force grey list and improved international credit ratings have strengthened investor confidence. Minister of Budget and Economic Planning Atiku Bagudu said the president believes Nigeria can attain the level of economic development recorded by countries such as Brazil. He stated that Nigerians have begun to experience the benefits of having a leader willing to take difficult decisions, particularly in implementing economic reforms

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 尼日利亚固体矿产部门今年1月至9月创造了超过1010亿奈拉的收入，高于2023年的60亿奈拉。固体矿产发展部长Dele Alake表示，这一增长得益于总统Bola Tinubu政府推出的改革。他说，该部门的收入在2024年增至380亿奈拉，2025年增至700亿奈拉，随后在2026年前九个月突破1010亿奈拉。Alake部长周二在阿布贾举行的全体进步大会党2027—2031年党纲发布活动上公布了这些数据。据部长介绍，尼日利亚中央银行的数据显示，该部门的收入在2026年持续增长。他说：“我于2023年在那里复职时，该部门创造的总收入为60亿奈拉。随着创新政策和改革的推出，仅用一年时间，到2024年，这一收入便增至380亿奈拉；到2025年，又增至700亿奈拉。”Alake部长表示，这一增长证明了政府经济政策以及重组采矿行业所作努力所产生的影响。部长还为取消汽油补贴和统一多重汇率辩护，认为在2027年大选之前，Tinubu总统把国家利益置于政治考量之上。他说：“普通政客会考虑下一次选举，回避可能损害其政治前景的争议性政策。但Bola Tinubu总统不会。他把国家置于个人利益之上。”Alake部长断言，自1960年尼日利亚独立以来，历届文职政府都没有开展过当前政府这种规模的结构性改革。他说，新党纲将巩固这些改革，并将其惠及范围扩大到安全、医疗保健、农业、工业化、制造业和固体矿产领域。部长还表示，政府的目标是把握宏观经济改善成果，改善尼日利亚民众的生活条件。尼日利亚拥有多种具有商业价值的矿产储量，包括锂、金、铁矿石、石灰石、重晶石、煤和铅锌，但该部门历来对国家整体经济产出的贡献相对较少。政府多次将采矿业确定为收入和外汇收益的替代来源，尤其是希望借此减少对原油的依赖。然而，该部门仍面临非法采矿、监管薄弱、采矿社区安全形势严峻、加工能力有限以及地质数据不足等挑战。政府也在加大力度，扩大本地加工和增值业务，而不是出口未经加工的矿产资源，以创造就业岗位并扩大工业活动。同一活动上发言的信息与国家导向部长Mohammed Idris敦促尼日利亚人支持政府经济改革，称这些改革的益处正在不同领域显现。Idris部长列举了阿布贾—卡杜纳和阿布贾—卡诺公路安全状况改善、160万人成为学生贷款计划受益者、通货膨胀率下降以及国内生产总值增长，作为取得进展的证据。他还表示，尼日利亚被金融行动特别工作组列入灰名单一事已有结果，加上国际信用评级改善，增强了投资者的信心。预算与经济规划部长Atiku Bagudu说，总统相信尼日利亚能够达到巴西等国所实现的经济发展水平。他指出，尼日利亚人已经开始享受由一位愿意作出艰难决策、特别是推动经济改革的领导人所带来的益处

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.summary: ABUJA — Members of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) on Wednesday staged a protest at the Federal High Court in Abuja, demanding the release of the Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgment nullifying the party’s National Working Committee led by former Senate President, David Mark.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.summary_zh: 阿布贾——非洲民主大会（ADC）成员周三在阿布贾联邦高等法院举行抗议，要求获发判决书核证副本；该判决推翻了由前参议院议长戴维·马克领导的该党全国工作委员会。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body: ABUJA — Members of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) on Wednesday staged a protest at the Federal High Court in Abuja, demanding the release of the Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgment nullifying the party’s National Working Committee led by former Senate President, David Mark. The protesters accused the trial judge, Justice Peter Lifu, of withholding the November 5 judgment despite an application by the party’s lawyers and payment of the prescribed fees, arguing that the delay was frustrating their efforts to challenge the ruling at the Court of Appeal. The letters bore the subject: “Urgent Appeal for Diplomatic Attention and Support for Due Process, the Right of Appeal and Credible Elections in Nigeria – Re: Judgment Delivered on 5th November, 2026 in Suit No: FHC/ABJ/CS/1819/2025 (Nafiu Bala Gombe Vs. ADC & Ors).” Speaking during the protest, a former Acting Chairman of the ADC in the Federal Capital Territory, Yusuf Shehu Tijani, described the judgment as a sham and called on the National Judicial Council (NJC) to intervene. “Our reason for coming here today is what Justice Lifu is doing. He is holding on to the sham judgment he said he passed. He should send the CTC, so that we can get it and appeal the judgment. “Moreover, the Supreme Court already affirmed the leadership of Senator David Mark as the National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress. So why is the High Court going against that recognition, saying he’s passing a judgment? “Now the judgment you passed, give us the Certified True Copy so that we can appeal. He is refusing to do that. That is why we are here,” Tijani said. He said the protest was intended to draw the NJC’s attention to the alleged delay and compel the judge to release the document. “So the protest is to call on the NJC to pressure this man, let him do what is right, because justice must prevail in Nigeria. This is not a jungle. This is a country that has laws, that has rules, and we have to follow the Constitution of the country. “The stated law is that he should send the CTC so that we can appeal the judgment, which is a sham judgment in the first place,” he added. The protest followed a November 10 petition addressed to the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court, Justice John Tsoho, by members of the ADC candidates’ forum, demanding the immediate release of the judgment. In the petition signed by Audu Aliyu on behalf of the candidates, the group said its lawyers applied for the CTC immediately after Justice Lifu delivered the judgment on November 5 and paid the prescribed fees, but had yet to receive the document despite repeated visits to the court registry. The candidates said the delay was undermining their constitutional right to appeal, warning that the expiration of relevant election deadlines could render the right meaningless. “We disagree with the judgment. We have a constitutional right to appeal it. But we cannot appeal what we do not have. “As at today, 10th November, 2026, five (5) days after judgment, the CTC has NOT been released to us. Our lawyers have visited the Registry daily to no avail without any lawful explanation,” the petition stated. The petitioners also alleged that they had credible information that the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) was pressuring the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to implement the judgment despite their inability to obtain its certified copy. Citing Sections 241 and 242 of the 1999 Constitution, which provide for appeals from decisions of the Federal High Court to the Court of Appeal, as well as Section 294(1), they argued that withholding the judgment could effectively deny them access to appellate justice. In a warning about the implications of the alleged delay, the candidates stated: “If a party can obtain a judgment against the opposition on Thursday, and the CTC is withheld until the election timetable closes, then the right of appeal becomes a mere illusion. Democracy dies not by coup, but by Registry delay.” They urged the Chief Judge to direct the Registrar to release the CTC within 24 hours of receiving the petition, setting Wednesday, November 11, as the deadline. The petitioners also notified the Chief Judge that ADC members, candidates and support groups would converge on the court premises by 10am on Wednesday to demand the document, insisting that the gathering was not intended as a protest against the judiciary but a demand for access to the judgment. Copies of the petition were sent to the President of the Court of Appeal, the Chief Justice of Nigeria, the NJC, the INEC Chairman, the Nigerian Bar Association, Abuja branch, and the Inspector-General of Police. The November 5 judgment nullified Mark’s emergence as ADC National Chairman and invalidated decisions taken by the party under his leadership, including the process that produced former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar as its presidential candidate for the 2027 general elections. Justice Lifu also directed INEC not to recognise or act on decisions taken at the party’s 99th National Executive Committee meeting held on July 27, 2025. The judgment followed a suit filed by Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former Deputy National Chairman of the ADC (North-East), who argued that he was constitutionally entitled to assume the party’s leadership following the resignation of its former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu. The ADC filed a notice of appeal on November 6 and also applied for a stay of execution, urging INEC not to take any action capable of prejudicing the outcome of the appeal. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.title_zh: 全国民主大会（ADC）抗议者就马克判决争议向尼日利亚司法委员会、联合国、欧盟、英国和美国使馆提出申诉
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body_zh:
阿布贾——非洲民主大会（ADC）成员周三在阿布贾联邦高等法院举行抗议，要求获得判决核证真实副本（CTC）。该判决推翻了由前参议院议长David Mark领导的该党全国工作委员会。抗议者指控审理法官Peter Lifu法官无视该党律师提交的申请及已缴纳的规定费用，仍扣留11月5日的判决，认为这一拖延妨碍了他们向上诉法院提出异议。信函主题为：“请求外交关注并支持尼日利亚正当程序、上诉权及可信选举的紧急呼吁——关于2026年11月5日在第FHC/ABJ/CS/1819/2025号案件中作出的判决（Nafiu Bala Gombe诉ADC等）”。

抗议期间，ADC联邦首都区前代理主席Yusuf Shehu Tijani称该判决是一场骗局，并呼吁国家司法委员会（NJC）介入。他说：“我们今天来到这里，是因为Lifu法官正在这样做。他扣留着自己所称的骗局判决。他应当把CTC交给我们，让我们取得判决并提出上诉。

“此外，最高法院已经确认参议员David Mark担任非洲民主大会全国主席的领导权。既然如此，高等法院为何要与这一确认相抵触，称他正在作出判决？

“你们既然已经作出判决，就把核证真实副本交给我们，以便我们提出上诉。他拒绝这样做，所以我们才会来到这里。”Tijani说。

他说，此次抗议旨在引起NJC对所称拖延行为的关注，并迫使法官发布该文件。

“因此，我们举行抗议，是要求NJC向这个人施压，让他做正确的事，因为正义必须在尼日利亚得到伸张。这里不是丛林，而是一个有法律、有规则的国家，我们必须遵守国家宪法。

“法律规定，他应当把CTC交给我们，以便我们对判决提出上诉，而该判决从一开始就是骗局判决。”他补充说。

此次抗议之前，ADC候选人论坛成员已于11月10日向联邦高等法院首席法官John Tsoho法官提交请愿书，要求立即发布判决。由Audu Aliyu代表候选人签署的请愿书称，该党律师在Lifu法官于11月5日作出判决后立即申请了CTC并缴纳规定费用，但多次前往法院登记处仍未获文件。候选人们表示，这一拖延正在削弱他们依法享有的上诉权，并警告说，相关选举截止日期一旦届满，这项权利可能就会变得毫无意义。

“我们不认同该判决。我们依法享有上诉权。但如果无法取得判决，我们便无法提出上诉。

“截至今天，即2026年11月10日，判决作出5天后，CTC仍未向我们发布。我们的律师每天前往登记处，却始终无果，也未得到任何合法解释。”请愿书指出。

请愿人还声称，他们掌握可靠信息，称全进步大会（APC）正在迫使独立国家选举委员会（INEC）执行该判决，而请愿人自己却无法取得判决核证副本。他们援引1999年《宪法》第241条和第242条以及第294条第（1）款。这些条款规定了对联邦高等法院裁决提出上诉至上诉法院的相关事项。请愿人认为，扣留判决实际上可能使他们无法获得上诉司法救济。

候选人在警告所称拖延可能造成的后果时表示：“如果某一方可以在星期四取得针对反对派的判决，而CTC却被扣留到选举时间表截止，那么上诉权就会沦为空幻。民主并非死于政变，而是死于登记处的拖延。”他们敦促首席法官指示登记官在收到请愿书后24小时内发布CTC，并将11月11日星期三设为最后期限。

请愿人还通知首席法官，ADC成员、候选人及支持团体将于周三上午10时聚集法院场所，要求取得该文件，并强调此次集会并非针对司法机构的抗议，而是要求获取判决。

请愿书副本已送交上诉法院院长、尼日利亚首席大法官、NJC、INEC主席、尼日利亚律师协会阿布贾分会以及警察总监。

11月5日的判决撤销了Mark当选ADC全国主席的资格，并宣布该党在其领导下作出的决定无效，其中包括推举前副总统Atiku Abubakar参选2027年大选的程序。Lifu法官还指示INEC不得承认或执行该党于2025年7月27日举行的第99届全国执行委员会会议所作出的决定。

该判决源于ADC东北部前全国副主席Nafiu Bala Gombe提起的诉讼。他主张，在该党前全国主席Ralph Nwosu辞职后，他依据宪法有权接掌该党领导权。ADC于11月6日提交上诉通知，并申请暂缓执行，敦促INEC不要采取任何可能妨碍上诉结果的行动。本文所载评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/dangote-refinery-i.body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery’s initial public offering (IPO) has recorded 172 per cent oversubscription, with N5.85 trillion in bids for 11.15 billion shares against 4.1 billion offered at N525 each. Subscription data seen by Nairametrics showed the N5.85 trillion in bids far exceeded the company’s initial fundraising target of N2.15 trillion, underscoring massive investor appetite for the refinery and setting the stage for one of the most significant equity transactions in African capital market history. The offering launched on September 14, 2026, initially offered approximately 4.1 billion ordinary shares at N525 each. The subscription period, initially scheduled to close on October 13, was subsequently extended to October 27 following regulatory approval. The scale of demand surprised even capital market analysts.For every share available, investors applied for nearly three shares, a level of oversubscription rarely seen in the Nigerian market. However, the subscription figures represent investor applications rather than final allotments, with the amount ultimately raised dependent on the allocation process and regulatory approvals. The strong subscription performance highlighted both the strategic importance of the refinery and the depth of liquidity now available in the Nigerian capital market, driven by domestic and international investors seeking exposure to a major energy infrastructure asset. Retail investor participation was a major feature of the IPO, supported by an extensive distribution network involving banks, stockbrokers and digital investment platforms. One investor applied for 771 million shares worth about N405 billion, or 6.92 per cent of total demand. Two groups of five investors each applied for 671.5 million shares worth N352.54 billion and 667.91 million shares worth N350.65 billion, respectively. The IPO also attracted significant interest from international institutional investors. Bloomberg earlier reported that the offering received approximately $4.1 billion in applications, comprising about $1.9 billion from Nigerian investors and a further $2.1 billion from prospective international investors. According to the report, South Africa’s Public Investment Corporation (PIC), which manages approximately $220 billion in pension assets, sought a substantial allocation. Nigerian pension fund managers were also reported to have expressed interest in acquiring shares in the refinery. The reported international demand reflects the refinery’s strategic importance as a major energy infrastructure asset and its potential role in transforming Africa’s petroleum refining industry. With subscription demand substantially exceeding the original offer size, attention is now expected to shift to the allotment process. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) allowed Dangote Refinery to absorb up to 30 per cent of additional oversubscription on top of its base offer. The offering forms part of the refinery’s broader financing strategy as it pursues an ambitious expansion programme intended to increase processing capacity to approximately 1.4 million barrels per day. The refinery’s recent financial performance has also provided investors with a basis for evaluating its growth prospects. For the nine months ended September 2026, the company reported revenue of $22.48 billion, representing a 144.47 per cent increase compared with the corresponding period of 2025. Profit after tax rose to $4.73 billion, compared with a loss of approximately $117 million in the corresponding period of the previous year. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/dangote-refinery-i.body_zh: 丹格特炼油厂的首次公开募股（IPO）获得172%的超额认购，投资者针对111.5亿股股份提出总额达N5.85万亿元的申购，而此次发行规模为41亿股，每股N525。Nairametrics看到的认购数据表明，N5.85万亿元的申购额远超公司最初N2.35万亿元的融资目标，凸显出投资者对该炼油厂的热烈需求，并为非洲资本市场历史上规模最大的股权交易之一奠定了基础。此次发行于2026年9月14日启动，最初发行约41亿股普通股，每股价格为N525。认购期原定于10月13日结束，但在获得监管批准后延长至10月27日。需求的规模甚至令资本市场分析师感到意外。每有一份可供认购的股份，投资者就申购近三份，这种超额认购水平在尼日利亚市场极为罕见。不过，这些认购数据代表的是投资者的申购申请，而非最终获配数量；最终筹集的金额将取决于分配流程和监管审批。强劲的认购表现既凸显了该炼油厂的战略重要性，也反映出尼日利亚资本市场目前拥有深厚的流动性，来自国内外的投资者都希望借此投资于一项大型能源基础设施资产。散户参与此次IPO是一项显著特点，银行、股票经纪商和数字投资平台组成的广泛销售网络为散户参与提供了支持。一名投资者申购了7.71亿股，价值约N4050亿，占总需求的6.92%。两个各由五名投资者组成的团体分别申购了6.715亿股和6.6791亿股，价值分别为N3525.4亿和N3506.5亿。此次IPO也吸引了国际机构投资者的广泛关注。彭博社此前报道称，此次发行收到约$41亿的申购申请，其中约$19亿来自尼日利亚投资者，另有约$21亿来自有意参与的国际投资者。据报道，管理约$2200亿养老金资产的南非公共投资公司（PIC）寻求获得大量配售。尼日利亚养老金管理机构的基金经理据报也表达了收购该炼油厂股份的意向。国际需求反映出该炼油厂作为大型能源基础设施资产的战略重要性，以及它在推动非洲石油炼制行业转型方面可能发挥的作用。由于认购需求大幅超过最初发行规模，市场关注点预计将转向获配流程。证券交易委员会（SEC）允许丹格特炼油厂在基础发行规模之外，再吸收最多30%的额外超额认购。此次发行是该炼油厂整体融资战略的一部分；该厂正在推进一项雄心勃勃的扩建计划，拟将加工能力提高至约每日140万桶。该炼油厂近期的财务表现也为投资者评估其增长前景提供了依据。截至2026年9月的九个月，公司报告营收为$224.8亿，较2025年同期增长144.47%。税后利润增至$47.3亿，而上年同期亏损约$1.17亿。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时获取全天候最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Olushola Bello Olushola Bello是《Leadership Newspaper》的高级记者，报道尼日利亚资本市场、产业部门及更广泛的经济议题。她以高影响力报道和对商业动态及金融市场的深入分析闻名，并以坚定的编辑判断以及对准确、公平的承诺为报道基础

https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.summary: Despite the differences in stop rates, the true yields remained relatively close across the instruments, settling at 18.83 per cent, 18.85 per cent and 18.68 per cent for the 154-day, 252-day and 329-day bills, respectively. The strong preference for the 329-day instrument suggests that investors are willing to commit funds for longer periods to secure prevailing returns, amid expectations of possible changes in monetary conditions.
https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.summary_zh: 尽管各期限票据的止售收益率存在差异，但这些工具的实际收益率总体保持相对接近，154天期、252天期和329天期票据的收益率分别稳定在18.83%、18.85%和18.68%。投资者对329天期票据的强烈偏好表明，在预计货币条件可能发生变化的情况下，投资者愿意投入资金更长时间，以获得当前收益率。
https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.body: The strong demand, which translated to a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.71 times, indicates sustained investor appetite for high-yielding government securities, particularly longer-dated instruments. Data from the auction results showed that the apex bank allotted N3.854 trillion across the three tenors, representing 2.57 times the amount offered, in what signals its continued effort to mop up excess liquidity from the financial system. A breakdown of the results showed that the 329-day instrument attracted the highest subscription of N2.82 trillion, accounting for about 69.3 per cent of the total bids received. The CBN offered N500 billion on the instrument but recorded subscriptions of N2.82 trillion, out of which N2.79 trillion was allotted at a stop rate of 15.99 per cent. The 252-day instrument also recorded subscriptions above its offer, attracting N791.5 billion against N500 billion offered. The apex bank sold N783.5 billion at a stop rate of 16.68 per cent. However, demand for the 154-day instrument fell below the amount offered, as subscriptions stood at N457.89 billion against N500 billion on offer. The CBN allotted N280.76 billion on the instrument at a stop rate of 17.44 per cent. The auction results showed a declining stop-rate structure across the three maturities, with the 154-day instrument recording the highest rate of 17.44 per cent, followed by 16.68 per cent on the 252-day bill and 15.99 per cent on the 329-day instrument. Despite the differences in stop rates, the true yields remained relatively close across the instruments, settling at 18.83 per cent, 18.85 per cent and 18.68 per cent for the 154-day, 252-day and 329-day bills, respectively. The strong preference for the 329-day instrument suggests that investors are willing to commit funds for longer periods to secure prevailing returns, amid expectations of possible changes in monetary conditions. The scale of the allotment, particularly on the longest tenor, also highlights the CBN’s willingness to absorb liquidity beyond its initial auction target. With total sales exceeding the offer by N2.35 trillion, the auction represents another significant liquidity management operation by the apex bank. The development comes as investors continue to position their portfolios around attractive fixed-income returns, with demand concentrated on longer-dated instruments offering relatively competitive yields. https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.body_zh: 强劲需求使认购倍数达到2.71倍，表明投资者对高收益政府证券、尤其是期限较长的工具保持持续兴趣。拍卖结果显示，中央银行在三个期限档中共配售3.854万亿奈拉，是发行额的2.57倍，这表明该行继续努力从金融体系中回收过剩流动性。结果明细显示，329天期工具认购额最高，达到2.82万亿奈拉，约占所获认购总额的69.3%。中央银行为该工具发行5000亿奈拉，却收到2.82万亿奈拉认购，其中2.79万亿奈拉按15.99%的中标利率配售。252天期工具的认购额也超过发行额，在发行5000亿奈拉的情况下吸引到7915亿奈拉认购。中央银行按16.68%的中标利率售出7835亿奈拉。然而，154天期工具的需求低于发行额，其认购额为4578.9亿奈拉，而发行额为5000亿奈拉。尼日利亚中央银行按17.44%的中标利率为该工具配售2807.6亿奈拉。拍卖结果显示，三个到期期限的中标利率结构呈下降趋势，其中154天期工具的利率最高，为17.44%，其次是252天期票据的16.68%，329天期工具为15.99%。尽管中标利率存在差异，这些工具的实际收益率仍相对接近，154天期、252天期和329天期票据分别稳定在18.83%、18.85%和18.68%。投资者对329天期工具的强烈偏好表明，在预期货币条件可能发生变化之际，投资者愿意将资金锁定更长时间，以获得当前收益率。尤其是期限最长工具的巨额配售规模，也凸显尼日利亚中央银行愿意吸收超出初始拍卖目标的流动性。销售总额比发行额高出2.35万亿奈拉，此次拍卖是中央银行实施的又一次重要流动性管理操作。随着投资者继续围绕具有吸引力的固定收益回报调整投资组合，需求集中于期限较长、收益率相对具有竞争力的工具。我们掌握前沿资讯。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取更新 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Bukola Aro-Lambo是《领导报》的记者，拥有十余年从业经验，专长于经济与金融报道。她以系统、数据驱动的方式，将官方数据与专家见解相结合，报道宏观经济趋势、财政政策、公共财政、银行业和金融科技。她还报道发展金融、基础设施融资、农产品出口、气候金融和科技驱动型企业，提供清晰且具有分析性的报道，支持公众围绕尼日利亚不断演变的经济格局展开 informed 讨论。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国总理韩升效周三承诺为农民创造更好的环境，并表示政府已为明年的农业预留了史上规模最大的预算。韩升效在农民节典礼上致辞称，政府已划拨超过3万亿韩元（22亿美元）的农民补贴，这笔资金被称为“公共利益直接支付”；这是该预算首次突破3万亿韩元大关。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook pledged Wednesday to create a better environment for farmers, saying the government has set aside the largest-ever budget for farming for next year. Han said in an address at a Farmers' Day ceremony that the government has earmarked more than 3 trillion won ($2.2 billion) in subsidies for farmers, known as "public interest direct payment," the first time the budget has exceeded the 3 trillion-won mark. She also said the government more than tripled the budget for the rural basic income from some 300 billion won to more than 1.1 trillion won for next year and will keep increasing the budget going forward. The government is also preparing to introduce retirement pension for farmers, she said. "The president said last month that agriculture is a national security industry and a strategic industry that is essential to the survival of the Republic of Korea," Han said. "First of all, I believe that creating an environment where farmers can work with peace of mind is crucial for safeguarding agricultural security." "Expanding smart farming is of vital importance for the future," she said. "By investing in physical AI, such as AI-powered agricultural machinery and farming robots, we can prepare for the future of our agricultural sector."

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: From hidden notes to AI glasses, cheating takes new forms
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: What has changed is the technology used to get away with it, from altered answer sheets and text messages to artificial intelligence (AI)-powered glasses. Centuries later, mobile phones made cheating a coordinated operation. “Preventing cheating with AI glasses is not an issue for the Ministry of Education alone,” a ministry official said, adding that agencies overseeing medical licensing and technical qualification exams also need to address the problem.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 如今发生变化的是用来逃避作弊的技术，从篡改答题卡和发送短信，到人工智能（AI）驱动的眼镜。几个世纪后，手机让作弊变成了一项协同行动。一名教育部官员表示：“防止利用AI眼镜作弊并非教育部一家的责任。”他还指出，负责医疗执照和技术资格考试的机构也需要应对这一问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: What has changed is the technology used to get away with it, from altered answer sheets and text messages to artificial intelligence (AI)-powered glasses. As the methods grow more sophisticated, detecting them has become increasingly difficult. Even the civil service examinations of the 1392-1910 Joseon Dynasty were vulnerable to cheaters. In a 1699 scandal, 15 of 33 successful candidates were found to have passed through irregular means, including the swapping of names attached to exam papers. Centuries later, mobile phones made cheating a coordinated operation. During the 2004 college entrance exam, students in Gwangju divided up roles among high-scoring test takers, intermediaries and recipients, passing answers through text messages. According to Ministry of Education figures released in 2005, the scores of 472 students were invalidated for cheating on college entrance exams from the 2002 through 2005 academic years. Of those, 412 had used text messages. The scandal prompted tighter restrictions on electronic devices and tougher penalties. More recently, smart glasses have added another challenge for exam supervisors. Two people were caught using AI-enabled glasses during TOEIC English-language tests in May. Three candidates wearing smart glasses were also caught at national technical qualification exams in Seoul, Gwangju and Mokpo, South Jeolla Province. Similar cases have surfaced in university entrance examinations. A survey from the education ministry released Monday found four cases involving smart glasses in middle and high school exams this year — one at a middle school and three at high schools. The survey covered 5,679 schools nationwide. At a high school in North Jeolla Province, a teacher grew suspicious when a student repeatedly touched the frames of his glasses during an exam. A green light reflected in the lenses helped give him away. All four students received zeros for the subjects concerned, while the three high school students faced additional disciplinary measures. The issue comes as Korea prepares for its annual College Scholastic Ability Test on Nov. 19. A separate tally found 1,229 cheating violations over the past five years, although many involved writing answers after time was called rather than using electronic devices. “Preventing cheating with AI glasses is not an issue for the Ministry of Education alone,” a ministry official said, adding that agencies overseeing medical licensing and technical qualification exams also need to address the problem. Smart glasses and other electronic devices will be banned from test centers on exam day. Officials are also exploring ways to detect the glasses electronically, but have yet to find a reliable solution
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 从隐蔽纸条到人工智能眼镜，作弊呈现出新形式
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 发生变化的是用来逃避作弊 detection 的技术，从篡改答题卡、发送短信，到利用人工智能（AI）眼镜作弊。随着手段日益精密，侦破作弊也变得越来越困难。即使是1392年至1910年朝鲜王朝的公务员考试，也曾容易受到作弊者侵害。1699年的一起丑闻中，33名录取者里有15人被认定通过不正当手段通过考试，其中包括调换试卷上的姓名。数百年后，手机使作弊变成了一项协同行动。在2004年高考期间，光州的学生在高分考生、中间人和接收者之间分工，通过短信传递答案。根据教育部于2005年公布的数据，2002年至2005学年的大学入学考试中，共有472名学生的成绩因作弊而作废，其中412人使用了短信。这场丑闻促使有关部门收紧对电子设备的限制，并加大处罚力度。近来，智能眼镜又给考试监考人员带来了另一项挑战。今年5月，两人在TOEIC英语考试中被发现使用人工智能眼镜。在韩国全罗南道首尔、光州和木浦举行的国家技术资格考试中，也有三名佩戴智能眼镜的考生被抓到。大学入学考试中也出现了类似案例。教育部周一发布的一项调查发现，今年初中和高中考试涉及智能眼镜的案件共有4起，其中初中1起、高中3起。调查覆盖全国5679所学校。在全罗北道的一所高中，一名教师在考试期间因一名学生反复触碰眼镜框而产生怀疑。镜片上反射的绿色灯光让他识破了作弊。这4名学生的相关科目成绩均为零，3名高中生还受到额外纪律处分。在韩国准备于11月19日举行年度大学修学能力试验之际，又出现了这一问题。另一项统计显示，过去五年共有1229起作弊违规行为，尽管其中许多是在停止答题信号后继续抄写答案，而非使用电子设备。教育部一名官员说：“防止利用AI眼镜作弊并非教育部一家机构能够解决的问题。”他还表示，负责医疗执照和技术资格考试的机构也需要应对这一问题。考试当天，智能眼镜及其他电子设备将被禁止带入场内。有关部门还在研究通过电子手段侦测智能眼镜的方法，但尚未找到可靠的解决方案……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety issued a safety alert Wednesday to medical professionals and patients over a potential risk of a rare eye condition associated with GLP-1 obesity drugs, including popular obesity treatments Wegovy and Mounjaro. The move follows safety measures by overseas regulators concerning nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve that can lead to sudden, potentially permanent vision loss.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 食品与药品安全部周三向医疗 professionals 和患者发布安全警报，警告 GLP-1 肥胖药物可能与一种罕见眼病有关，其中包括广受欢迎的肥胖治疗药物 Wegovy 和 Mounjaro。此前，海外监管机构已针对非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）采取安全措施；这种疾病由流向视神经的血流减少引起，可能导致突然且可能永久的视力丧失。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety issued a safety alert Wednesday to medical professionals and patients over a potential risk of a rare eye condition associated with GLP-1 obesity drugs, including popular obesity treatments Wegovy and Mounjaro. The move follows safety measures by overseas regulators concerning nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve that can lead to sudden, potentially permanent vision loss. In June last year, the European Medicines Agency classified it as a very rare side effect of semaglutide, the active ingredient in Wegovy, estimating it may affect up to 1 in 10,000 users. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration asked drugmakers Monday to add a possible increased risk of NAION to the warnings and precautions on GLP-1 drug labels. The letter advises medical professionals to stop treatment and have patients examined immediately if NAION is suspected in those taking GLP-1 drugs, which aid weight loss by mimicking a hormone that regulates appetite and blood sugar. Patients with related symptoms are advised to consult their doctors right away. The food and drug ministry also asked companies selling GLP-1 drugs in Korea to submit data, including plans to amend their product approvals in light of the safety information. Based on the submissions, the ministry will consider revising the drugs’ usage precautions. The safety measure comes amid surging demand for GLP-1 obesity treatments in Korea. According to drug utilization review data submitted by the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service to Rep. Han Zee-a of the People Power Party in July, Mounjaro was prescribed 1,501,161 times from its domestic launch last August through May this year. Monthly prescriptions rose about 14.7 times, from 18,579 in August last year to 273,140 in May this year. By age group, people in their 30s accounted for the largest share at 36 percent, followed by those in their 40s at 27.1 percent, those in their 20s at 16.9 percent and those in their 50s at 14.6 percent. Wegovy was prescribed a cumulative 1,228,867 times from its October 2024 launch through May this year. People in their 20s and 30s accounted for 46.4 percent of that total
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国警告称，GLP-1药物存在罕见的失明风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国食品药品安全部周三向医务人员和患者发布安全警报，警示GLP-1类肥胖药物（包括热门减重药Wegovy和Mounjaro）可能存在一种罕见眼病的风险。此举是在海外监管机构针对非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）采取安全措施之后发布的。NAION由流向视神经的血流减少引起，可能造成突发性且可能永久性的视力丧失。去年6月，欧洲药品管理局将其列为司美格鲁肽的一种极罕见副作用；司美格鲁肽是Wegovy的活性成分，监管机构估计，每10,000名使用者中可能有多达1人受到影响。美国食品药品监督管理局周一要求药品制造商在GLP-1类药物标签的警告和注意事项中加入NAION风险可能上升的提示。该信函建议医务人员在服用GLP-1类药物的患者疑似患有NAION时停止治疗，并立即安排患者接受检查；这类药物通过模拟调节食欲和血糖的激素来帮助减重。出现相关症状的患者被建议立即咨询医生。食品药品安全部还要求在韩国销售GLP-1类药物的公司提交相关数据，包括根据安全信息修改产品批准事项的计划。该部将根据提交的材料考虑修订这些药物的使用注意事项。采取这项安全措施之际，GLP-1类肥胖治疗药物在韩国的需求激增。根据健康保险审查评价服务7月提交给国民力量党议员韩在爱的药品使用审查数据，自去年8月在韩国上市以来至今年5月，Mounjaro的处方量达1,501,161次。月处方量约增长14.7倍，从去年8月的18,579次增至今年5月的273,140次。按年龄组划分，30多岁人群占比最高，为36%；其次是40多岁人群，占27.1%；20多岁人群占16.9%；50多岁人群占14.6%。自2024年10月上市以来至今年5月，Wegovy累计处方1,228,867次。20多岁和30多岁人群占总数的46.4%

Represented by Ime Eprikpo, director of Metallurgical Raw Material Development and Investment Promotion, Audu said the regulations would establish a transparent and sustainable scrap metal value chain to support industrialisation.
https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.summary_zh: 钢铁发展部长Shuaibu Abubakar Audu亲王在拉各斯举行的利益相关方磋商活动中披露了有关情况。此次活动于11月9日至10日举行，旨在验证拟议中的《2026年废金属（收集、交易、回收与监管）条例》。冶金原材料开发与投资促进主任Ime Eprikpo代表Audu出席活动。他表示，这些条例将建立透明、可持续的废金属价值链，以支持工业化。
https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.body: The Minister of Steel Development, Prince Shuaibu Abubakar Audu, disclosed this at a stakeholders’ engagement to validate the proposed Scrap Metal (Collection, Trading, Recycling and Regulation) Regulations, 2026, held in Lagos from 9 November to 10. Represented by Ime Eprikpo, director of Metallurgical Raw Material Development and Investment Promotion, Audu said the regulations would establish a transparent and sustainable scrap metal value chain to support industrialisation. He described scrap metal as a vital raw material for steelmaking and manufacturing, with the potential to create jobs, reduce waste and promote a circular economy. However, he warned that poor regulation encouraged infrastructure theft, unsafe dismantling and environmental degradation. The proposed framework provides for operator licensing, regulation of collection centres, transaction traceability, safety standards and stronger enforcement against illicit trade. “Our objective is not to suppress legitimate commercial activity. Rather, it is to establish a system in which lawful businesses can operate with greater clarity and confidence, while activities involving stolen materials, unsafe practices or environmental harm are addressed through appropriate regulatory and legal measures,” he said. Audu assured small-scale operators, many of whom depend on scrap trading for their livelihoods, of a pathway to formalisation with requirements proportionate to their business scale. Expressing concern over the theft of electrical cables, railway components, manhole covers, and other public infrastructure, he called for stricter supplier verification, improved transaction records, and collaboration with security agencies to curb the trade in stolen metals. He urged stakeholders to submit practical recommendations to strengthen the draft regulations and address potential implementation challenges. FG Targets Steel Industry Growth: The Permanent Secretary, Ambassador Nura Abba Rimi, represented by Christopher T. Wanje, Director of Metallurgical Inspectorate and Environmental Protection, said the initiative aligned with President Bola Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda to build a competitive and self-sustaining steel industry. He described effective scrap metal regulation as essential to securing raw materials, improving resource efficiency and strengthening local manufacturing. Industry Backs Regulation: The National President of the National Association of Scrap and Waste Dealers Employers of Nigeria, Comrade Pastor Engr. Ogbu Luke Uchechukwu, described the engagement as a landmark step towards an organised and economically viable scrap industry. Similarly, NESREA Director-General, Dr Innocent Bariate Bariko, represented by Engr. Walter Okoye, welcomed the initiative, noting that although scrap metal was vital to steel production and the circular economy, poor regulation posed environmental and public health risks. Busari Olanrewaju of Kam Steel Integrated Company Ltd. also pledged the company’s support through training for scrap collectors, standardised grading, modern sorting and shredding technologies, and increased local utilisation of Nigerian scrap metal. https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.body_zh: 钢铁发展部长谢艾布·阿布巴卡尔·奥杜亲王在11月9日至10日于拉各斯举行的利益相关方会议上披露了这一信息，会议旨在验证拟议的《2026年废金属（收集、交易、回收与监管）条例》。冶金原材料开发与投资促进主任伊梅·埃普里克波代表奥杜出席。他表示，这些条例将建立一个透明、可持续的废金属价值链，以支持工业化。他指出，废金属是炼钢和制造业的重要原材料，具有创造就业、减少废弃物和促进循环经济的潜力。然而，他警告称，监管不力会助长基础设施盗窃、不安全拆解和环境恶化。拟议框架规定了对经营者进行许可管理、规范收集中心、实施交易可追溯性、制定安全标准，并加强打击非法贸易。他说：“我们的目标不是压制合法商业活动，而是建立一套制度，使合法企业能够在更清晰、更有信心的情况下经营，同时通过适当的监管和法律措施处理涉及被盗材料、不安全做法或环境危害的活动。”奥杜向小规模经营者保证，其中许多人依靠废金属贸易维持生计，针对他们提供合规转化路径，且相关要求与其经营规模相称。他对电缆、铁路设施、井盖和其他公共基础设施被盗表示关切，呼吁加强供应商核验、改善交易记录，并与安全机构合作，以遏制被盗金属交易。他敦促利益相关方提交切实可行的建议，以强化条例草案并应对潜在的实施挑战。联邦政府推动钢铁工业发展：冶金监察与环境保护主任克里斯托弗·T·万杰代表常任秘书、大使努拉·阿巴·里米出席上述活动。万杰表示，此项举措与博拉·蒂努布总统的“ renewed Hope”议程相一致，旨在建设一个具有竞争力且能够自我 sustaining 的钢铁工业。他指出，有效监管废金属对于保障原材料供应、提高资源效率和加强本地制造至关重要。业界支持监管：尼日利亚全国废品与废弃物经销商雇主协会全国主席、同志牧师兼工程师奥格布·卢克·乌切库卢表示，此次协商是迈向组织化且经济上可持续的废品行业的重要一步。同样，NESREA总干事英nocent·巴里亚特·巴里科由工程师沃尔特·奥科耶代表，对这项举措表示欢迎，并指出，尽管废金属对钢铁生产和循环经济至关重要，但监管不力会带来环境和公共健康风险。Kam Steel Integrated Company Ltd.的布萨里·奥兰雷乔也承诺支持公司通过为废品收集人员提供培训、推行标准化分级、采用现代化分拣和粉碎技术，以及提高尼日利亚废金属的本地利用等方式予以支持。我们拥有独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp 频道，随时随地获取更新 → 加入我们的 WhatsApp 频道 --> --> 西拉斯·埃泽古 西拉斯·埃泽古是《Leadership Newspaper》的高级记者，报道包括矿山和钢铁在内的多个领域。

https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.summary: The resolution was contained in a communiqué adopted at a two-day capacity-building retreat on sustainable nutrition financing for the executive chairmen of the 25 LGAs, organised by the Civil Society Scaling Up Nutrition in Nigeria (CS-SUNN) in partnership with the Niger State Government.
