https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.summary_zh: 该决议载于一份为期两天的可持续营养融资能力建设研讨会通过的公报中。研讨会面向尼日利亚25个地方政府行政区的行政主席举行，由尼日利亚民间社会推动营养规模化组织（CS-SUNN）与尼日尔州政府合作主办。公报称，这些地方政府行政区还将于2027年第一季度前，在全部25个行政委员会设立并启动地方食品与营养委员会。
https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.body: The resolution was contained in a communiqué adopted at a two-day capacity-building retreat on sustainable nutrition financing for the executive chairmen of the 25 LGAs, organised by the Civil Society Scaling Up Nutrition in Nigeria (CS-SUNN) in partnership with the Niger State Government. The retreat, held in Abuja from November 5 to 6, 2026, also resolved that the local governments would move beyond budgetary approvals to ensure predictable quarterly cash releases for nutrition programmes. The chairmen further committed to developing Annual Operational Plans to guide nutrition spending and implementation, as well as strengthening accountability mechanisms to ensure that allocated funds and nutrition commodities reach intended beneficiaries. According to the communiqué, the LGAs will also inaugurate and operationalise Local Government Committees on Food and Nutrition across the 25 councils by the first quarter of 2027. The committees are expected to coordinate nutrition planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring at the grassroots level under the leadership of the respective LGA chairmen. The retreat noted that although ₦500 million was already available in the state nutrition account, securing budgetary allocations alone was insufficient without timely releases and effective utilisation of the funds. Participants therefore called for sustained advocacy and engagement with government institutions to ensure that existing financial commitments translate into interventions that address malnutrition. They also identified the UNICEF Child Nutrition Fund’s 1:1 matching arrangement as an opportunity to mobilise additional resources for nutrition, stressing the need for timely counterpart funding by government. The communiqué further recommended capacity-building programmes for nutrition desk officers and focal persons to improve their skills in planning, budget preparation, data analysis and field monitoring. To strengthen transparency, the LGAs also resolved to collaborate with the State Committee on Food and Nutrition, CS-SUNN and community structures to track nutrition resources and prevent the diversion of commodities. Participants emphasised the need for community sensitisation and the promotion of locally produced nutritious foods, including Tom Brown, to encourage demand for maternal, infant and young child feeding services. The retreat observed that nutrition interventions were often carried out on an ad hoc basis in many LGAs due to the absence of dedicated budget lines, making structured planning and predictable financing necessary for sustainable results. https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.body_zh: 该决议载于在阿布贾举行的为期两天的可持续营养融资能力建设研讨会上通过的公报中。此次研讨会面向尼日利亚25个地方政府区的行政主席，由尼日利亚公民社会营养扩展组织（CS-SUNN）与尼日尔州政府合作举办。研讨会于2026年11月5日至6日举行，还决定地方政府将不再仅限于批准预算，而要确保为营养项目按季度稳定拨付现金。主席们进一步承诺制定年度运营计划，以指导营养支出和落实工作，并加强问责机制，确保所拨资金和营养物资能够送达目标受益人。公报称，25个地方议会还将于2027年第一季度前设立并启动地方食品与营养委员会。在各自地方政府区主席的领导下，这些委员会预计将协调基层的营养规划、预算编制、执行和监测工作。研讨会指出，尽管州营养账户中已有₦500 million可用资金，但若资金不能及时拨付并得到有效使用，仅获得预算拨款仍不够。因此，与会者呼吁持续开展倡导工作，并与政府机构接洽，以确保现有财政承诺转化为应对营养不良的具体干预措施。他们还认定，UNICEF儿童营养基金的1:1配套拨款安排是动员更多营养资金的机会，并强调政府必须及时提供配套资金。公报还建议为营养事务专员和联络人员开展能力建设计划，以提升他们在规划、预算编制、数据分析和实地监测方面的技能。为加强透明度，地方政府还决定与州食品与营养委员会、CS-SUNN及社区组织合作，追踪营养资源，防止物资被挪用。与会者强调，需要加强社区宣传并推广本地生产的营养食品，包括Tom Brown，以促进对孕产妇、婴幼儿和幼儿喂养服务的需求。研讨会观察到，由于缺少专项预算项目，许多地方政府区的营养干预措施往往临时开展，因此必须实行结构化规划并提供稳定融资，才能取得可持续成果。We've got the edge. 立即获取真实时间报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取更新 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Patience Ivie Ihejirika是Leadership Newspaper获奖记者，专攻健康领域报道。她以深入细致的报道、引人入胜的人物故事和研究充分的特别报道闻名于业内

https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.summary_zh: 菲律宾武装部队负责西菲律宾海相关事务的发言人罗伊·文森特·特立尼迪（预备役）表示，他认同副总统的看法，即菲律宾不应与其他国家交恶，但强调，维护自身海洋权利是另一回事。特立尼迪在阿吉纳尔多营的新闻发布会上说：“我们并未因西菲律宾海问题与任何国家挑起冲突。”
https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.body: Rear Adm. Roy Vincent Trinidad (Reserve), the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ spokesperson on matters relating to the West Philippine Sea, said he agreed with the Vice President that the Philippines should not antagonize other countries but stressed that asserting its maritime rights was a separate matter. “We are not picking a fight with any country over the West Philippine Sea,” Trinidad said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo. “By merely standing up for what is rightfully and legally ours, we are not fighting any other country.” Trinidad was responding to Duterte’s remarks during a gathering with overseas Filipino workers in Hong Kong on Sunday, where she urged the government to maintain good relations with China despite the maritime dispute. The Vice President warned that deteriorating bilateral ties could threaten the jobs and businesses of Filipinos working in China. She also called for a team of diplomats and negotiators to handle the dispute rather than resorting to confrontations at sea or exchanges on social media. READ: Marcos wants South China Sea code of conduct finalized during Asean She further cited the disparity between the two countries’ military capabilities, arguing that the government should consider the consequences of confronting a more powerful neighbor. Asked about Duterte’s comparison of the Philippines’ military strength with China’s, Trinidad said the AFP would continue performing its mandate regardless of its capabilities. “It is not about military strength. We have what we have. We are improving our capabilities,” he said. “Given what we have, we are good. Given more, we could perform even better. But it will not stop the AFP from fighting, from standing up, from supporting all our government officials who stand up for our rights in the West Philippine Sea.” Trinidad also stressed that every Filipino, including elected officials, has a responsibility to defend the country’s national interests. “The Arbitral Tribunal of 2016 is a legal landmark that upheld the maritime entitlements of the Philippines. Every Filipino should champion this,” he said. The 2016 arbitral ruling invalidated China’s sweeping maritime claims in the South China Sea, although Beijing has refused to recognize the decision. Trinidad also said the AFP would not scale back its activities in the West Philippine Sea despite calls to preserve diplomatic space for talks with Beijing. Asked whether the military should tone down its assertion of Philippine maritime rights to give diplomacy a chance, Trinidad said the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the defense establishment had distinct responsibilities. “We leave the statement of the [DFA] at that inasmuch as they are the primary vehicle of government for diplomacy,” he said. “On the side of the [Department of National Defense] and the AFP, we have a mandate to perform to secure the integrity of the national territory, protect our sovereignty, and look after the welfare of the Filipino people,” he added. The DFA earlier reminded officials, particularly members of the defense and security sector, to align their statements and actions with President Marcos’ foreign policy direction, particularly with regard to China. https://www.inquirer.net/495284/afp-to-v.body_zh: 菲律宾海军中将罗伊·文森特·特立尼达（预备役）是菲律宾武装部队负责西菲律宾海事务的发言人。他表示认同副总统的观点，即菲律宾不应与其他国家交恶，但强调，维护自身海洋权利是另一回事。特立尼达在阿吉纳尔多营的一次新闻发布会上说：“我们没有因西菲律宾海问题与任何国家挑起争端。仅是为维护理应属于我们且符合法律的权利，并不意味着我们是在与任何其他国家交战。”特立尼达是在回应杜特尔特周日与香港菲律宾海外劳工集会时发表的言论。她在集会上敦促政府，尽管存在海洋争端，仍应与中国保持良好关系。副总统警告，双边关系恶化可能危及在华菲律宾人的就业和生意。她还呼吁由外交官和谈判人员组成的团队处理争端，而不是诉诸海上对抗或社交媒体上的交锋。阅读：马科斯希望Asean期间完成《南海行为准则》。她还指出两国军事实力存在差距，主张政府应考虑与实力更强的邻国对峙可能带来的后果。当被问及杜特尔特将菲律宾军事实力与中国作比较时，特立尼达表示，无论实力如何，菲律宾武装部队都会继续履行职责。他说：“关键不在于军事实力。我们有什么就用什么。我们正在提升自己的能力。就现有条件而言，我们已经足够出色。若拥有更多资源，我们就能表现得更好。但这不会阻止菲律宾武装部队战斗、挺身而出，也不会阻止我们支持所有在西菲律宾海维护我们权利的政府官员。”特立尼达还强调，每一名菲律宾人，包括民选官员，都有责任捍卫国家利益。他说：“2016年仲裁庭裁决是一项法律里程碑，确认了菲律宾的海洋权益。每一名菲律宾人都应为此发声。”2016年的仲裁裁决否定了中国在南海提出的广泛海洋主张，但北京一直拒绝承认该裁决。尽管有人呼吁为与北京对话保留外交空间，特立尼达仍表示，菲律宾武装部队不会缩减其在西菲律宾海的活动。当被问及军方是否应缓和其对菲律宾海洋权利的主张，为外交谈判创造机会时，特立尼达表示，外交部（DFA）与国防体系承担着不同的职责。他说：“对于外交部，我们对其声明不作进一步评论，因为外交部是政府开展外交的主要渠道。就国防部和菲律宾武装部队而言，我们的使命是维护国家领土完整、保护我们的主权，并照顾菲律宾人民的福祉。”外交部早些时候提醒官员，尤其是国防和安全部门人员，应使自身言行与马科斯总统的外交政策方向保持一致，特别是在涉及中国的问题上。无法保存您的订阅，请重试。您的订阅已成功。外交部说：“无论公职人员持有什么个人信念，其公开立场都承载着机构责任。他们不能不顾后果，针对中国或任何其他国际伙伴推行自己偏好的做法，因为这会影响政府的整体政策。”/cb 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海专题最新消息页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点了解最新动态

https://www.inquirer.net/495278/navy-rai.summary: NavComWest said it had been coordinating with concerned government agencies, coastal communities, and fisherfolk ahead of the launch to ensure the timely reporting of suspected rocket debris, falling objects, and other related maritime and aerial incidents.
https://www.inquirer.net/495278/navy-rai.summary_zh: NavComWest表示，该机构已在发射活动启动前与相关政府机构、沿海社区和渔业从业者展开协调，以确保及时报告疑似火箭残骸、坠落物体以及其他相关海上和空中事件。
https://www.inquirer.net/495278/navy-rai.body: NavComWest said it had been coordinating with concerned government agencies, coastal communities, and fisherfolk ahead of the launch to ensure the timely reporting of suspected rocket debris, falling objects, and other related maritime and aerial incidents. The Navy said the launch, conducted from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center in Wenchang, Hainan, at 4:24 a.m., produced an unusual phenomenon over this city and several Philippine-held island stations in the West Philippine Sea, raising concerns over the potential security implications of similar activities. The Long March 12 rocket is known to produce light and smoke trails as it enters the final stage of its launch, followed by loud sounds attributed to sonic booms. These effects were observed in this city about nine minutes after the launch, when bright lights illuminated the sky before loud explosions were heard. Navy personnel deployed at various stations in the West Philippine Sea also reported similar observations, particularly in Lawak, Patag, and Likas Islands, as well as Rizal (Commodore) Reef. Personnel assigned to the Tubbataha Reef Natural Park reported seeing a bright luminous object approximately 35 kilometers (19 nautical miles) from their station. The area had earlier been identified by the Philippine Space Agency as a possible drop zone for debris from the rocket. Based on its initial assessment, NavComWest said the phenomenon, known as a “space jellyfish,” was likely caused by the expansion of rocket exhaust gases at high altitudes. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea's top economic policymaker said Wednesday the government will release annual economic growth forecasts three times a year starting in 2027, up from the current two, to respond more proactively to changing economic conditions. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il made the announcement as he discussed details of the government's economic growth strategy for next year with relevant ministers, indicating the plan will seek sustainable growth by addressing disparities. "In order to promptly respond to the changing environment at home and abroad, the government will increase the number of economic outlooks issued from two to three, which would mark the first change in 32 years," Lee said. Lee said the government will no longer release a separate economic growth strategy for the second half of the year under the revised system, but will instead draw up supplementary measures to address economic conditions when it announces its growth forecasts. The finance minister said details will be announced in December following discussions with relevant ministries. During the meeting, Lee added that the government will continue efforts to maintain the current growth momentum through flagship initiatives, including the three megaprojects

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Time to turn ROK-US agreement into action
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. As the agreement’s first anniversary approaches, Seoul and Washington need an implementation plan that places fuel procurement and construction preparations on a single, coordinated timeline.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 9月还确认，韩国已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），打算就依据其《全面保障协定》第14条达成安排开始磋商。现在是时候将具体谈判目标书面确定了。随着该协定即将迎来首个周年纪念日，首尔和华盛顿需要制定一份实施计划，将燃料采购和建设准备工作纳入同一个协调推进的时间表。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: As the first anniversary of the ROK–U.S. Joint Fact Sheet singed in November 2025 approaches, Seoul and Washington should demonstrate concrete progress in implementing their commitments. The United States approved South Korea’s construction of nuclear-powered submarines and pledged close cooperation on the requirements for the program, including avenues to source fuel. Those political commitments must now be translated into clear timelines and clearly assigned responsibilities. Securing a shipyard alone will not deliver a nuclear-powered submarine. Fuel specifications and supply arrangements must be established to align reactor design and testing, submarine construction and entry into service. Delays in fuel cooperation could lead to design changes, higher costs and uncertainty for companies considering investment. Diplomatic negotiations and domestic development must not become trapped in a cycle in which each waits for decisions from the other. There has been some progress. In December 2025, the two countries’ foreign affairs officials agreed on the need to move promptly toward follow-up consultations on nuclear cooperation, shipbuilding and nuclear-powered submarines. At a congressional hearing in March, a senior State Department official explained that an interagency review was underway, with the Pentagon addressing infrastructure issues and the State Department handling matters related to potential nuclear fuel provision. In June, delegations from both countries met in Seoul for follow-up consultations on nuclear-powered submarines and civil nuclear cooperation. They agreed to pursue tangible results promptly and establish a mechanism to review progress. In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. This is an important step toward developing naval nuclear propulsion while upholding nonproliferation obligations. However, according to an Oct. 30 news report, a senior South Korean presidential official said that follow-up security negotiations remained on hold and that a second round had yet to be scheduled. Beginning consultations does not, by itself, guarantee sustained progress. Procedural progress must also be distinguished from securing fuel. The Joint Fact Sheet did not guarantee direct U.S. fuel supply or delivery by a specified date. Nor do consultations with the IAEA determine the supplier or delivery schedule. The government nevertheless has a responsibility to explain what has been agreed and which decisions remain outstanding. The most immediate reason South Korea needs nuclear-powered submarines is the threat posed by North Korea’s submarine-launched ballistic missiles. Because the movements of North Korean submarines and the timing of a potential launch cannot be predicted with certainty, the ability to maintain prolonged underwater surveillance and tracking is essential. Nuclear-powered submarines offer advantages in submerged endurance and sustained high-speed operations. Their effectiveness increases when they operate alongside surface ships, maritime patrol aircraft and underwater surveillance systems. South Korea must also prepare for neighboring countries’ expanding submarine forces and maritime influence. Protecting sea lines of communication and maritime interests, while strengthening the persistence of combined ROK–U.S. anti-submarine warfare operations, serves both allies. A greater South Korean contribution to surveillance and anti-submarine warfare in surrounding waters would also give the U.S. Navy greater operational flexibility. The missions of South Korean nuclear-powered submarines should, however, be grounded in the defense of the Korean Peninsula and South Korea’s sovereign authority over decisions concerning their employment. For more than seven decades, the ROK–U.S. alliance has remained one of the world’s strongest. South Korea’s submarine construction expertise and naval maintenance capabilities are valuable assets for the United States as well. Nuclear fuel cooperation and shipbuilding cooperation should not be treated as a simple exchange of concessions. The case should instead be made clearly that both can strengthen the alliance’s maritime security and industrial base. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. A framework should identify the supplier, uranium enrichment level and fuel form, the timing of initial delivery, ownership arrangements and principles for managing spent nuclear fuel. Both governments should also identify the U.S. laws and congressional review procedures applicable to the particular materials or technology to be transferred. Civil nuclear enrichment and reprocessing cooperation and fuel cooperation for naval propulsion serve different purposes and follow different legal pathways. Each therefore requires a clearly defined negotiating agenda. Regardless of the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections, engagement between South Korea’s National Assembly and the U.S. Congress must deepen. Reliable implementation of executive-level agreements requires understanding and support across party lines. Lawmakers from South Korea’s governing and opposition parties should jointly engage the relevant House and Senate committees and key members of Congress. They should explain the military requirement, the benefits to the alliance, the proposed use of low-enriched uranium and the measures intended to uphold nonproliferation commitments. Parliamentary diplomacy must go beyond goodwill visits. South Korean representatives should provide evidence-based answers to congressional questions about fuel management, technology protection, financial responsibilities and the industrial benefits for members’ states and districts. The National Assembly should support the government’s negotiations while scrutinizing budgets, schedules and safety arrangements. Bipartisan support should be accompanied by responsible oversight that helps sustain the program. South Korea must also strengthen its domestic arrangements for implementing the program. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs should lead diplomatic negotiations with Washington, while the Ministry of National Defense and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration define operational requirements and acquisition schedules. Nuclear research institutions and industry should specify the scope of development and technical requirements, and safety regulators should participate from the outset. A governmentwide coordination mechanism must make clear who is responsible for each decision and when it must be made, so that negotiated outcomes can be translated promptly into program execution. Preparations that can proceed should advance while fuel decisions remain pending. Defining operational performance requirements, securing design personnel and preparing testing and maintenance infrastructure should move forward in parallel, with careful management of the risk that fuel decisions may require changes. The government should work backward from the design and construction schedule to set negotiating milestones and prepare contingencies for delays. It should report regularly to the National Assembly on progress and major risks, using closed briefings for sensitive matters. Alliance credibility is demonstrated through implementation. South Korea must prepare for responsible development and effective nonproliferation arrangements, while the United States should clarify the practical pathways for fulfilling its commitments. Legislators in both countries should support this work across election cycles and changes of government. As the agreement’s first anniversary approaches, Seoul and Washington need an implementation plan that places fuel procurement and construction preparations on a single, coordinated timeline. Ret. Navy Capt. Moon Keun-sik is distinguished professor of Graduate School of Public Policy at Hanyang University in Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 是时候将韩国与美国协议付诸行动了
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 随着2025年11月签署的韩美联合情况说明首个周年即将到来，首尔和华盛顿应以具体进展证明双方正在履行承诺。美国已批准韩国建造核动力潜艇，并承诺就该项目的相关要求密切合作，包括核燃料来源渠道。这些政治承诺如今必须转化为明确时间表和清晰的责任分工。仅找到一家造船厂并不能造出核动力潜艇。双方必须确定燃料规格和供应安排，使反应堆设计与测试、潜艇建造及服役相互衔接。燃料合作若延误，可能导致设计变更、成本上升，并给考虑投资的企业带来不确定性。外交谈判与国内研发不能陷入彼此等待对方决定的循环。目前已取得一些进展。2025年12月，两国外交事务官员同意，应迅速推进关于核合作、造船和核动力潜艇的后续磋商。3月举行的一次国会听证会上，美国国务院一名高级官员表示，跨部门审查正在推进，五角大楼负责处理基础设施问题，国务院负责处理与可能提供核燃料有关的事务。6月，两国代表团在首尔举行后续磋商，讨论核动力潜艇和民用核合作。双方同意迅速取得实质性成果，并建立审查进展的机制。9月，韩国还确认已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），拟就其《全面保障监督协定》第14条所设安排开始磋商。这是朝着发展海军核动力推进技术迈出的重要一步，同时也能履行不扩散义务。然而，据10月30日的一篇新闻报道，韩国总统府一名高级官员称，后续安保谈判仍处于搁置状态，第二轮会谈尚未安排。启动磋商本身并不能保证持续进展。还必须将程序性进展与落实燃料供应区分开来。《联合情况说明》并未保证美国直接供应燃料或规定具体交付日期。与IAEA磋商也无法确定供应方或交付时间表。尽管如此，政府仍有责任说明双方已经商定什么，以及哪些决定仍未作出。韩国急需核动力潜艇的直接原因，是朝鲜弹道导弹潜艇带来的威胁。由于朝鲜潜艇的动向及潜在发射时间无法准确预测，长期保持水下监视和追踪能力至关重要。核动力潜艇在水下续航和持续高速运行方面具有优势。与水面舰艇、海上巡逻机和水下监视系统协同行动时，其效能会进一步提高。韩国还必须为邻国不断扩大的潜艇力量和海上影响做好准备。保护海上交通线和海洋利益，同时加强韩美联合反潜行动的持续能力，对两个盟友都有益。韩国为周边水域监视和反潜作战作出更大贡献，也会让美国海军获得更大的行动灵活性。不过，韩国核动力潜艇的任务必须以朝鲜半岛防务为根基，且其使用决定必须由韩国依据主权作出。七十多年来，韩美同盟一直是世界上最强大的同盟之一。韩国的潜艇建造专长和海军维护能力对美国同样宝贵。核燃料合作与造船合作不应被视为简单的利益交换，而应明确说明双方合作都能增强同盟的海上安全和产业基础。是时候把具体谈判目标写入文件了。框架应明确供应方、铀浓缩丰度和燃料形态、首次交付时间、所有权安排以及乏核燃料管理原则。双方政府还应查明适用于拟转让特定材料或技术的美国法律及国会审查程序。民用核浓缩与后处理合作，以及舰船核动力推进所需的燃料合作，服务于不同目标，遵循不同法律路径，因此各自都需要边界清晰的谈判议程。无论美国中期选举结果如何，韩国国会与美国国会之间的交流都必须深化。可靠落实行政层级协议，需要跨党派理解和支持。韩国执政党和反对党议员应共同接触众议院和参议院的相关委员会及国会重要成员，说明军事需求、对同盟的益处、拟使用低浓缩铀的情况，以及旨在维护不扩散承诺的措施。议会外交不能止于礼节性访问。韩国代表应基于证据回答国会议员关于燃料管理、技术保护、财政责任以及相关成员国和选区工业收益的问题。韩国国会应支持政府谈判，同时严格审查预算、进度和安全安排。两党支持应伴随负责任的监督，以帮助项目持续推进。韩国还必须加强落实项目的国内机制。外交部应牵头与华盛顿开展外交谈判，国防部和国防事业厅则界定作战需求及采购时间表。核研究机构和产业界应明确研发范围和技术要求，安全监管机构应从一开始便参与。面向全政府的协调机制必须明确每项决定由谁负责以及应在何时作出，从而把谈判成果迅速转化为项目执行。燃料决定尚未作出期间，可以推进能够开展的准备工作。界定作战性能要求、落实设计人员以及准备测试和维护基础设施应同步推进，同时谨慎管理燃料决定可能引发变更的风险。政府应从设计和建造进度倒推，设定谈判里程碑，并为延误准备应急方案。政府应定期向国会报告进展和重大风险，敏感事项则采用闭门简报。同盟的可信度通过执行来体现。韩国必须为负责任的研发和有效的不扩散安排做好准备，美国则应明确履行承诺的实际路径。两国议员应跨越选举周期和政府更迭，支持这项工作。随着协议首个周年临近，首尔和华盛顿需要一份实施计划，把燃料采购和建造准备纳入同一条协调时间表。退役海军上校文根植是首尔汉阳大学公共政策研究生院杰出教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea added 139,000 jobs in October from a year earlier, government data showed Wednesday, with job growth exceeding the 100,000 mark for the fourth consecutive month. The number of employed people came to 29.17 million in October, compared with 29.04 million a year earlier, according to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Job growth turned positive in June after declining by 40,000 in May, the first drop in 17 months. The country's jobless rate came to 2 percent last month, down 0.2 percentage point from a year earlier. The number of unemployed people totaled 602,000 in October, down 56,000 from the same month in 2025. The employment rate for people aged 15 to 64 came to 70.4 percent, up 0.3 percentage point from a year earlier. The figure for those aged 15 to 29, on the other hand, fell 1.7 percentage points to 42.9 percent

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，美国官员团队本月早些时候访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协定（BTA）举行会谈，新德里和华盛顿仍在努力推动尽早敲定该协议的第一批条款。印度官员对这项拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果会干扰谈判的可能性。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. The two sides discussed issues related to customs and trade facilitation during meetings in New Delhi last week, the official said, requesting anonymity. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections. The US and India have a very consequential relationship which, apart from trade, draws strengths from economic, political and security imperatives, an official said, asking not to be named. According to trade experts, uncertainty created by Washington’s frequent trade measures and the use of tariffs as a negotiating tool had been major hurdles to signing an interim BTA, even though a preliminary draft is almost ready. The two countries issued a joint statement on February 7 outlining a framework for an interim BTA. However, the agreement was not signed after the US Supreme Court invalidated the legal basis for the preferential tariff mechanism Washington had offered, the experts said. India is now awaiting a preferential tariff framework that gives it exporters competitive access compared with exporters from competing countries, they said. The US government is also keen to finalise the agreement at the earliest, they added. In September, US Ambassador Sergio Gor said India and the United States were working to build a “fair, reciprocal and mutually beneficial” trade relationship. “The US-India relationship stands at a historic high point. Pick any sector and the United States and India are working together on it,” Gor said at the 66th annual session of the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) in New Delhi. HT reported it on September 3. Gor said cooperation between the two countries extended from information technology and data centres to pharmaceuticals, defence sales and military exercises. He also pointed to potential cooperation in space, citing NASA’s invitation to ISRO to participate in its Moon Base programme. India and the US have been negotiating a bilateral trade agreement since Prime Minister Narendra Modi and US President Donald Trump met in Washington on February 13, 2025. In February this year, the two countries announced that they had finalised a framework for an interim BTA. Subsequent changes to the US tariff regime, however, have affected the negotiations

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，本月初，一支美国官员团队访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协议（BTA）举行会谈；目前，新德里和华盛顿仍在推动尽早敲定该协议的第一阶段内容。该官员在上周于新德里举行的会议中介绍了相关情况，并要求匿名。印度官员仍对拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果对谈判造成任何中断的可能。另一名要求匿名的官员表示，美印关系非常重要，除贸易外，这种关系还受到经济、政治和安全需要的推动。据贸易专家称，尽管初步草案已接近完成，但华盛顿频繁采取贸易措施以及把关税作为谈判工具，给签署临时BTA造成了重大障碍。专家表示，两国于2月7日发表联合声明，概述了临时BTA的框架。然而，美国最高法院裁定华盛顿所提供的优惠关税机制失去法律依据后，该协议并未签署。专家称，印度目前正等待一套优惠关税框架，使印度出口商相较于来自竞争国家的出口商获得具有竞争力的市场准入。他们补充说，美国政府也希望尽早敲定协议。9月，美国大使Sergio Gor表示，印度和美国正努力建立“公平、互惠和互利”的贸易关系。Gor在新德里举行的汽车零部件制造商协会（ACMA）第66届年会上说：“美印关系正处于历史最高点。无论选择哪个行业，美国和印度都在携手合作。”《论坛时报》于9月3日报道了此事。Gor表示，两国之间的合作涵盖信息技术、数据中心、药品、防务产品销售和军事演习等领域。他还指出双方在太空领域存在合作潜力，并提到NASA邀请印度空间研究组织（ISRO）参与其“月球基地”计划。自总理Narendra Modi与美国总统Donald Trump于2025年2月13日在华盛顿会晤以来，印度和美国一直在谈判双边贸易协议。今年2月，两国宣布已完成临时BTA框架。然而，美国关税制度随后发生的变化对谈判产生了影响

Unlock these with Subscription With 425.61 MW of domestic rooftop solar installations in Tamil Nadu that have benefited from the PM Surya Ghar scheme, the Tamil Nadu Green Energy Corporation is taking efforts to bring more households under rooftop solar. However, industry and consumer representatives say the State government should address a couple of basic policy issues so that more households go in for rooftop solar. “While the government advertisements claim that consumers will get to pay nothing as bi-monthly energy charges if they instal rooftop solar, in reality, they have to pay network charges,” says K. Kathirmathiyon, secretary of Coimbatore Consumer Cause. A.D. Thirumurthi, advisor of the National Solar Energy Federation of India, says the consumers should be exempted from network charges for rooftop solar. Further, in the case of additional solar energy generated in a financial year that goes unused, the consumers should be paid at least the average power purchase cost for the excess solar energy they feed to the grid. Mr. Kathirmathiyon explained that if a consumer instals a five KW rooftop solar and his bi-monthly consumption is 500-550 units, he will supply the excess to the grid. He does not get any payment for the additional power. Instead, he will have to pay nearly ₹5,800 annually as network charges. Why should a consumer pay for solar energy that he has generated and not consumed, he asks. “Tamil Nadu should adopt an approach similar to Kerala instead of allowing surplus electricity credits to lapse without compensation. Network charges applicable to domestic rooftop solar investors under the TNERC tariff framework with effect from October 22, 2021 constitute another major disincentive,” he says. The Government and the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission should ensure domestic rooftop solar power producer/consumer is paid for the surplus electricity remaining unadjusted at the end of the settlement period (31st March). It should also withdraw network/wheeling charges levied on domestic rooftop solar power producers. Mr. Thirumurthi says residents who consume more than 500 units of electricity in two months stand to benefit more if they go in for solar. https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.body: Crimes committed by the late disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein after 2005 could have been prevented were it not for "failures" by federal investigators and prosecutors, a congressional investigation has concluded. The Republican-led US House Oversight Committee on Tuesday released its final report into what it described as the "decades-long" mishandling of the criminal investigations into Epstein and his long-term associate Ghislaine Maxwell. The report's findings are based on interviews and depositions with witnesses, government files, and financial records over a 15-month period. Epstein died in 2019 as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges. "While some of these failures involved an exercise in poor judgment by the USAO, others appeared to be the result of Epstein's pervasive and wide-reaching influence," the report reads, referring to the US Attorney's Office. It states that, rather than fully investigating allegations in other states, the USAO for the Southern District of Florida entered into an agreement with Epstein in 2007 that allowed him to evade federal prosecution. Regarding Epstein's death in a New York prison , investigators concluded this was a result of "a series of institutional failures at the facility," which included staffing shortages, overworked employees, poor recordkeeping, and lax security practices. Testimony the panel solicited was "unable to definitively dispel certain theories" surrounding Epstein's death, the report states, including accounting for a lapse in surveillance footage. It found the Justice Department (DoJ) failed to communicate about document releases and that deficient redactions exposed survivors' sensitive personal information. The DoJ has released millions of pages of Epstein-related files in response to legislation from Congress. Earlier this year, the department had to remove thousands of documents related to Epstein from its website after victims said their identities had been compromised. The report also alleges that financial institutions like American Express enabled human trafficking and immigration fraud by allowing Epstein to use decoy flights and dummy itineraries to transport foreign workers across borders. The BBC has contacted American Express for comment. The investigative panel recommended that Congress should pass legislation to prevent the weaponisation of non-disclosure agreements, which they said Epstein used to silence survivors. "Epstein operated with impunity, shielded and enabled by powerful connections and a justice system that repeatedly failed his victims," said James Comer, the Republican chairman of the committee. He called upon the DoJ to "interview or re-interview key witnesses, investigate Epstein associates accused of criminal activity, and ensure survivors have access to their records. The department remains under bipartisan scrutiny regarding the Epstein files. In the state of New Mexico, where Epstein had a ranch, the top state prosecutor accused the DoJ of stonewalling their criminal investigation. "With all due respect, the Chairman's recommendations have already been addressed," a department spokesperson said in response to Comer's report. The report accuses Democrats of being "obsessed" with trying to implicate US President Donald Trump and that an "unfounded witch hunt continued without regard for the interests of survivors". Trump has previously said he was friendly with Epstein before they fell out in 2004. The president's name appears thousands of times in the Epstein files, but appearing in the documents does not suggest any wrongdoing. The committee's review did not identify any documents that would implicate Trump, the report concluded. In a statement, Rep. Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the Oversight Committee, alleged his Republican colleagues "released a report based on an incomplete investigation and zero public hearings on Jeffrey Epstein". Garcia accused the Justice Department of withholding "over 2.5 million pages of documents". "We will not allow the President and his allies to dismiss this investigation," said Garcia, who is expected to lead the committee when Democrats take control of Congress in January following the recent midterm elections. The family members of one of Epstein's most prominent accusers, the late Virginia Roberts Giuffre, thanked Comer for releasing Tuesday's report. "A sentence from the report stands out to us: 'Questions remain as to whether the DOJ has released all its relevant documents.' We could not agree more and urge that all 7 million-plus files be released," Sky and Amanda Roberts said in a statement. "There are many more individuals who have yet to be identified and brought to justice," they said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.title_zh: 报告发现，美国联邦当局本可阻止爱泼斯坦实施犯罪行为
https://www.myjoyonline.com/us-federal-a.body_zh: 国会调查得出结论，如果不是联邦调查人员和检察官“失职”，已故且声名狼藉的金融家杰弗里·爱泼斯坦在2005年以后犯下的罪行本可得到阻止。共和党主导的美国众议院监督委员会周二发布最终报告，描述了对爱泼斯坦及其长期合作者吉斯兰·麦克斯韦尔刑事调查进行“数十年”处理不当的情况。报告结论基于历时15个月的证人访谈和证词、政府档案以及财务记录。爱泼斯坦于2019年sex trafficking（性交易）指控受审期间死亡。报告称：“其中一些失职是美国联邦检察官办公室作出错误判断的表现，另一些则似乎是爱泼斯坦无处不在且影响深远的结果。”报告提及美国联邦检察官办公室时如此写道。报告指出，佛罗里达州南区联邦检察官办公室没有全面调查其他州提出的指控，而是于2007年与爱泼斯坦达成协议，使他得以逃避联邦起诉。关于爱泼斯坦在纽约一所监狱死亡一事，调查人员认定，这是“该设施一系列制度失职”的结果，包括人员短缺、员工超负荷工作、记录管理不善以及安保措施松懈。报告称，专家组收集的证词“无法明确排除围绕爱泼斯坦死亡的某些说法”，其中包括解释为何部分监控录像出现缺失。报告发现，司法部（DoJ）未能就文件公开事宜进行沟通，而且不充分的删节处理暴露了幸存者的敏感个人信息。响应国会立法，司法部已公开数百万页与爱泼斯坦有关的文件。今年早些时候，受害者称其身份信息遭到泄露后，该部门不得不从网站上删除数千份与爱泼斯坦有关的文件。报告还指控，American Express等金融机构纵容人口贩运和移民欺诈，允许爱泼斯坦使用诱饵航班和虚假行程，将外国劳工运送出境。BBC已联系American Express置评。调查小组建议国会通过立法，防止不披露协议被武器化；小组称，爱泼斯坦利用此类协议迫使受害者保持沉默。委员会共和党主席詹姆斯·科默说：“爱泼斯坦在 powerful connections（强大关系）的庇护和助推下肆无忌惮，而司法系统也一再未能为其受害者伸张正义。”他呼吁司法部“约谈或重新约谈关键证人，调查被控从事犯罪活动的爱泼斯坦关联人员，并确保受害者能够获取与其有关的记录。近期中期选举结束后，民主党预计于1月掌控国会，届时将领导该委员会。目前，该部门因爱泼斯坦文件一事仍受到两党审视。在爱泼斯坦拥有一处牧场的新墨西哥州，该州最高检察官指控司法部阻挠州刑事调查。部门发言人在回应科默的报告时表示：“我们充分尊重主席，但主席的建议实际上已经得到落实。”报告指控民主党“执迷于”试图将美国总统唐纳德·特朗普牵涉其中，并称“无根据的猎巫行动无视幸存者的利益，持续进行”。特朗普此前曾表示，他与爱泼斯坦曾是朋友，双方于2004年闹翻。特朗普的名字在爱泼斯坦文件中出现了数千次，但名字出现在文件中并不意味着存在任何不当行为。报告总结称，委员会审查并未发现任何会牵连特朗普的文件。监督委员会首席民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚在一份声明中指称，其共和党同事“发布了一份基于不完整调查且未举行任何公开听证会的杰弗里·爱泼斯坦报告”。加西亚指控司法部扣留了“超过250万页文件”。加西亚说：“我们不会允许总统及其盟友 dismissing（搁置）这项调查。”预计民主党在近期中期选举后于1月掌控国届时，加西亚将领导该委员会。爱泼斯坦最知名的指控者之一、已故弗吉尼亚·罗伯茨·朱弗的家人感谢科默发布周二的报告。Sky Roberts和Amanda Roberts在一份声明中说：“报告中的这句话令我们印象深刻：‘司法部是否已经公开所有相关文件，目前仍存疑问。’我们完全赞同，并敦促公开全部超过700万份文件。”她们说：“还有许多尚未被查明并绳之以法的人。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.summary_zh: 预计尼日利亚银行系统本周将获得 2.448 万亿奈拉流动性流入，主要由到期的公开市场操作（OMO）票据推动；与此同时，尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）和债务管理办公室（DMO）正准备举行新的债券拍卖，以吸收金融系统中的过剩现金。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/n.body: Nigeria’s banking system is expected to receive N2.448 trillion in liquidity inflows this week, largely driven by maturing Open Market Operations (OMO) bills, even as the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and the Debt Management Office (DMO) prepare fresh debt auctions to absorb excess cash from the financial system. This is according to the Weekly Market Report by the Financial Markets Dealers Association (FMDA), where it projected that OMO maturities would account for N2.298 trillion of the expected inflows, while Treasury bills maturities would contribute N148.565 billion. The anticipated liquidity injection comes against the backdrop of sustained efforts by the CBN to manage excess naira liquidity, with the apex bank raising N5.667 trillion through OMO auctions conducted on November 3 and 6. The anticipated inflows are expected to test the CBN’s liquidity management strategy, particularly as the DMO prepares to raise fresh funds from the market. The N800 billion offer, against only N148.565 billion in Treasury bills maturities, also provides an avenue to withdraw liquidity from the financial system, alongside potential further OMO interventions. Meanwhile, the foreign exchange market recorded divergent movements, with the naira appreciating at the official window but weakening at the parallel market. The country’s external reserves also declined marginally by 0.16 per cent week-on-week to $55.133 billion, following their recent rise above the $55 billion mark, the highest level since December 2008. In the international oil market, average Brent crude fell by 13.45 per cent to $99.97 per barrel, retreating from an intraday high above $116 recorded the previous week. FMDA attributed the decline to easing Middle East supply concerns following signs of de-escalation involving Iran after the United States midterm elections. In the fixed-income market, average FGN bond yields rose by 20 basis points to 16.37 per cent, driven largely by the seven-year instrument, which increased by 104 basis points. Conversely, Treasury bills yields declined by 35 basis points to 17.67 per cent, reflecting a divergence in movements across both segments of the market. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/e.summary_zh: Yamkella 讲话的核心清晰而直接：联邦政府应以明确界定的国家能源政策支持其国家工业政策（NIP），并指出能源政策必须成为有效工业政策的一部分。他说：“能源政策就是工业战略。”“因此，能源政策必须成为工业政策的一部分。”Yamkella 表示，各国不能仅靠制定政策文件就实现工业化。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/11/e.body: Former Director General of United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO), Dr. Kandeh Kolleh Yamkella, was on a familiar turf on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The occasion was the 6 th Adeola Odutola Lecture, which was organised by the Manufacturers Association of Nigeria (MAN) as part of its 54 th Annual General Meeting. The topic of his lecture was “Leveraging National Industrial Policy to Position Nigeria as Africa’s Industrial Hub.” As he mounted the podium, his audience was expectant. One, the distinguished guest lecturer, Yamkella, has spent more than two decades, studying, analysing, promoting, packaging, delivering and advising government and businesses on industrial policies. Two, the federal government in February 2026 launched Nigeria Industrial Policy (NIP), the first in the country’s history. The kernel of Yamkella’s message was clear and direct: the federal government should back its NIP with a clearly defined energy policy for the country, stating that energy policy must be part of an effective industrial policy. He said: “Energy policy is industrial strategy. If we do not fix that, industry will die because no industrial strategy can succeed without reliable electricity.” This is already killing industries in Nigeria as energy cost is reported to constitute between 30 and 40 per cent of manufacturer’s production cost. And for some manufacturers, the energy cost is as high as 60 per cent. “You know the story. It (energy) is killing your industry. Manufacturers spent an estimated N1.3 trillion on self-generated power in 2025, up from N781 billion in 2023, with energy now accounting for as much as 35 to 40 per cent of production costs. Here, some people even say 60 per cent of their operating costs. Whereas energy makes up roughly between 5.0 and 15 per cent manufacturing costs in countries such as India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Turkey, Mexico and South Africa.” He remarked that the strategic point where Asia is beating Nigeria and most of Africa, is energy cost which it subsidies for its manufacturers. For Asia, energy and water is subsidised but in factories have to generate their own power and have their own boreholes. “So energy policy has to be part of industrial policy.” Yamkella stated that countries do not industrialise simply by producing policy documents. According to him, industrial policy matters only when it becomes productive capacity, investment, technology, competitiveness, pushes value addition and creates jobs. Otherwise, it is as good as a piece of paper. He, therefore, tasked government on practical, deliberate implementation of industrial policy. Policy, he said, is one side of the coin. And government deciding that it will drive industrialisation another. That is how the Asians have done it. Because the risks and constraints are many even though Nigeria has the essential foundations for an industrial powerhouse. Yet, he reminded his audience that potential is not performance. Otherwise manufacturing contributions should not be between seven and eight per cent of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) as it is currently in Nigeria. In addition, manufacturing exports generate only 3.0 per cent of the country’s export revenue, which, he said, is far below several other African peers. He pointed out that Nigeria’s biggest economic paradox has been that the country has a large market and abundant resources, yet imports dominate everyday consumption. “I am aware of the government’s effort to change this narrative through the Nigerian industrial policy launched on February 17 this year. Nigeria’s industrial challenge is therefore not a shortage of ambition or enterprise. It is the need to convert scale into productivity, competitiveness, and exports. So we must ask ourselves what it will take to make this ambition a reality at a time that the world is changing,” he said. One of the ways to realise Nigeria’s industrial ambition is for the government to ensure that its newly launched industrial policy must become industrial action. The former UNIDO chief said, “Policy is only the starting point. The true test of any industrial policy lies not in its design alone, but in the execution. So there are key parameters that government must monitor deliberately to check if the policy is working. These parameters are how many new factories are being established because of the new policy? How many existing factories are expanding? How much domestic value is created? How much investment is mobilised? “I say this because in my career at UNIDO, over 75 countries I went to, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, the European countries, China, you name it, their governments are actually visiting factories to measures performance. If it is not going where they want it, the government will put public capital and change policy. The countries I know in Asia that made that break, like Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and others who are catching up, Vietnam, Cambodia, their governments measure how many new factories did we create?” Yamkella said that rather than waiting for MAN to complain, governments in Nigeria should be asking MAN: how do we help your members grow? That’s how Indians grow. He added, “That is why when the consultant came here to look at your textile sector, he looked at the cost of energy and water in Nigerian factories and said that even with cheap labour, you cannot compete because we find other ways to subsidise them by making electricity cheap. So government itself must want to measure and be a friend of MAN and the manufacturers on how to make them do better so that they can create jobs and wealth? It is deliberate policy. It is not just a paper. Government has to be deliberate. But there’s some hope.” Apart from addressing the high cost energy, Yamkella said that Nigeria must think beyond its borders by become world’s dominant players in cement. fertiliser and electric car battery manufacturing. This, he stated, will require a new supply chain that will link the country with Togo and Congo. “Now, fertilizer. Nigeria is producing urea. Togo has phosphate, and Congo has potash. Nigeria could be top five producer of fertilizer in five years. That is the aim, that is the dream. That is why Nigeria must think beyond its borders. You have the core already; your neighbours have the others. Morocco, Togo, Congo. It’s about you producing. But industrial policy should support that now to grow. How do we make that transform Nigeria into one of the leading fertilizer producers of the world? Because I tell you, from America to Europe, everybody’s struggling for fertilizer, ”he said. Yamkella also believed that Nigeria can lead Africa in automobile manufacturing by using deliberate policy actions to drive production. He said: “Nigeria’s industrial future cannot be defined by domestic market alone. Nigeria must manufacture for Nigeria, but also for West Africa, the rest of Africa, and in fact, the world. The opportunity before us is greater than the constraints. I know that, yes, Nigeria can be the powerhouse and the hub for West Africa, and in fact, for the rest of the continent as well.” He recognised that Nigeria has one of Africa’s largest automotive markets and significant assembling capacity. But remarked that there is gap between license capacity and actual production that reminds us that license are not factories. According to him, “installed capacity is not production and assembly without local value chains is not industrial transformation.” Nevertheless, the opportunity, however, is substantial in Nigeria to compete in electric motorcycles, battery swapping systems, buses, fleet vehicles, battery packs assembly, charging infrastructure, and other components for the automotive industry. “But the biggest opportunity I see, and you are doing it already because your solid minerals policy on lithium that says if you want our lithium, you should process 30 per cent here,” he said, adding that Nigeria has “one policy already that is already attracting three, four companies to process your lithium. Put another policy to say now you make the batteries here. “You become the battery hub for the region. That is industrial policy in action. But it has to be backed now by other policies,”he said. Yamkella said that it is good that Nigeria has come back to embrace industrial policy after decades of deindustrialisation that was occasioned by wholesale embrace of the Washington Consensus that it is all about market liberalisation on the premise that industrial policy is not necessary anymore. “ And of course, Africa followed that doctrine. And a lot of industries died, especially here (Nigeria). UNIDO did studies here in Nigeria during my tenure to show the death of Nigerian industry. And we call it de-industrialisation because Nigeria suddenly opened its market. Well, when I went to Asia, it was the opposite. They were still supporting industry.” The Asians never listened. They continued to use public capital, public policy to directly support the industry,” he added. 联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）前总干事坎德·科莱·亚姆凯拉博士于2026年10月6日星期二回到了一个熟悉的地方。此次活动是制造商协会（MAN）举办的第54届年度大会的一部分，也是第6届阿德奥拉·奥杜托拉演讲会。亚姆凯拉演讲的题目是《利用国家工业政策将尼日利亚打造为非洲工业中心》。他登上讲台时，台下听众满怀期待。首先，这位 Distinguished 客座演讲者亚姆凯拉花了二十多年研究、分析、推广、阐释和实施工业政策，并向政府和企业提供工业政策方面的建议。其次，联邦政府于2026年2月推出尼日利亚工业政策（NIP），这是该国历史上的第一部工业政策。亚姆凯拉讲话的核心明确而直接：联邦政府应以一项界定清晰的能源政策支持尼日利亚工业政策，并指出能源政策必须成为有效工业政策的一部分。他说：“能源政策就是工业战略。如果不解决这个问题，工业就会消亡，因为没有可靠的电力，任何工业战略都不可能成功。”据报道，能源成本占制造商生产成本的30%至40%，这已经在扼杀尼日利亚的工业；对一些制造商而言，能源成本甚至高达60%。他说：“情况就是这样。它（能源）正在扼杀你们的工业。2025年，制造商在自行发电方面支出了估计1.3万亿奈拉，而2023年为7810亿奈拉，如今能源占生产成本的比例高达35%至40%。这里有些人甚至说，能源占运营成本的60%。相比之下，在印度、越南、印度尼西亚、土耳其、墨西哥和南非等国家，能源约占制造成本的5.0%至15%。”他指出，亚洲超越尼日利亚以及非洲大多数国家的战略优势在于能源成本，亚洲为制造商提供补贴。对亚洲而言，能源和用水受到补贴，但工厂必须自行发电、自备水井。“因此，能源政策必须成为工业政策的一部分。”亚姆凯拉表示，一个国家不能仅靠制定政策文件就实现工业化。据他所说，工业政策只有转化为生产能力、投资、技术和竞争力，推动附加值并创造就业机会，才具有实质意义。否则，它不过是一张纸。因此，他要求政府切实而有意识地执行工业政策。他说，政策是硬币的一面，政府决定推动工业化则是另一面。亚洲国家正是这样做的。尽管尼日利亚已经具备成为工业强国的必要基础，但其面临的风险和制约因素众多。然而，他提醒听众，潜力并不等于表现。否则，尼日利亚的制造业贡献如今不应仅为国内生产总值（GDP）的7%至8%。此外，制造业出口仅占该国出口收入的3.0%，据他说，这远低于其他几个非洲同行。他指出，尼日利亚最大的经济悖论在于，该国拥有庞大的市场和丰富的资源，但日常消费仍由进口商品主导。他说：“我知道，政府正努力通过今年2月17日推出的尼日利亚工业政策改变这一局面。因此，尼日利亚面临的工业挑战并非缺乏雄心或进取精神，而是需要把规模转化为生产力、竞争力和出口。因此，在世界正在发生变化的当下，我们必须自问，要采取什么措施才能让这一雄心成为现实。”实现尼日利亚工业雄心的途径之一，是政府确保新推出的工业政策转化为工业行动。这位前UNIDO负责人说：“政策只是起点。任何工业政策的真正考验不仅在于其设计，更在于其执行。因此，政府必须有意识地监测一些关键参数，以检验政策是否奏效。这些参数包括：新政策促使多少新工厂建立？多少现有工厂正在扩大？创造了多少国内附加值？动员了多少投资？我之所以这么说，是因为我在UNIDO任职期间走访了75个国家，包括孟加拉国、斯里兰卡、欧洲国家、中国，以及所有你能想到的地方。它们的政府确实会实地走访工厂，衡量绩效。如果发展没有达到预期，政府就会投入公共资本并调整政策。我所了解的亚洲国家中，那些实现突破的国家，如孟加拉国、斯里兰卡以及其他正在赶上的国家，包括越南、柬埔寨，它们的政府会衡量我们建成了多少新工厂。”亚姆凯拉表示，尼日利亚各级政府不应坐等制造商协会抱怨，而应主动询问制造商协会：“我们如何帮助会员实现增长？”印度人正是这样发展的。他补充说：“因此，当顾问前来考察你们的纺织业时，他查看了尼日利亚工厂的能源和用水成本，并指出，即使劳动力廉价，你们也无法参与竞争，因为我们会通过降低电力价格，采用其他方式提供补贴。因此，政府本身必须有意愿去衡量绩效，并成为制造商协会和制造商的伙伴，帮助他们做得更好，从而创造就业和财富。这是一项有意实施的政策，不只是一张纸。政府必须有明确的行动意愿。不过，仍有一些希望。”除了应对高能源成本外，亚姆凯拉还表示，尼日利亚必须突破国界局限，成为水泥、化肥和电动汽车电池制造领域的世界主导者。为此，必须建立将该国与多哥和刚果连接起来的新供应链。他说：“现在说化肥。尼日利亚正在生产尿素。多哥拥有磷酸盐，刚果拥有钾盐。尼日利亚五年内可以成为全球前五大化肥生产国。这是目标，也是梦想。因此，尼日利亚必须突破国界。你们已经拥有核心原料，邻国则拥有其他原料，包括摩洛哥、多哥和刚果。关键在于你们开展生产。但工业政策现在就应予以支持，以推动增长。我们要如何实现这一目标，让尼日利亚成为世界主要化肥生产国之一？因为我告诉你，从美洲到欧洲，所有人都在争夺化肥。”亚姆凯拉还认为，尼日利亚可以通过有针对性的政策行动推动生产，在非洲汽车制造领域发挥领导作用。他说：“尼日利亚的工业未来不能只由国内市场来定义。尼日利亚不仅要为尼日利亚生产，还要为西非、非洲其他地区，乃至全世界生产。摆在我们面前的机会大于制约因素。我知道，尼日利亚确实可以成为西非乃至整个非洲大陆的工业强国和中心。”他承认，尼日利亚拥有非洲最大的汽车市场之一和 significant 组装能力，但也指出，牌照产能与实际产量之间仍存在差距，这提醒人们，牌照并不等于工厂。据他所说，“已安装产能不等于生产，没有本地价值链的组装也不等于产业转型”。尽管如此，尼日利亚在电动摩托车、换电系统、客车、车队车辆、电池组装配、充电基础设施以及汽车工业其他零部件领域，仍有巨大的竞争机会。他说：“但我看到的最大机会在于，而且你们已经在行动，因为你们的固态矿产政策针对锂作出规定：想获得我们的锂，就必须将30%的加工留在本地。”他补充说，尼日利亚“已经制定了一项政策，而且这项政策已经吸引三四家公司加工你们的锂。再制定一项政策，规定现在必须在本国制造电池。届时，你们就会成为本地区的电池中心。这就是工业政策的实际运用。但现在还必须有其他政策配合。”亚姆凯拉表示，尼日利亚在经历数十年的去工业化之后重新拥抱工业政策是一件好事；此前，该国全面接受华盛顿共识，以市场自由化为核心，并以前提“工业政策已不再必要”为依据。“当然，非洲也追随了这一信条。结果许多工业消亡了，尤其是在这里（尼日利亚）。我任职期间，UNIDO在尼日利亚开展研究，揭示尼日利亚工业的消亡。我们称之为去工业化，因为尼日利亚突然开放了市场。然而，当我去亚洲时，情况正相反。它们仍在支持工业。亚洲人从未听信这套说法。他们继续利用公共资本和公共政策直接支持工业。”他补充道。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/mini.body: Layer 1 The Zamfara State Government inaugurated a 13-man committee to curb illegal mining activities across the state. The Secretary to the Zamfara State Government, Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada, inaugurated the committee on Friday in Gusau, the state capital. This was contained in a statement signed by Mr Sulaiman Tudu, the Senior Special Assistant on Media, Office of the Secretary to the State Government, issued in Gusau on Saturday. The committee, headed by the State’s Commissioner for Environment, Abdulrahman Tumbido, has broad membership across security agencies, traditional institutions, and relevant federal and state government agencies. Inaugurating the committee, Mr Nakwada said the initiative was part of the state government’s efforts to assist the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector in the state. The SSG charged the committee to work closely with security agencies and relevant regulatory and local authorities to identify locations where illegal mining is taking place and profile the operators. The committee will also ensure that even licensed companies comply with relevant laws and regulations, take adequate measures to prevent environmental degradation, and safeguard the safety and rights of host communities. In his remarks, the Chairman of the Committee, Tumbido, said the committee will work with reliable information, respect for the law, fairness and regard for the rights and livelihoods of the people. He added that the committee will ensure that its efforts contribute to lasting security, environmental protection and sustainable development in the state. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/mini.body_zh: 第一层 扎姆法拉州政府成立了一个由13人组成的委员会，以遏制全州非法采矿活动。扎姆法拉州政府秘书阿布巴卡尔·穆罕默德·纳夸达于星期五在州首府古绍主持委员会成立仪式。相关内容见州政府秘书办公室媒体高级特别助理苏莱曼·图杜先生签署的声明，该声明于星期六在古绍发布。该委员会由州环境专员阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·通比多牵头，成员广泛来自安全机构、传统机构以及相关联邦和州政府机构。纳夸达先生在主持委员会成立仪式时表示，此举是州政府协助联邦政府推动全州采矿行业正规化工作的一部分。州政府秘书责成该委员会与安全机构以及相关监管和地方当局密切合作，确定非法采矿活动发生的地点，并查明经营者的相关情况。委员会还将确保持证公司遵守相关法律法规，采取充分措施防止环境恶化，并保障东道主社区的安全和权利。委员会主席通比多先生表示，委员会将依据可靠信息开展工作，尊重法律，坚持公平，并重视人民的权利和生计。他补充说，委员会将确保其工作有助于实现全州长久的安全、环境保护和可持续发展。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 우크라이나가 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부의 경고에도 러시아 정유 시설에 드론 공격을 강화하면서 러시아 전체 원유 정제능력의 약 30%가 타격을 입은 것으로 전해졌다. 역내 연료난 속에서도 미국과 합의에 따라 경유를 수출하고 있는 러시아는 우크라이나의 잇따른 공격으로 연료 수급에 더욱 큰 차질을 빚을 것으로 보인다. 10일(현지시간) 로이터통신에 따르면 러시아 석유업계 관계자 2명은 우크라이나가 지난달 말부터 러시아 정유시설에 대한 드론 공격을 재개하면서 전체 정제능력의 약 30%에 해당하는 시설이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔다.

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 우크라이나가 도널드 트럼프 미 행정부의 경고에도 러시아 정유 시설에 드론 공격을 강화하면서 러시아 전체 원유 정제능력의 약 30%가 타격을 입은 것으로 전해졌다. 역내 연료난 속에서도 미국과 합의에 따라 경유를 수출하고 있는 러시아는 우크라이나의 잇따른 공격으로 연료 수급에 더욱 큰 차질을 빚을 것으로 보인다. 10일(현지시간) 로이터통신에 따르면 러시아 석유업계 관계자 2명은 우크라이나가 지난달 말부터 러시아 정유시설에 대한 드론 공격을 재개하면서 전체 정제능력의 약 30%에 해당하는 시설이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔다. 지난 일주일 동안 러시아의 주요 정유시설 35곳 가운데 9곳이 우크라이나의 공격을 받아 가동 차질 등 비상 상황이 발생했다. 업계 소식통들에 따르면 지난달 말 이후 공격받은 정유시설들의 설계상 원유 정제능력은 하루 약 30만t(220만 배럴)에 달한다. 다만 공격받은 시설이 모두 가동을 중단한 것은 아니어서 실제 원유 처리량 감소 규모는 이보다 적을 것으로 추정된다. 업계 소식통들은 지난달 말 하루 약 70만t(500만 배럴)이었던 러시아의 원유 처리량이 이번 공격으로 하루 최대 20만t 줄었을 것으로 추산했다. 러시아의 대형 정유시설도 공격을 피하지 못했다. 지난 9일 밤에는 우크라이나 드론이 러시아에서 두 번째로 큰 키리시 정유시설을 타격해 화재가 발생했다. 우크라이나는 지난달 말 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 발표한 러시아와 우크라이나 간 에너지시설 공격 중단 조치가 실효를 거두지 못하자 러시아 정유시설에 대한 공세를 강화해왔다. 세르게이 라브로프 러시아 외무장관은 전날 러시아 일간 코메르산트 기고문에서 우크라이나가 러시아 에너지시설 공격을 중단하라는 트럼프 대통령의 요구를 무시하고 있다고 비판했다. 반면 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령은 자국의 공격은 우크라이나 에너지 기반 시설을 겨냥한 러시아의 공습에 대응하는 차원이라고 주장했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/11 08:25 송고 2026년11월11일 08시25분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111102.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者申在宇＝据报道，尽管唐纳德·特朗普的美国政府发出警告，乌克兰仍加大力度袭击俄罗斯炼油设施，俄罗斯整体原油炼化能力约30%遭受打击。俄罗斯在与美国达成协议后继续出口柴油，即使区域内燃料短缺不断加剧，乌克兰接连发动袭击预计也将使俄罗斯的燃料供应面临更大障碍。据路透社10日（当地时间）报道，俄罗斯石油业界人士称，自上月底乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油设施发动无人机袭击以来，约占整体炼化能力30%的设施受到影响。过去一周，俄罗斯35座主要炼油设施中有9座遭乌克兰袭击，发生运营中断等紧急情况。据业界消息人士介绍，上月底以来遭袭炼油设施的设计原油炼化能力约为每天30万吨（220万桶）。不过，并非所有遭袭设施都停止运营，因此实际原油加工量的降幅预计小于上述数字。业界消息人士估算，俄罗斯原油加工量上月底约为每天70万吨（500万桶），此次袭击预计使日加工量最多减少20万吨。俄罗斯大型炼油设施也未能躲过袭击。9日晚，乌克兰无人机袭击了俄罗斯第二大炼油设施基里希炼油厂，并引发火灾。上月底特朗普美国总统宣布俄罗斯与乌克兰之间暂停攻击能源设施的措施未能奏效后，乌克兰加强了对俄罗斯炼油设施的攻势。俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫在前一天刊登于俄罗斯日报《商业报》的文章中批评称，乌克兰无视特朗普总统要求停止袭击俄罗斯能源设施的呼吁。与此同时，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，乌克兰发动袭击是为了回应俄罗斯针对乌克兰能源基础设施发动的袭击。报道可通过KakaoTalk发送给okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用。2026年11月11日08:25发布

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-engage.title: Ghana engages US civil rights lawyer Ben Crump over killings of nationals
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-engage.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has approved the engagement of prominent US civil rights lawyer Ben Crump to assist Ghana in seeking justice for nationals killed in the United States in recent months. “Approval has been granted to Ghana's Permanent Mission in New York to engage the services of celebrated US civil rights lawyer, Ben Crump, at no cost to the Ghanaian taxpayer, to assist Ghana in securing justice for all Ghanaians killed in the US in recent months,” the statement said.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-engage.summary_zh: 加纳外交部已批准聘请美国知名民权律师本·克伦普，协助加纳为近几个月在美国遇害的本国公民伸张正义。声明称：“加纳常驻联合国代表团已获批准聘请美国知名民权律师本·克伦普，且不向加纳纳税人收取任何费用，以协助加纳为近几个月所有在美国遇害的加纳人伸张正义。”
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-engage.body: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has approved the engagement of prominent US civil rights lawyer Ben Crump to assist Ghana in seeking justice for nationals killed in the United States in recent months. In a statement issued on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, the Ministry said Ghana’s Permanent Mission in New York had been authorised to engage Mr Crump’s services at no cost to the Ghanaian taxpayer. “Approval has been granted to Ghana's Permanent Mission in New York to engage the services of celebrated US civil rights lawyer, Ben Crump, at no cost to the Ghanaian taxpayer, to assist Ghana in securing justice for all Ghanaians killed in the US in recent months,” the statement said. The Ministry said the decision reflected the government’s commitment to protecting the rights and dignity of Ghanaians living abroad. “Ghana will go every length to secure justice and safeguard the dignity of our dear nationals abroad,” it added. The Ministry said the Foreign Minister was grateful to Mr Crump for what it described as a positive telephone discussion on the matter. It also acknowledged the cooperation of US authorities in efforts to secure justice for the victims. “We equally acknowledge the cooperation and commitment of US authorities in our collective quest for justice,” the statement said. The move follows the recent killings of Ghanaians in the United States, including 15-year-old Javits Frimpong and 24-year-old Joseph Owusu, both of whom were killed in the Bronx, New York. Mr Crump is a prominent US civil rights attorney known for representing families in high-profile cases involving racial injustice and police brutality. His engagement is expected to support Ghana’s efforts to pursue accountability in the cases involving its nationals. The Ministry has not provided details of the legal steps Mr Crump will take, the specific cases he will handle or the timeline for the engagement

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: NNPC Audit Report: Former GMD tells lawmakers ₦210 trillion isn’t missing
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: Former Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company ( NNPC ) Limited, Mele Kyari, said the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy flagged in the Auditor-General’s report covering 2017 to 2023 misrepresents the facts. He said this on Tuesday, when he appeared before the Senate Committee on Public Accounts to respond to allegations in the audit report.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）有限公司前集团首席执行官梅莱·基亚里表示，审计长报告中针对2017年至2023年提出的所谓210万亿奈拉差额歪曲了事实。他周二出席参议院公共账目委员会，就审计报告中的指控作出回应时表示了这一点。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Former Group Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company ( NNPC ) Limited, Mele Kyari, said the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy flagged in the Auditor-General’s report covering 2017 to 2023 misrepresents the facts. Mr Kyari maintained that the money was neither missing nor stolen under his watch, denying reports suggesting that the amount had been lost. He said this on Tuesday, when he appeared before the Senate Committee on Public Accounts to respond to allegations in the audit report. “The issue of ₦210 trillion that is misconstrued in the reports to have been lost, I have confirmed at this moment that nothing is lost. It’s simply not possible under my care and under my leadership for that to happen, but it did not happen,” he said. Mr Kyari argued that the controversy originated from accounting and bookkeeping failures rather than any financial losses. He said he had provided detailed explanations in a report submitted to the committee. “There are actually three issues, which I know have been clarified. They are bookkeeping issues and have nothing to do with any losses. And I really, really confirm that nothing is lost. Those are just accounting entry issues, and I’m sure that description is correct. It’s also in my report how that description works,” he added. The controversy surrounding the alleged ₦210 trillion discrepancy began in June 2025 after details of NNPC Ltd’s audited financial records attracted public attention. At the time, the Senate committee gave the company a seven-day ultimatum to explain the discrepancies. However, NNPC Ltd, now led by Bayo Ojulari, failed to meet the deadline, citing its officials’ attendance at a retreat. The company’s failure to respond to the Senate’s queries fuelled public concerns about transparency and accountability within the national oil company. In November 2025, NNPC Ltd submitted a written explanation to the committee, stating that ₦103 trillion represented accrued expenses, while ₦107 trillion was recorded as receivables. The committee, then chaired by Aliyu Wadada, the senator representing Nasarawa West, rejected the explanation and insisted that the company’s leadership appear in person to provide further clarification. The matter remained unresolved until Ibrahim Dankwambo, the senator for Gombe Central, replaced Mr Wadada as committee chairman and resumed the investigation. The committee later invited Mr Kyari to appear before the lawmakers and account for the discrepancies. In June, the committee threatened to issue an arrest warrant against him to compel his appearance after he failed to honour several invitations. President Bola Tinubu removed Mr Kyari from office in April 2025 amid several corruption-related petitions against him. Mr Kyari also addressed questions surrounding the payment of about ₦2.99 billion for the incorporation and registration of NNPC Limited, explaining that the expenditure covered payments to government institutions responsible for the relevant statutory processes. The former NNPC chief executive said the payment was not for naming the company, contrary to some public interpretations of the financial records. He explained that the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA), enacted by the National Assembly, provided for the incorporation of NNPC Limited as part of the national company’s restructuring. According to the PA, the payment was made to the relevant government institutions and subsequently charged to the Federation’s revenue account. “It’s actually paid to the former FIRS and the Corporate Affairs Commission as a matter of payment for registration. It’s just an entry about who should pay for it. The PIA, which is the National Assembly, states that company owners should incorporate the company. “In this case, the owner of the company at that moment was not necessarily NNPC. The federation must pay for that role in the incorporation. NNPC, which was not owned by the federation at that moment, paid on behalf of the federation and then charged it to the federation’s revenue base.” Mr Kyari also dismissed reports suggesting that NNPC Ltd paid about ₦5 billion merely to register or name the company, insisting that the name was already provided for in the PIA. “I have some comments that, for naming the company, we paid ₦5 billion. Actually, this company was named by the National Assembly, so you don’t need to pay any kobo to register that company. “The company was named by the National Assembly in appropriate sections of the PIA. So there is no such thing. I think it’s a description issue, and we apologise if that wasn’t properly captured by the auditors,” he said. While defending his stewardship, Mr Kyari said he assumed responsibility for the state oil company in 2019 and immediately introduced a transparency and accountability framework to strengthen public confidence in its operations. He said the decision to publish the company’s financial statements exposed its operations to sustained public scrutiny but ultimately improved institutional accountability and operational performance. “When I took responsibility in 2019, the first thing I did was to institute a transparency and accountability framework. I said that public institutions and public leaders must account for what they are responsible for, and institutions must be accountable to their stakeholders, particularly their shareholders. “In the case of NNPC, all Nigerians are shareholders of this company. And I understood this. We took the bold decision to publish the financial records of this company, which has never been done in its 43 years of existence.” After his presentation, Mr Kyari submitted his report to the committee. The committee chairman said the lawmakers would study the document and review his explanations before deciding on further action
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: NNPC审计报告：前总经理告诉议员，210万亿奈拉并未失踪
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited前首席执行官梅莱·凯亚里表示，审计长报告所指出、涵盖2017年至2023年的所谓₦210万亿差额歪曲了事实。凯亚里先生坚称，在他任职期间，这笔钱既没有失踪，也没有被盗，并否认了有关这笔资金已经损失的说法。他于星期二出席参议院公共账户委员会，回应审计报告中的指控时表示了上述观点。凯亚里先生说：“报告中将₦210万亿误认为已经损失，但眼下我确认，没有任何资金遭到损失。在我的管理和领导之下，这种事根本不可能发生，而事实上也没有发生。”凯亚里先生认为，这场争议源于会计和簿记失误，而非任何资金损失。他说，他已在提交给委员会的报告中提供了详细说明。凯亚里先生补充道：“实际上存在三个问题，而且我知道这些问题已经得到澄清。这些都是簿记问题，与任何损失毫无关系。我确实、确实确认没有任何资金损失。这些只是会计分录问题，我确信这样的描述是正确的。我的报告也说明了这种描述具体如何适用。”围绕所谓₦210万亿差额的争议始于2025年6月，当时尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited经审计的财务记录详情引起公众关注。当时，参议院委员会给该公司下了最后通牒，要求其在7天内解释这些差额。然而，由巴约·奥朱拉里领导的尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited未能履行期限，理由是公司官员正在参加务虚会。该公司未能回应参议院的质询，进一步加剧了公众对这家国家石油公司透明度和问责制的担忧。2025年11月，尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited向委员会提交书面说明，称₦103万亿属于应计费用，另有₦107万亿记为应收款项。当时由代表纳萨拉瓦西区的参议员阿里尤·瓦达达担任委员会主席。他拒绝接受这份解释，并坚持要求公司领导层亲自出席，提供进一步说明。此事一直悬而未决，直到戈姆贝中区的参议员易卜拉欣·丹克万博取代瓦达达先生，出任委员会主席并重启调查。委员会随后邀请凯亚里先生出席议员会议，就这些差额作出解释。6月，在凯亚里先生数次无视邀请后，委员会威胁要向他发出逮捕令，迫使其出庭。2025年4月，在针对凯亚里先生的多项贪腐请愿引发争议之际，博拉·蒂努布总统解除了他的职务。凯亚里先生还回应了围绕尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited设立和注册支付约₦2.99 billion的相关问题，解释称，这笔支出涵盖向负责相关法定程序的政府机构支付的款项。这名前尼日利亚国家石油公司首席执行官表示，这笔款项并非用于公司命名，与公众对财务记录的部分解读不符。他解释道，全国议会颁布的《石油工业法》（PIA）规定将尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited的设立纳入国家石油公司的重组计划。根据《石油工业法》，这笔款项支付给了相关政府机构，随后计入联邦收入账户。凯亚里先生说：“这笔钱实际上支付给了原尼日利亚税务局（FIRS）和公司事务委员会，用于办理注册手续。这不过是确定由谁付款的记账问题。全国议会颁布的《石油工业法》规定，公司所有者应负责公司设立。‘当时的公司所有者未必是尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）。联邦政府必须承担公司设立环节的付款责任。当时并不由联邦政府持有的尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）代联邦政府付款，之后再从联邦政府的收入基础中列支。”凯亚里先生还否认了有关尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited支付约₦5 billion仅为公司注册或命名的报道，坚称公司名称已在《石油工业法》中确定。他说：“我看到一些评论称，我们为公司命名支付了₦5 billion。实际上，这家公司是由全国议会命名的，因此注册该公司不需要支付任何科博。‘全国议会已在《石油工业法》的适当条款中为公司命名。所以根本不存在所说的那种情况。我认为这是一个描述问题，如果审计人员未能准确记录，我们对此表示歉意。’”凯亚里先生在为自己任职期间的治理工作辩护时表示，他于2019年接手这家国家石油公司，并立即建立透明度和问责制框架，以加强公众对其运营的信心。他说，公布公司财务报表的决定使公司运营长期受到公众审视，但最终提升了机构问责和运营绩效。凯亚里先生说：“2019年我接手工作时，做的第一件事就是建立透明度和问责制框架。我明确表示，公共机构和公共领导人必须就自身职责作出说明，机构必须对利益相关者负责，尤其是对股东负责。‘对尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）而言，所有尼日利亚人都是这家公司的股东。我充分认识到了这一点。我们作出了大胆决定，公布这家公司的财务记录，而这家公司成立43年来从未这样做过。’陈述结束后，凯亚里先生向委员会提交了报告。委员会主席表示，议员们将研究该文件并审查他的解释，再决定采取何种后续行动

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/10/t.summary_zh: 博拉·蒂努布总统不知第多少次宣布，燃油补贴永远不会恢复，并斥责那些承诺恢复补贴的人为骗子。不过，他表示政府将补贴农业生产，而非燃油消费。蒂努布宣布为农民提供重大新支持，声明政府将补贴农业生产，而非燃油消费。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/10/t.body: For the umpteenth time, President Bola Tinubu has declared that fuel subsidy will never return, dismissing those promising its restoration as liars. He, however, declared that his government would subsidise farming and not fuel consumption. Speaking at a rally in Jigawa State on Tuesday, Tinubu said Nigeria cannot continue to spend the future of its children to sustain a system that was draining the country. The President stated: “To those who say subsidy is coming back, it’s a lie. Don’t let them lie to you again. It’s not going to come back. We cannot spend the future of our children today and feel that they will go tomorrow.” ” Those who think they should bring subsidy back, they are liars. How will you pay for those commitments? How will you repair the roads? How will you maintain them? How will you function? “We will subsidise farming. We will reward small scale farmers. Interest-free loan for farmers is coming. Prosperity is coming. Food security will happen. “I hope you hear me, Nigeria. You hear me, Nigeria. There will be interest-free loan for small scale farmers. We are going to install mechanised farming service centre in six geographical locations. Mechanised farming.” ” We have the arable land, we have the commitment, we have the people. We can feed ourselves and we will bring the food prices down to the minimum. I promise you on agriculture, mechanisation, irrigation and additional value for land, arable land.” Tinubu said universities will be more involved in agricultural research and development than ever before. The President thanked the people for their loyalty and commitment, while promising to address the problem of insecurity head-on. His words: “I have heard you loud and clear. I know you have problems of insecurity in Nigeria. But working together, as your friend and partner, exchange information, anything you know about insecurity, report it immediately.” “I promise you, we are working hard to ensure that Nigeria is safe and our forces are well taken care of, housing, reward, regardless of where they come from. We will conquer insecurity.” “We have been through many wars. We will defeat our enemies. Enemies of unity, enemies of stability, enemies of all.” The President noted that his government has strengthened the police and the armed forces and is paying better salaries today. The President described the student loan scheme, NELFUND as a weapon against poverty. According to him, We are taking away the problem of the education of their children by establishing the NELFUND. NELFUND is a weapon against poverty. Are you with me? NELFUND is a weapon against poverty. And we will continue in that direction. He announced that every money recovered from irregularities by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) is now directed to NELFUND to educate children, and every asset recovered would be invested in NELFUND. Tinubu commended Jigawa state Governor, Umar Namadi, saying he had never seen so much progress made by one man. “I have been here a number of years. I have never seen so much progress being made by one man. That is Governor Umar Namadi. He has worked so tirelessly and hard for all of us to benefit from the benefits of democracy, ” Tinubu stated. Tinubu announced major new support for farmers, declaring that the government will subsidise farming, not fuel consumption. The president assured that his government would invest in medical stability and opportunity in every local government. He further assured that he would lower the cost of living for security and provide reliable power, saying, “not the old privatisation that is not working. We will provide you with reliable power in [every part of] Nigeria.” Speaking, the Director General of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council (PCC) said the massive turnout for Tinubu in the Northwest has exposed the opposition’s claim that the President will not be welcomed in Northern Nigeria. Yari told the President that the crowd before him — men, women and youths — were proof that the Northwest stands with him. He added: “Your Excellency, Mr. President, these are your people, men and women and youths. This is Northwest, where our opponents are campaigning that you are not going to be welcomed in the Northern Nigeria.” Yari stressed that the opponents have nothing to offer beyond what Tinubu has done for Nigeria, both as governor and as President, and what he has done for the North. Yari challenged those who call themselves core northerners to point to any candidate they have supported to victory. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/10/t.title_zh: 蒂努布：我会补贴农业生产，而不是燃料消费
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/10/t.body_zh: 第无数次，博拉·蒂努布总统宣布燃油补贴绝不会恢复，并斥责那些承诺恢复补贴的人为骗子。不过，他表示政府将补贴农业生产，而不是燃油消费。蒂努布周二在吉加瓦州的一次集会上表示，尼日利亚不能继续消耗子孙后代的未来，以维持一个正在耗尽国家资源的体系。总统说：“那些说补贴将恢复的人是在撒谎。别再让他们骗你们了。补贴不会恢复。我们不能今天花掉子女的未来，却指望他们明天继续生活。”那些认为应该恢复补贴的人都是骗子。你们拿什么支付那些承诺？拿什么修路？拿什么维护道路？又拿什么维持运转？“我们将补贴农业生产，奖励小规模农户。面向农户的无息贷款即将推出。繁荣即将到来。粮食安全将得到保障。”我希望你们听明白，尼日利亚。你们听到了吗，尼日利亚？面向小规模农户的无息贷款即将发放。我们将在六个地理区域设立机械化农业服务中心。推动机械化农业。”我们有可耕地，有决心，也有人才。我们能够养活自己，并会把食品价格降至最低。我向你们保证，我们将推动农业机械化、灌溉以及提高土地和可耕地的附加值。”蒂努布表示，大学将比以往任何时候都更深入参与农业研究与开发。总统感谢民众的忠诚和投入，同时承诺正面解决安全问题。他说：“我已经清楚听到了你们的诉求。我知道尼日利亚存在安全问题。但只要我们携手合作，作为你们的朋友和伙伴，你们掌握的任何安全信息都应立即上报。”我向你们保证，我们正努力确保尼日利亚安全，并妥善照顾我们的武装力量，为他们提供住房和奖励，不论他们来自哪里。我们将战胜不安全威胁。“我们经历过许多战争。我们将击败敌人，击败破坏团结的敌人、破坏稳定的敌人以及一切敌人。”总统指出，政府已经加强警察和武装力量，如今也为他们发放更高的薪资。总统称学生贷款计划NELFUND是反贫困的武器。他说：“我们通过设立NELFEND，解决子女的教育问题。NELFEND是反贫困的武器。你们同意吗？NELFEND是反贫困的武器。我们将继续沿着这个方向前进。”他宣布，经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）追回的全部违规资金如今都拨入NELFEND，用于儿童教育；追回的全部资产也将投入NELFEND。蒂努布赞扬吉加瓦州州长乌马尔·纳马迪，称自己从未见过一个人取得如此大的进展。他说：“我在这里已有许多年，从未见过一个人推动如此多的进展。这就是州长乌马尔·纳马迪。他为我们所有人不知疲倦、辛勤工作，让所有人共享民主的成果。”蒂努布宣布将为农户提供重大新支持，并宣称政府将补贴农业生产，而不是燃油消费。总统保证，政府将投资改善每个地方政府的医疗条件和发展机会。他进一步保证将降低生活成本、维护安全并提供可靠的电力。他说：“不是过去那种毫无成效的私有化。我们将在尼日利亚每个地区为你们提供可靠电力。”全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会（PCC）总干事发言称，蒂努布在西北地区获得的大规模支持，戳穿了反对派所谓总统不会在尼日利亚北部受到欢迎的说法。亚里告诉总统，现场的群众——男人、女人和青年——证明西北地区与他站在一起。他补充说：“总统阁下，这些都是您的人民，男人、女人和青年。这里是西北地区，我们的对手正在竞选造势，说您不会在尼日利亚北部受到欢迎。”亚里强调，除了蒂努布担任州长和总统期间为尼日利亚及北部所做的贡献外，反对派拿不出任何其他东西。亚里要求那些自称为北方核心派的人指出，他们曾支持哪位候选人最终获胜。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，社址位于尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，该报通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。这家报纸秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会的交叉议题。您可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系页面

https://x.com/gloriousgod01/status/21202.snippet:
Just in case you're wondering what's going on, China cars are already close to the verge of dominating the car space. Their cars are cheap and smart.

In this post, I've made a list of 7 legit and reliable sites where you can get China cars at low costs. Two of them are run by NYSE-listed companies. The rest are smaller export agents, so check them before you pay.

1. AutoCango (https://t.co/s78avyxWSy): Over 2 million used cars plus new ones. Backed by a NYSE-listed parent company. Third-party inspection reports come in English.

2. China EV Marketplace (https://t.co/GvgJ37sFH5): Electric cars only, new and used. BYD, Xiaomi, Zeekr and more. 20% deposit, balance after you confirm the VIN and photos.

3. Autohome Global (https://t.co/vKyDggsypp): Run by Autohome Inc., also NYSE-listed. They say your payment is held until the car ships, with a refund if it doesn't arrive.

4. ZEEX AUTO (https://t.co/uUVu7VPQgW): Inspect first, pay later. A third-party inspection costs $100 and you approve the report before paying for the car. They also have an Africa site, https://t.co/hPZANs31ci.

5. EAuto Export (https://t.co/bhQ1jgDWUs): A sourcing agent in Beijing. Over 100,000 listings and independent on-site inspection. Fee is 3% of the car price, minimum $600.

6. Auto In China (https://t.co/baqk5mxJrH): A sourcing agent in Guangzhou. Good for ready-stock cars, luxury brands and EVs. Fee for one car is 7% of the price, minimum $300 and maximum $400.

7. Guazi (https://t.co/cSj3HUY5Co): Used cars only. Daily auctions or Buy It Now. Every car gets a 200-point inspection and a grade from S to D.

Before you pay for any car:
Nigeria only accepts left-hand drive. Check this first.
Used cars have an age limit. Confirm the current one with Customs before you buy.
The listed price is FOB, the price at the Chinese port. Shipping, duty and clearing come on top.
Ask for the inspection report. For EVs, ask for the battery report too. Chinese EVs use GB/T chargers.
Pay a company account against a signed contract. Never a personal account.

https://x.com/gloriousgod01/status/21202.title_zh: 如果你还想了解情况，那么中国汽车实际上已经接近主导汽车市场的边缘。
https://x.com/gloriousgod01/status/21202.snippet_zh:
万一你想了解情况如何，中国汽车实际上已经接近主导汽车市场的边缘了。中国的汽车价格实惠，而且智能化程度高。

在这篇文章中，我整理了7个正规且可靠的网站，你可以通过它们以低成本购买中国汽车。其中两个由在纽约证券交易所上市的公司运营。其余是规模较小的出口代理，因此付款前应先核实它们。

1. AutoCango（https://t.co/s78avyxWSy）：提供超过200万辆二手车，也有新车。由一家在纽约证券交易所上市的母公司提供支持。第三方检测报告提供英文版本。

2. China EV Marketplace（https://t.co/GvgJ37sFH5）：只销售电动汽车，包括新车和二手车。车型有比亚迪、小米、极氪等。支付20%的定金，确认车辆识别代号（VIN）和照片后再付清余款。

3. Autohome Global（https://t.co/vKyDggsypp）：由同样在纽约证券交易所上市的汽车之家股份有限公司运营。对方称，在车辆装运前你的付款会被暂扣；如果车辆未能到达，将予以退款。

4. ZEEX AUTO（https://t.co/uUVu7VPQgW）：先检测，后付款。第三方检测费为$100，你在支付购车款前可审核检测报告。该网站还设有非洲站点：https://t.co/hPZANs31ci。

5. EAuto Export（https://t.co/bhQ1jgDWUs）：一家位于北京的采购代理。提供超过100,000条车辆信息，并进行独立的现场检测。收费为车价的3%，最低$600。

6. Auto In China（https://t.co/baqk5mxJrH）：一家位于广州的采购代理。适合采购现货汽车、豪华品牌汽车和电动汽车。单辆车收费为车价的7%，最低$300，最高$400。

7. Guazi（https://t.co/cSj3HUY5Co）：只销售二手车。提供每日拍卖或“一口价购买”服务。每辆车都会接受200项检测，并获得从S到D的评级。

在支付任何购车款之前：
尼日利亚只接受左舵车。首先确认这一点。
二手车有车龄限制。购买前向海关确认当前的限制标准。
标示价格是离岸价，即中国港口的成交价格。运输、关税和清关费用需另行支付。
索取检测报告。对于电动汽车，还要索取电池报告。中国电动汽车使用GB/T充电标准。
签署合同后，将款项支付至公司账户。绝不要支付至个人账户。

https://x.com/ghananewsguide/status/2120.title: The Chief Executive Officer of the Minerals Commission, Isaac Tandoh, has called on the Government of China to treat illegal mining by its n
https://x.com/ghananewsguide/status/2120.snippet:
The Chief Executive Officer of the Minerals Commission, Isaac Tandoh, has called on the Government of China to treat illegal mining by its nationals in Ghana as a bilateral enforcement priority, warning that the conduct of a "lawless minority" is undermining a friendship built over six decades.

Speaking at the China-Ghana Mining Cooperation Conference at the Kempinski Hotel in Accra on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, Mr Tandoh said the integrity of the partnership between the two countries is being tested not in boardrooms, but in Ghana's rivers, forest reserves and farmlands.

"Illegal small-scale mining has become an existential threat to our environment, our water bodies, and our national security. And in too many instances, Chinese nationals have been found at the centre of these illegal operations," he said.

矿业委员会首席执行官Isaac Tandoh呼吁中国政府将中国公民在加纳从事的非法采矿列为双边执法优先事项，并警告称，“一小撮目无法纪者的行为”正在破坏两国六十年建立的友谊。
